title: Assistant Manager/Manager, Traded and Quantitative Risk — CCR/CVA
description: Connect to your Industry Counterparty Credit Risk (“CCR”) and Credit Valuation Adjustment (“CVA”) Risk are major risk types for Financial Institutions, particularly within the Capital Markets divisions of banks and other financial institutions that trade derivatives, securities financing transactions and other counterparty-facing products. These risks sit at the intersection of front office, risk management, finance, model risk, collateral management and regulatory capital. CCR and CVA capital can represent a material component of a bank’s prudential capital requirements, particularly for institutions with significant derivatives and securities financing activity. The drivers of CCR and CVA are complex, requiring a detailed understanding of traded products, counterparty exposure, collateralisation, netting, margining, wrong-way risk, exposure modelling, and the regulatory capital frameworks used to measure and manage these risks. As we expand our Risk Advisory business to more holistically include all risk types, the focus on CCR and CVA continues to increase. With important regulatory developments including SA-CVA, SA-CCR, advancing IMM expectations and model risk management expectations for counterparty credit risk, client-driven demand to support banks and other financial institutions in these areas is creating an increasing need for these skills. Whatever we do, wherever we are in the world, we lead the way , serve with integrity , take care of each other , foster inclusion , and collaborate for measurable impact . These five shared values lead every decision we make and action we take, guiding us to deliver impact how and where it matters most . Connect to your opportunity Responsibilities may include: Providing technical guidance and interpretation of prudential regulations relating to CCR and CVA, including SA-CVA, BA-CVA, SA-CCR, IMM and associated governance, model risk and regulatory expectations for Capital Markets Financial Services institutions. Providing input into, and/or leading, technical presentations to financial services clients covering CCR, CVA, key regulatory trends, technical insights and practical implementation challenges. Developing and managing a portfolio of client relationships across the financial services sector to support business growth. Managing workstreams or projects as part of a Deloitte team to support financial services clients in managing their CCR and CVA regulatory programmes, including SA-CVA implementation, BA-CVA assessment, SA-CCR optimisation, IMM development or remediation, exposure modelling and CVA risk management. Leading and managing teams and individuals to support meeting client demands, while also providing the basis for people development, mentoring and leadership. When supporting our clients, we will be looking for individuals who can work in the CCR/CVA ecosystem, either in the Front Office working with traders, XVA desks, quants or structurers, or in Risk Management, Finance, Model Risk or Quantitative Analytics working with risk managers, finance teams, model validators, credit officers or quantitative teams. Areas of work can and will vary, but the core competencies needed to support these clients remain largely the same. These include the ability to understand traded products, counterparty exposure, netting, collateral, margining, exposure profiles, valuation adjustments, regulatory capital requirements and the practical implementation of models and frameworks within large financial institutions. The candidate should have a broader perspective of potential issues encountered when managing diverse teams and the strategies to overcome them; have a clear understanding of the firm’s commitment to creating a more inclusive culture; and be able to manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution. title: EY-Parthenon Consultant Transactions & Corporate Finance - Strategy and Transactions (w/m/d)
description: Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Du willst mehr als reine Strategieberatung? Du willst tiefer einsteigen als im klassischen M&A? Dann komm dorthin, wo beides zusammenläuft: Bei EY-Parthenon begleitest du CEOs, Vorstände und Private-Equity-Gesellschaften bei transaktionsbasierten Transformationen vom ersten strategischen Gedanken bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Hier arbeitest du an wegweisenden Projekten in vielfältigen Branchen: von der Neuausrichtung und Optimierung von Strategien bis hin zu transformativen Deals und Restrukturierungen. Mit datenbasierten Insights und dem gezielten Einsatz von KI-Technologien eröffnest du neue Märkte, treibst Wachstum voran und entwickelst Unternehmens- und Kapitalstrategien, die den entscheidenden Unterschied machen. Deine Aufgaben Als Mitglied unseres Transactions & Corporate Finance-Teams an den Standorten Hamburg, Frankfurt/Main, Stuttgart, München, Berlin und Düsseldorf stellst du dich anspruchsvollen Aufgaben im Herzen der Transaktionswelt. Du erhältst breite Einblicke in unterschiedliche Branchen und Projekttypen, wodurch du dich zu einem vielseitigen Professional entwickelst und fachliche Exzellenz mit umfassendem Branchenwissen verbindest. Indem du deine analytischen und methodischen Fähigkeiten stärkst, gestaltest du deine Spezialisierung aktiv – sei es durch eine frühe Fokussierung oder durch projektbezogene Erfahrungen in den folgenden Bereichen, wobei dich in dieser Rolle vielfältige Aufgaben erwarten: Financial Due Diligence: Du wirkst bei der Durchführung umfassender Financial Due Diligences mit und analysierst die finanzielle Lage potenzieller Zielunternehmen. Dabei identifizierst du Chancen und Risiken anhand von Geschäftsmodellen, Cashflow-Entwicklungen, Working‑Capital‑Strukturen sowie weiteren leistungs‑ und liquiditätsrelevanten Kennzahlen. Valuation: Du beteiligst dich an der Erstellung von Unternehmensbewertungen im Rahmen von Transaktionen und strategischen Fragestellungen. Dabei evaluierst du zentrale Werttreiber und leitest Bewertungsannahmen ab. Financial Restructuring: Du unterstützt Unternehmen gezielt in herausfordernden Situationen und orientierst dich dabei an anerkannten Standards wie dem IDW S6. Mit bewährten Methoden prüfst du die finanzielle Ausgangslage, erkennst Probleme und entwickelst Lösungen, die Stabilität schaffen und den Fortbestand sichern. M&A Transactions: Du begleitest das Team bei der Beratung von Unternehmen und Private‑Equity‑Investoren im Rahmen von Buy‑Side- und Sell‑Side‑M&A‑Transaktionen und unterstützt bei der Beantwortung finanzierungsbezogener Fragestellungen. Projektarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Berater:innen zusammen, unterstützt die Analyse und Strukturierung von Ergebnissen und bringst diese in aufbereiteter Form in Projektmeetings ein. Dein Skillset Du hast dein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Finanzen, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Ingenieurwesen oder anderen quantitativen Bereichen erfolgreich abgeschlossen und brennst für Entwicklungen und Trends im Bereich Corporate Finance und Accounting. Du konntest durch studienbegleitende Tätigkeiten oder Praktika schon erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Corporate Finance sammeln. Du hinterfragst Fakten kritisch und verfügst über sehr gute Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten in Deutsch (mindestens C1-Niveau) und Englisch. Dein Mindset Agil : Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten. Neugierig : Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden. Teamorientiert : Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen. Deine Benefits Bei EY-Parthenon arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. Eine steile Lernkurve ist dir garantiert. Mehr über unsere Benefits . Bewirb dich noch heute! Mehr Informationen zum Bewerbungsprozess bei EY-Parthenon findest du auf unserer Karrieresei

title: Terminmanager Bau und Infrastruktur (w/m/d)
description:
Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Transformation suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Terminmanager Bau und Infrastruktur (w/m/d).

Das erwartet dich

Projekte –Du wirst als Terminmanager:in Teil von anspruchsvollen und abwechslungsreichen Projekten bei langfristigen Bau- und Infrastrukturvorhaben unserer Mandanten.
Organisation - In Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Teams und Stakeholdern sorgst du proaktiv dafür, dass Großbau- und Infrastrukturprojekte erfolgreich und effizient nach den Projektzielen umgesetzt werden.
Mission – Als Terminmanager bist du verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Nachverfolgung und Steuerung der Terminplanung. Du gewährleistest dabei regelmäßige Fortschrittsermittlungen, Szenarienentwicklungen und unterstützt im Berichtswesen.
Lösungen - Bei Abweichungen führst du entsprechende Analysen (Plan-/Soll-/Ist-) durch und entwickelst Maßnahmen und Handlungsempfehlungen für die Projektleitung mit den Stakeholdern.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast dein Studium in Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Bauingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau, Architektur oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang mit einer technischen und/oder kaufmännischen Vertiefung abgeschlossen.
  • Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Terminmanagement von Bauprojekten oder Bauprojektmanagement mit und interessierst dich für die Planung, Steuerung und Durchführung von Großvorhaben im Bereich Infrastruktur und Großanlagenbau.
  • Idealerweise bringst du Kenntnisse in einschlägigen Verordnungen und Gesetzen (z. B. AHO, VOB und HOAI) und in branchenspezifischer Software im Bereich Terminmanagement (z. B. Primavera P6, Tilos, MS Project) mit.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift..

title: Transaction Services, Deals Insights and Analytics - Senior Associate
description:
About the role:

In this role, you will leverage your financial and commercial knowledge to develop and deliver sophisticated analytics that reveal the core strengths of businesses, supporting strategic decision-making and enhancing investor confidence.

Here's what we offer:

A suite of transformative modelling and analytics products and services that guide our clients through every stage of the deal cycle.

A commitment to the latest technologies and platforms to keep us at the forefront of the industry. Supportive, inclusive team that brings together a wealth of expertise from data science, technology, business, finance, and various industries.

This is an amazing opportunity to grow your career in a nurturing environment that encourages your creative and commercial side. Plus, you'll enjoy the personal growth opportunities, client engagement, and resources that come with being part of our team.

What your days will look like:

You'll be at the heart of our team, crafting and delivering analyses that change the game for our clients. Your day-to-day tasks will include:

  • Developing analytics that reveal the core strengths of a business to its leaders or potential investors, boosting their confidence in the deal
  • Understanding what makes a business tick and creating data-driven tools that empower management to make informed decisions and enhance business value
  • Translating complex technical and financial concepts into clear insights for our non-technical stakeholders, aiding in sound decision-making
  • Enhancing investor and financier understanding by contributing to clear, KPI-focused forecasts that reflect key business sensitivities
  • Strengthening negotiation positions with in-depth analysis of past financial performance, projecting cash flow and profit trends
  • Working with management to develop commercial insights to improve business performance after a deal process
  • Preparing businesses for future transactions by establishing essential KPIs and reporting frameworks
  • Engaging in business development to spot and research new opportunities with current or potential clients

This role is for you if:

We're looking for someone who loves tackling complex challenges and takes pride in explaining their solutions. You'll collaborate with similar analytical minds and engage with a variety of stakeholders. As a team player and excellent communicator, you'll be an advisor who works well with others.

Your commercial and financial acumen will be key as you delve into business drivers, analyse data, and provide transparent, actionable insights to our clients.

  • Experience in client-facing roles.
  • A passion for coaching and mentoring, with a drive to develop and empower your team.
  • Self-motivation and a love for learning.
  • The ability to navigate complex financial and operational issues and solve unique business challenges.
  • ACA or ACCA equivalent is preferred but not required
  • Proficiency in data visualisation tools like PowerBI, Tableau etc
  • Experience in connecting and refining data using tools like Alteryx or Power Query
  • SQL and/ or Python skills would be beneficial.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

description: Du denkst nicht in Problemen, sondern gehst lösungsorientiert jede neue Herausforderung an? Dann kannst Du Dich hier einbringen: Als (Senior) Consultant (m/w/d) Treasury Accounting & Commodity / Energy Trading bist Du vom ersten Tag an in der fachlichen Beratung und Prüfung von Industrieunternehmen, Handelskonzernen und Energieversorgern aktiv. Du betreust eine Vielzahl unserer Mandant:innen gesamtheitlich vom Risikomanagement in Bezug auf Zins-, Währungs- und Rohstoffpreisrisiken, über die Risikoidentifikation, Risikomodellierung und Risikosteuerung bis hin zur optimalen bilanziellen Abbildung nach IFRS und HGB. Du analysierst originäre und derivative Finanzinstrumente sowie Verträge im Rohstoff- und Energiemanagement im Hinblick auf ihre bilanzielle Abbildung nach IFRS und HGB. Hierbei kannst Du unter anderem lernen, wie durch den Energiewandel induzierte Instrumententypen (bspw. Power Purchase Agreements) in der Industrie Einzug nehmen. Des Weiteren berätst Du aufstrebende Unternehmen im Rahmen von IPO's bei der Umstellung auf die Vorgaben der internationalen Rechnungslegung sowie der Ausgestaltung von anteilsbasierten Vergütungsprogrammen. Du erbringst Strategie- und Fachberatung im Hinblick auf die prozessuale und methodische Aufbau- und Ablauforganisation im Treasury sowie die Neuausrichtung des Energie- und Rohstoffhandels, insbesondere im Hinblick auf erneuerbare Energien und ESG-relevante Aspekte. Darüber hinaus hast Du die Möglichkeit, in die finanzmathematische Bewertung von Derivaten, Finanzierungen und anteilsbasierten Vergütungsformen sowohl aus Sicht eines Beraters, als auch aus der Sicht eines Prüfers einzusteigen. Zudem wirkst Du bei der Ausgestaltung von spezifischen ESG-Komponenten in der Welt der Finanzinstrumente mit.
description_en: Do you not think in terms of problems, but rather approach each new challenge in a solution-oriented manner? Then you can get involved here: As a (Senior) Consultant (m/f/d) Treasury Accounting & Commodity / Energy Trading, you will be active in providing technical advice and auditing to industrial companies, trading groups and energy suppliers from day one. You provide comprehensive support to a large number of our clients, from risk management in relation to interest rate, currency and raw material price risks, to risk identification, risk modeling and risk control, to optimal accounting in accordance with IFRS and HGB. You analyze original and derivative financial instruments as well as contracts in raw materials and energy management with regard to their accounting in accordance with IFRS and HGB. Among other things, you can learn how types of instruments induced by the energy transition (e.g. power purchase agreements) are finding their way into industry. You also advise aspiring companies in the context of IPOs on the transition to international accounting requirements and the design of share-based compensation programs. You provide strategic and specialist advice with regard to the procedural and methodological structure and workflow organization in treasury as well as the realignment of energy and raw materials trading, especially with regard to renewable energies and ESG-relevant aspects. In addition, you have the opportunity to get involved in the financial mathematical valuation of derivatives, financing and share-based forms of remuneration from both the perspective of a consultant and an auditor. You will also be involved in the design of specific ESG components in the world of financial instruments.

title: M&A Operations - Software - Technology - Manager
description:
About the role


S& MA& Operations focuses on providing support for potential / actual M&A transactions and assists clients in all operational aspects of the transaction, pre and post deal, including:

  • Pre-deal value creation advisory (i.e. helping clients to prepare their business, or parts of their business for sale)

  • Buy and sell side operational due diligence (i.e. reviewing and reporting on the technology risks and value opportunities for the business)

  • Synergy development and review (i.e. helping to develop or providing an external independent review on the level of synergies available from putting two or more businesses together)

  • Carve out and divestment support (i.e. helping to develop the standalone operating model, one-off costs and standalone operating costs of a divestment)

  • Taking control and 100 day planning (i.e. helping our clients to safely take control of the business, manage risks and deliver ‘quick wins’ during the first 100 days of ownership)

  • Mergers & Acquisitions Integration (i.e. helping our clients protect and grow the value of an acquisition, develop a robust and realistic integration plan and then executing on it)

  • Post-acquisition performance improvement (i.e. reviewing where the value might lie in the business and how realistic and sustainable cost savings can be achieved)

​

What your days will look like:

We are looking for individuals who have industry experience with developing and implementing software platforms and who can help answer the following questions that are typically asked by clients when considering an investment in a technology business or one that is tech-enabled:

  • Is the platform well invested or will I need to spend cash in the short term to address ‘tech debt’?

  • Is the platform well designed and can it support the planned business growth (either through increased scale, acquisition or addressing adjacent markets / territories)?

  • Do the roadmap initiatives align with and support the business plan?

  • What is the competitive ‘moat’ when it comes to both features and functionality vs peers and the potential that others (such as AI) can address the same market at lower cost?

title: Junior konzultant - Korporátní finance & Oceňování a Ekonomické poradenství
description: To nejdůležitější v pár větách Náš tým Korporátních financí pracuje na těch největších transakcích v rámci střední a jihovýchodní Evropy. Našim klientům poskytujeme odborné poradenství, které slouží jako podklad pro klíčová rozhodnutí. Připravujeme finanční modely a ocenění pro top hráče ze světa investování, financí a průmyslu, jako jsou PPF, J&T, Penta, ČEZ, Česká spořitelna, a mnoho dalších. Přidej se k nám do týmu. Naučíme tě, jak funguje velký transakční byznys , a zároveň získáš rozhled v řadě odvětví. Co je pro nás důležité Pod vedením zkušených kolegů se budeš podílet na komplexním řešení projektů v oblasti korporátních financí, oceňování a finančního modelování. Víme, že jsi teprve na začátku kariéry. Ale tady je několik věcí, které jsou pro tuhle práci podstatné. Jsi studentem posledního ročníku nebo máš dokončenou vysokou školu ekonomického , nebo technického zaměření (pokud jsi v nižším ročníku, podívej se na naši nabídku internshipu). Máš povědomí o korporátních financích , finanční analýze , modelování , financování a cash flow . Pokud máš k tomu i nějaké praktické zkušenosti, velmi to oceníme. Mluvíš a píšeš dobře anglicky a k tomu máš hlubší znalost češtiny nebo slovenštiny. Výstupy zpracováváme hlavně v Excelu a PowerPointu v úzké spolupráci v našem týmu a za průběžných konzultací s klientem. Máš zápal pro věc . Rád/a se neustále učíš nové věci. A hlavně to musí být dobrý match . Budeš s kolegy trávit hodně času, tak si musíte sednout i lidsky. Jak se ti odměníme Nástupní mzda 60 000 korun měsíčně a každý rok progres v rámci hierarchie a platu. Šikovné nováčky do dvou let povýšíme na seniora a v tu chvíli se jim zvedne plat klidně o 20 000 korun. Na příjemné benefity budeš mít nárok už od začátku. Tady je pár z nich: Volno: 6 týdnů volna abys mohl/a načerpat nové síly. Benefitní body : 30 000 v Cafeterii můžeš utratit podle sebe. Třeba si pořídit Multisport kartu, nakoupit dárky nebo si užít odpočinek na Slevomatu. Profesionální rozvoj: U nás se neustále učíš a rozvíjíš své schopnosti. Nabízíme ti jedinečný program profesního rozvoje a pestrou paletu kurzů v naší learningové mapě. Můžeš využívat přístup ke vzdělávacímu portálu Udemy.com a k jazykovým kurzům. Máš možnost si udělat certifikaci ACCA nebo CFA a nejen, že ti jí rádi zaplatíme, ale dáme ti i studijní volno nad rámec dovolené. Naši kolegové ti poskytnou podporu v podobě counselingu a interního koučinku. Odměna za doporučení kandidáta: Získej od 10 do 70 tisíc Kč za doporučení nového kolegy. iPhone i k soukromému používání. Slevy pro zaměstnance: Užij si skvělé zvýhodněné nabídky na širokou škálu služeb. Využij slevy ve Fruitisimo, Sushi Time, optice, fitness centru BodyBody a na dalších místech. Zdraví a péče: Získej přístup k rychlému a pohodlnému online poradenství uLékaře.cz od kvalifikovaných lékařů, zapoj se do wellbeing programu Better EY a využij možnost účastnit se tematických akcí a workshopů spojených s péčí o své zdraví. Navíc ti v EY zaplatíme i životní pojištění. Týmová spolupráce a zábava: U nás nejde jen o práci, ale také o zábavu a týmovou spolupráci. Nejen po úspěšném dokončení velkých projektů tě čekají odměny ve formě večeří, bowlingu, firemních večírků a dalších skvělých akcí, které posilují naši týmovou atmosféru. Můžeš se také zapojit do CSR aktivit. Co tě čeká po odeslání přihlášky Prvním krokem jsou vstupní testy , které vyplníš doma. Budou celkem tři: z angličtiny, z kognitivního myšlení v češtině a z logického myšlení. Na tyto testy budeš mít týden a budeme rádi, když je stihneš vyplnit včas. Pokud projdeš vstupními testy, bude tě čekat case study . Tu budeš vypracovávat u nás v kanceláři. Dostaneš na ní 2,5 hodiny a budeš mít možnosti využívat AI. Počítač i zadání budeš mít připravené. Následovat bude rovnou pohovor, kde s kolegy s týmu proberete case study a pak další detaily práce v týmu Oceňování a modelování. Určitě se nemáš čeho bát, bude to probíhat formou diskuze. Následuje zpětná vazba a pak už případná nabídka. Na termínu nástupu se domluvíme podle tvých potřeb. Těšíme se na tebe!
description_en: The most important things in a few sentences Our Corporate Finance team works on the largest transactions within Central and Southeastern Europe. We provide our clients with expert advice that serves as a basis for key decisions. We prepare financial models and awards for top players from the world of investment, finance and industry, such as PPF, J&T, Penta, ČEZ, Česká spořitelna, and many others. Join our team. We will teach you how a large transactional business works, and at the same time you will gain insight into a number of industries. You have an awareness of corporate finance, financial analysis, modeling, financing and cash flow. If you also have some practical experience, we would greatly appreciate it. You speak and write English well, and you also have a deeper knowledge of Czech or Slovak. We process the outputs mainly in Excel and PowerPoint in close cooperation in our team and in continuous consultation with the client. You have a passion for the cause. title: Consultant - Technology Consulting - Financial Sector
description:
Jaký bude tvůj tým

V oblasti technologického poradenství u PwC nejde jen o to být součástí velké firmy; jde o to vidět, jak věci fungují v různých společnostech. Obvykle jsme přímo v centru dění, pracujeme v projektových týmech, které zajišťují vše od návrhu po dodání skvělých, špičkových řešení v oblasti byznysu a technologií nejen v České republice. Neustále rozvíjíme své dovednosti, nejen prostřednictvím projektů pro klienty, ale také díky jiným zajímavým aktivitám. Máme šest úžasných komunit, kde se věnujeme tématům jako jsou New Technologies, Digital Strategies, Business Intelligence, Self Mastery, SAP, Agile, ESG.

Na koho se můžeš spolehnout

Irina Stoianova je manažerka v týmu Technology Consulting se zaměřením na post merge integrace, business operations a strategii finančních institucí. Na projektech funguje jako projektový manažer a business analytik, klientům vytváří a napočítává business cases a je také zodpovědná za jejich realizaci v implementační fázi, čímž pomáhá klientům dosahovat úspor a provozní efektivity. Irinu před práci nebo po ní můžete potkat ve fitku nebo v bazénu. Volno ráda tráví ve společnosti svých přátel nebo doma u knížky se svými dvěma kočkami.

Jako konzultant budeš klíčovým hráčem v projektech pro klienty, budeš brainstormovat a implementovat tyto inovativní řešení v oblasti byznysu a technologií po celé České republice a Evropě pro klienty z finančního sektoru.

  • Budeš se přímo podílet na projektech pro naše klienty

  • Ponoříš se do analýzy a mapování podnikových potřeb

  • Pomůžeš s návrhem a realizací řešení

  • Budeš prezentovat implementovaná řešení zákazníkům

  • Budovat a řídit vztahy s klienty každý den

Co by ti nemělo chybět

  • Máš vysokoškolský titul? Skvělé!

  • Zkušenosti? Fajn, pokud je máš, ale není to nutnost (max 2 roky)

  • Máš skutečnou lásku k technologiím a jejich vlivu na business svět

  • Dobrá znalost ekonomiky a managementu

  • Jsi vždy připraven hledat inovativní řešení

  • Máš chuť se učit nové nástroje a řešení

  • Máš silné sociální dovednosti a komunikační schopnosti – super důležité pro každodenní život, práci s klienty a tvým týmem

  • Jsi motivovaný, ambiciózní a pracovitý

  • Samostatný, s pozitivním přístupem

  • Plynulá znalost češtiny/slovenštiny a angličtiny (oba jazyky jsou nutností)

Čím tě potěšíme my?

  • Kariérní zkušenost z Big4

  • 30.000 benefitních bodů na sport, stravenky, do lékárny nebo na kulturní zážitky

  • Počítač a iPhone s neomezenými daty

  • Placené volno 25 dní, 3 wellbeing days a až 2 dny "vánočního" volna navíc

  • Můžeš si nastavit flexibilně svůj pracovní rozvrh nebo občas pracovat z domova

  • Máme pravidelné odborné vzdělávání v různých oblastech – byznysové, technické i soft skills, pomocí Digital Upskilling Academy nebo našich Technology komunit, v rámci kterých pořádáme různá školení

  • Dostaneš podporu zkušenějších kolegů v týmu, nebo i buddyho, abys na to nebyl/a sám/a

  • Network zajímavých lidí a zábavu – každý měsíc se v PwC konají akce (např. Closing Semester party, Lunch Breaks a další)

  • Každý měsíc máme TC statusy, na kterých si povíme, jak to vypadá na našich projektech a poté vyrazíme na společnou aktivitu (např. karaoke, indoor mini golf apod.) - určitě se podívej, jaká je práce u nás v Technology Consulting

PwC, to je největší auditní tým v České republice, ale i poradenské týmy, které se zaměřují na strategie, fúze & akvizice, restrukturalizace, finanční poradenství, daně, právo, technologie, data nebo forenzní analýzu. Zjisti, jak snadné je kombinovat tyto znalosti, když jsi na správném místě. Máme více než 364 000 kolegů ve 151 zemích. V PwC vytváříme inkluzi

We are usually right in the center of the action, working in project teams that ensure everything from the design to the delivery of great, cutting-edge solutions in the field of business and technology, not only in the Czech Republic. It's great if you have them, but it's not a necessity (max. 2 years) You have a real love for technology and its impact on the business

title: HR analyst/Statistical expert
description:
Jaký bude tvůj tým

Budeš pracovat v týmu zkušených profesionálů, kde je samozřejmostí otevřená komunikace, sdílení know-how a společná odpovědnost za kvalitní výsledky. Zakládáme si na spolupráci a vzájemné důvěře.

Na koho se můžeš spolehnout

Andrea se profesně zaměřuje na oblast transparentního odměňování, HR transformace a procesních personálních auditů, kde propojuje analytický přístup s praktickou implementací změn. Ve volném čase ráda cestuje, lyžuje a věnuje se tenisu.

O čem bude tvoje role

  • Odpovědnost za aplikaci statistické metody (regrese) dle požadavků směrnice EU o transparentnosti odměňování a certifikačního procesu EQUAL‑SALARY Foundation.

  • Spolupráce s klienty při ověřování kvality dat a jejich upřesňování.

  • Porozumění filozofii a principům odměňování klientů na základě dokumentace a odborných diskusí.

  • Interpretace reálných mzdových a kompenzačních situací v rámci analýzy „stejná odměna za stejnou práci“.

  • Práce se statistickými nástroji, jako jsou R, R Studio a podobný software.

  • Vysvětlování statistických výsledků a konceptů HR týmům tak, aby byly prakticky využitelné.

  • Úzká spolupráce s týmem, který přebírá další fáze procesu po dokončení statistické analýzy.

  • Spolupráce na dalších projektech a iniciativách, kde jsou klíčové analytické dovednosti a práce s daty.

Co by ti nemělo chybět

  • Vysokoškolské vzdělání (Mgr./Ing. nebo ekvivalent) v oblasti ekonometrie, ekonomie nebo sociálních věd se silným zaměřením na kvantitativní metody, mikroekonometrickou analýzu a kauzální inference.

  • Výborná čeština a angličtina.

  • Zkušenost na obdobné pozici alespoň 3 roky

  • Pokročilá znalost analytických nástrojů, jako jsou R, Python nebo Stata, včetně schopnosti zvolit vhodný model, interpretovat výsledky regresních analýz a formulovat smysluplné závěry.

  • Schopnost samostatně realizovat kompletní mzdovou analýzu nebo kontrolu včetně výstupů a reportů.

  • Znalost oblasti Compensation & Benefits a základních HR témat.

  • Znalost lokální legislativy týkající se rovného odměňování v ČR je výhodou.

Co ti nabízíme my

  • Koncentrovanou zkušenost a rychlý kariérní růst. Může ti to znít jako fráze, ale tak to skutečně je.

  • Férovou mzdu a roční bonus odpovídající tvému výkonu.

  • Flexibilní pracovní dobu a možnost občasné práce z domova.

  • Placené volno 30 dní, 3 Wellbeing days a 2 dny volna navíc od firmy na konci roku.

  • Špičkový Ultrabook a iPhone s neomezenými daty.

  • Benefit program s 45.000 body, který můžeš využít na dovolenou, vzdělávání, stravenky, sport, zdraví... Prostě na to, co tě baví.

  • Podporu tvého rozvoje a vzdělávání.

  • Rozvoj tvých osobních a profesních dovedností a kompetencí.

  • Mimopracovní aktivity a Away Days (team building, ski weekend apod.).

  • Buddy systém a pravidelnou zpětnou vazbu na tvoji práci, konzultace s koučem, se kterým můžeš řešit svůj další rozvoj i kariérní směr.

Zaujala tě naše pozice? Tak nám pošli svůj životopis.

PwC, to je největší auditní tým v České republice, ale i poradenské týmy, které se zaměřují na strategie, fúze & akvizice, restrukturalizace, finanční poradenství, daně, právo, technologie, data nebo forenzní analýzu. Zjisti, jak snadné je kombinovat tyto znalosti, když jsi na správném místě. Máme více než 364 000 kolegů ve 151 zemích. V PwC vytváříme inkluzivní pracovní prostředí, kde každý může být sám sebou a najde si své místo a příležitost k rozvoji. I letos jsme úspěšně obhájili prestižní Equal Pay Certifikaci – jsme tak jednou ze čtyř firem v Česku (a jedinou z Big 4), která prokazatelně uplatňuje férové odměňování bez ohledu na pohlaví.

Join us at PwC Technology Consulting, where we blend business and technology! Be part of a team that crafts innovative solutions across Europe, diving into diverse company cultures and technologies.Our journey doesn't stop at client projects. Dive into our six knowledge-rich communities, from New Technologies to Digital Strategies and beyond. At PwC, it's not just about growing; it's about thriving and leading the tech revolution.

Tomáš Karas is a senior manager who leads our team of data experts and business intelligence projects. When he is not working, you can either see him with the team somewhere after work for a drink, or he takes care of a small home zoo, including two children and about 80 guinea pigs from their family farm.

Are you passionate about data and eager to expand your skills and knowledge? Do you aspire to lead and guide others in your field? Dive deeper into the realms of implementation, data modeling, and ETL processes with our dynamic team. Come, grow and lead with us!

You will look in large databases for specific data. You will lead young engineers, and you will be the main intermediary for communication with the client.   • Define cloud solution architecture design in data solutions.

  • Data transformation rules definition and implementation

  • Report design and implementation

  • Functional and technical design preparation

  • Lead and guide junior colleagues

Requirements of the role

  • University degree

  • At least 5 years of experience

  • Cloud knowledge and practical experience with one of the following - Azure, AWS, Google Cloud

  • Practical experience with at least one of the following programming language - Python, Spark, PySpark, Java, Scala, R, C#

  • Experience with at least one of the following data management capabilities as data mesh architecture, master data management, data modeling in data vault, data governance

  • Strong analytical thinking, communication and presentation skills

  • Attention to detail, accuracy and punctuality

Our Benefits and Fun

  • Stable, but challenging working environment providing plenty of opportunities for your continuous professional growth.

  • Fair salary and flexible working hours.

  • Paid time off 30 days, 3 wellbeing days and 2 extra days off from the company at the end of the year.

  • High-end Ultrabook and iPhone with unlimited data.

  • Benefit program with 45.000 points that you can use for holidays, education, food vouchers, sports, health... Simply on what you enjoy.

And various training within our technology communities.

title: Manažer/ka pro oblast nepřímých daní
description:
Do týmu nepřímých daní hledáme zkušeného kolegu či kolegyni na pozici manažera.

Jaký bude Tvůj tým

Je nás okolo dvaceti a jsme pestrý tým seniorních a juniorních kolegů. Zaměřujeme se na komplexní analýzu klientských transakcí a požadavků z pohledu nepřímých daní. Využíváme nejnovější technologie, nástroje a umělou inteligenci. Jsou mezi námi zkušení profesionálové, rodiče malých dětí, studenti i mladí lidé pár let po škole.

Manažeři v našem týmu se specializují na nejrůznější průmyslová odvětví – automotive sektor; výroba, distribuce a prodej rychloobrátkového zboží; farmaceutické společnosti; finanční instituce; podnikání v nemovitostech; e-commerce, technologie, veřejné instituce a další. Umíme DPH, spotřební daně, cla i energetické daně. Z oblasti ESG se věnujeme například CBAM. Velkou část opakující se práce s daty automatizujeme.

V našem týmu klademe důraz na otevřenou komunikaci, vzájemný respekt a spolupráci. Jsme zvyklí si naslouchat. Sdílíme pracovní zkušenosti, a realisticky nastavujeme termíny. Na schůzkách se snažíme být plně přítomní a chodíme včas.

Důvěra je pro nás klíčová – věci řešíme přímo, přiznáváme chyby a hledáme řešení, ne viníka. Každý může otevřeně říct svůj názor, rozdílné pohledy držíme ve věcné rovině. Naše hodnoty jsou respekt, zdraví, humor a laskavost.

Na koho se můžeš spolehnout

Na Míšu. Míša vede náš tým a zároveň se stará o své klientské portfolio, kterému poskytuje odborné poradenství v oblasti DPH. Je ti kdykoli k dispozici nejen pracovně, ale i lidsky - pokud budeš potřebovat něco probrat nebo poradit. Rozvíjí nové příležitosti a projekty, propojuje nás s kolegy ze zahraničí i vedením firmy, hlídá rozpočet týmu a reprezentuje nás na různých akcích.

Kromě práce je Míša máma dvou dětí, ráda cestuje a sportuje.

O čem bude Tvoje role

  • kompletní řízení projektů od a do z

  • komunikace s klienty, daňovou a celní správou, zahraničními kancelářemi

title: Transaction Services – Manager (Financial Due Diligence)
description:
PwC Transaction Services – Manager (Financial Due Diligence)

At PwC we work on some of the most exciting and market-leading deals, and we pride ourselves on our inclusive culture, focus on wellbeing and commitment to development. You’ll have the opportunity to build a long-term career working with high-profile clients across a diverse range of transactions, supported by leading technology, advanced data tools, and innovative digital platforms.

Our Transaction Services practice supports private equity, investment funds and corporates throughout the deal cycle. You will work across a range of sectors, developing your commercial understanding, and gradually building deeper sector expertise as your career progresses.

About the role:

As a Manager in Financial Due Diligence, you will play a hands-on role in delivering high-quality financial and commercial analysis. You’ll work closely with teams to investigate business performance, support the preparation of diligence reports, and contribute insight that helps clients understand key drivers and risks in a transaction.

You’ll also develop your leadership capabilities by guiding day-to-day work, supporting team members, and building the confidence to take on larger areas of ownership over time. As your commercial awareness grows, you’ll increasingly contribute to client conversations and the development of opportunities across the practice. If you’re looking to build your career in deals and develop strong analytical and commercial skills within a supportive team, we’d be excited to hear from you.

What your days will look like:

  • Taking ownership and delivery of your financial due diligence areas.

  • Working with teams to analyse financial and non-financial information on buy-side and sell-side engagements.

  • Contributing to the preparation of clear, insightful financial due diligence reports.

  • Supporting interactions with senior management, business owners, and private equity investors.

  • Identifying trends, risks, deal breakers and value-creation opportunities.

  • Helping to coach and support junior team members in developing strong analytical and commercial skills.

  • Using data and analytics tools (Alteryx, PowerBI) to enhance insight and project delivery.

  • Building internal and external networks and contributing to the development of opportunities.

  • Demonstrating integrity and values-led leadership.

The role is for you if:

  • Hold ACA/ICAS (or equivalent international qualification).

  • Have strong financial due diligence and analysis skills and commercial awareness.

  • Have excellent report writing, data interpretation, and Excel skills.

  • Are experienced in managing teams and delegating effectively.

  • Can mentor and coach colleagues.

  • Hold strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Can build trusted relationships with clients and internal teams.

  • Have a willingness to embrace data tools and new ways of working.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

description:
About the role:

You’ll be joining our Data & AI capability as a Manager in the Data Engineering team, leading one or more teams to design and deliver advanced data solutions that address complex challenges for PwC and its clients. Operating at the forefront of data engineering, you’ll support projects across various industries such as healthcare and financial services, shaping and scaling data platforms that underpin analytics, AI and machine learning.

You’ll combine hands-on technical delivery with team leadership, setting direction for robust, modern data engineering practices. You’ll work in a cross-functional environment, collaborating across business and technology to deliver tangible value from data.

We’re looking for a motivated self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity and experienced in managing cross-functional delivery, with 4+ years of data engineering experience, to join us in either our Manchester or Birmingham offices.

What your days will look like:

  • Leading and developing teams of data engineers, creating a collaborative, high-performing environment focused on building reliable and scalable data solutions.

  • Providing technical direction for the design, build and support of data pipelines, data platforms and analytics infrastructure, ensuring alignment with organisational goals and industry best practices.

  • Contributing hands-on to solution design, development and troubleshooting, including code reviews and resolution of complex technical issues.

  • Building data engineering capability by driving adoption of modern techniques, tools and patterns, supporting the professional growth of your teams and the wider Data & AI capability.

  • Engaging stakeholders across business, technology partners and clients to understand requirements, set priorities and deliver impactful data solutions.

  • Ensuring quality by overseeing the development, deployment and validation of data solutions, maintaining high standards of accuracy, reliability and performance.

This role is for you if:

  • Proven experience leading or managing data engineering teams or workstreams in complex environments.

  • Strong object-oriented Python skills for developing, testing and packaging code, including experience with tools such as GitCliff, and familiarity with frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow where relevant to data and AI workloads.

  • Experience with Apache Spark for large-scale data processing.

  • Effective use of coding tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot and similar to accelerate high-quality delivery.

  • Experience developing APIs using FastAPI or similar technologies to expose data and analytics services.

  • Strong understanding of business intelligence needs and optimising data transformations for AI and BI applications.

  • Solid understanding of best practices in data engineering architecture, including data modelling, orchestration, testing and observability.

  • Familiarity with SDLC methodologies such as SAFe, Agile and JadX and experience applying them to data engineering projects.

  • Experience using repositories and DevOps tooling including GitHub and Azure DevOps.

  • Hands-on experience with major data engineering tools and platforms such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory and Palantir.

  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP), ideally more than one, for data engineering workloads.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions. We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: M&A Operations - Integration - Manager
description:
About the role:

The M&A Operations team consists of c.250 people who advise clients on the operational and strategic aspects of merger and acquisition (M&A) projects, acting as a strategic and trusted advisor to both Corporate and Private Equity clients on transactions ranging from £50 million to over £5 billion. M&A Operations is a market leading team that sits within PwC’s Strategy& Value Creation Business Unit and provides a highly complex, fast paced, challenging yet rewarding environment for those who aspire to grow and develop in their careers. Within M&A Operations sits the Integration team, a specialist group of c.16 professionals working cross-sector and focused specifically on supporting clients through complex integration programmes.

As a Manager in the M&A Operations Integration team, you will manage day-to-day delivery of M&A integration engagements, supporting Senior Managers and Directors on complex transactions and supporting junior staff within the engagement team. You will help translate integration strategy into executable plans whilst managing teams and client interactions. The role offers exposure to high-profile transactions across a range of sectors, alongside responsibility for business development, team leadership and capability building.

We comprise both career-consultants and individuals with experience gained in industry and actively seek diversity of experience in our new team members.

What your days will look like:

You will help our clients focus on the right priorities at the right time in their M&A integration projects. Leading and working with a number of stakeholders to make a meaningful, hands-on contribution and engaging deeply with our clients to define integration strategies and target operating models to deliver in line with the deal value case. As a Manager in the M&A Integration team, your role responsibilities will largely cover:

  • Supporting with designing and building client integration programmes, including strategy definition, target operating model, value creation (synergy) assessment, integration planning (Day 1 and "100-Day"), and post-acquisition execution.

  • Supporting with developing a combined operating model and defining the level of integration required across business functions.

  • Managing day-to-day client interactions, working with C-suite executives and their teams to deliver high-quality work and relevant recommendations.

  • Supporting the creation of proposals and client presentations in collaboration with other PwC functional and sector teams.

  • Driving the growth of the M&A Integration team by forging strong business relationships with clients.

  • Collaborating with the team to build and share knowledge, support the continuous development of best practices, and introduce relevant new ideas (e.g., digital tools).

title: LA&R, Valuations - Capital Equipment, Manager
description:
About the role:

Join PwC’s growing Valuations team within Capital Equipment (CE), where we help clients make informed decisions about their physical assets across the deal cycle and beyond. You will work with a diverse client base across sectors including Energy & Infrastructure, Industrials, Consumer and Private Equity, supporting them through transactions, financial reporting, insurance, asset-based lending and tax-related valuation needs. The role is not only about technical valuation delivery; it is about building trusted relationships, understanding client priorities, communicating complex matters clearly, and working collaboratively with specialists across PwC to deliver practical, insight-led advice.

This role offers the opportunity to accelerate your career through exposure to a wide range of clients, sectors and asset types, working on complex engagements across the UK and internationally. You will collaborate with global teams and cross-disciplinary specialists, developing your stakeholder management, project delivery, commercial judgement and client-facing skills. We also use data analytics tools and emerging technologies, including AI, to enhance how we work and deliver insights to clients. With increasing responsibility, client exposure and opportunities to contribute to business development, this role is well suited to individuals looking to further develop their careers in a dynamic and evolving valuations environment.

What your days will look like:

You will:

  • Deliver Capital Equipment valuation engagements (PPA, pre-deal, insurance, lending, tax), ensuring high-quality, timely outputs

  • Manage client relationships, including scoping, fee discussions and presenting conclusions

  • Manage multiple valuation engagements simultaneously, coordinating project plans, resources, budgets and stakeholder expectations to ensure timely and high-quality delivery.

  • Review complex valuation models and reports, applying robust challenge and judgement

  • Coordinate multi-disciplinary teams (Deals, Audit, Tax) to deliver integrated solutions

  • Develop and coach junior staff; drive quality and consistency across the team

  • Contribute to business development, including proposals, thought leadership and client networking

The role is for you if:

  • You have strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills

  • You have strong project management skills, with the ability to prioritise competing demands, manage stakeholders effectively, and deliver complex projects to deadlines.

  • You can operate in a fast-paced environment, handling multiple engagements simultaneously

  • You demonstrate commercial awareness and sound professional judgement

  • You take ownership of delivery and team development

  • You are motivated to build and grow our fixed assets valuation offering in a dynamic market

Essential requirements of the role:

  • Must possess a degree in Engineering (essential), ideally complemented by a professional qualification (e.g. ACA, CFA, MRICS) or equivalent work experience. This includes international candidates who qualify through experience in their home country

  • Demonstrable experience in capital equipment / fixed asset valuations

  • Strong Excel and modelling capability; experience reviewing complex models

  • Experience managing teams and client-facing delivery

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Health Consulting Enterprise Transformation – Manager
description:
About the Role:

We are building one of the most innovative and health‑focused consulting capabilities and are market leading in digital transformations, particularly with Electronic Patient Records (EPRs). Our work centres on helping public and private health and social care organisations design and deliver large‑scale transformation — from rethinking digitally enabled health systems to modernising services, improving patient outcomes and enabling more efficient, and resilient organisations.

The UK health and social care sector is undergoing once‑in‑a‑generation change: integrated care systems, elective recovery, digital and data transformation, workforce redesign, financial sustainability and the adoption of digital health technologies at scale. Our team supports clients across the NHS, arm’s‑length bodies, local government and independent providers to navigate this complexity and deliver meaningful, lasting change.

We are a collaborative, diverse and growing team with deep expertise in public and private Healthcare. As a Manager, you’ll lead client EPR and digital transformation engagements, bring strong sector and EPR supplier knowledge, and work with multidisciplinary teams to shape and deliver end‑to‑end transformation programmes that make a difference to patients, clinicians, communities and the wider system.

What your days will look like:

  • Managing the design and delivery of health‑focused, technology‑enabled EPR transformation programmes — including care pathway transformation, implementation planning, programme mobilisation, organisational readiness and optimisation
  • Developing insight into client needs across care settings, and supporting the growth of our Health Enterprise Transformation market
  • Helping to evolve our tools, methods and assets specifically for EPR and digital health transformation, drawing on best practice across change, programme delivery and digital adoption
  • Leading engagement economics, risk and issue management, and ensuring high‑quality programme and project delivery
  • Building trusted relationships with senior health stakeholders and expanding your network across the sector and delivery models

This role is for you if:

  • You have hands‑on experience scoping and delivering EPR transformation programmes within the health or social care sector — such as clinical or operational transformation, digital health initiatives, workforce change or data‑led improvement programmes
  • You have knowledge of EPR systems and understand the delivery and implementation e.g. Oracle Health, Epic, Nervecentre
  • You have experience in EPR supplier design and implementation methodology, transformation programme management, change and adoption, or transformation communications across multi-disciplinary care settings
  • You understand the transformation opportunities and constraints unique to health and social care — including patient safety, quality and outcomes, regulatory requirements and workforce pressures
  • You understand, identify and can execute on opportunities to leverage AI to accelerate EPR delivery
  • You are comfortable developing requirements across process, people, organisation, technology and data to support EPR transformation aligning to key vendor methodologies
  • You can articulate the tangible benefits of digital and data technologies in healthcare, such as digital care pathways, analytics, interoperability and automation
  • You have a successful track record of leadership in healthcare — either from consulting or from working directly within the sector
  • Ability to travel to client site across the UK - 60% of time will be spent on client site

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

title: Senior Pipeline Manager
description:
About the role:

This role sits within the Sales and Marketing function, supporting one of the firm’s Lines of Service to strengthen pipeline management and contribute to overall growth ambitions.
The individual will work closely with market teams, building trusted relationships with key stakeholders to understand pipeline dynamics and provide timely insights into sales performance. These insights will inform targeted interventions, improve opportunity qualification, and ensure effective mobilisation of the wider Sales and Marketing function.
The role will champion best practice in opportunity management, including the consistent use of Salesforce, and drive awareness and adoption of established sales protocols. It will also support the identification and progression of priority opportunities through a structured pipeline cadence.
Working in collaboration with Bids and Proposals teams, the role will help embed a consistent qualification methodology and ensure appropriate coaching is in place for key opportunities.
Reporting to the Head of Sales for the relevant Line of Service, the role contributes to the delivery of the broader sales strategy. It also forms part of a wider network focused on enhancing sales effectiveness and enabling improved outcomes across the organisation.

What your days will look like:

  • Embed a structured pipeline cadence to proactively identify new opportunities and drive progress across the existing portfolio.

  • Analyse pipeline trends to generate clear, actionable insights that inform sales performance and support decision-making.

  • Facilitate qualification (win plan) discussions with engagement teams to accelerate opportunities and improve win outcomes.

  • Leverage pipeline data and promote best practices in Salesforce to identify growth opportunities, strengthen forecasting confidence, and maintain high-quality pipeline management.

This role is for you if:

  • Demonstrated experience in business development, sales, or a related function within professional services or a service-led environment.

  • Comfortable building and managing relationships with senior stakeholders, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively.

  • Experience using Salesforce or similar tools, with an interest in data analysis and turning insights into meaningful business outcomes.

  • Ability to support and embed change initiatives that enhance sales processes, pipeline management, and overall performance.

  • Strong commercial awareness, with the ability to interpret data and communicate clear, actionable insights.

  • Good understanding of the sales lifecycle and the key elements required to progress and convert opportunities successfully.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.
We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

Tvoje role v týmu „Budeš součástí týmu, jehož cílem je záchrana firem, které se i kvůli pandemii dostaly do finančních potíží a jejich management i akcionáři se mohou spolehnout, že uděláme maximum pro to, abychom je dostali z nejhoršího. Častokrát to znamená detailní analýzu klientova businessu a hledání správných míst, kde ušetřit nebo vyjednat lepší podmínky s věřiteli nebo bankami. Naposled se nám to povedlo se společností Smartwings. Studujeme oblast podnikání našich klientů do hloubky. Díky tomu třeba víme, jak fungují letadlové motory, jak se vyrábí elektřina nebo recyklují odpady těmi nejmodernějšími metodami. Taky se díváme na to, jak se trh vyvíjí, vytváříme podrobné finanční plány a modely. V konečné fázi prezentujeme příběhy našich klientů přímo v bance nebo u investorů. Zastupujeme jejich zájmy, argumentujeme a získáváme peníze pro rozjezd, expanzi nebo udržení jejich podnikání. V mém týmu tě čeká zajímavá práce, která současně představuje investici do tvé budoucnosti. Za pár měsíců si osvojíš obrovské množství dovedností, které budeš mít možnost dál rozvíjet a aplikovat v různých projektech. Zaplatíme ti mezinárodní certifikaci CFA (k ní ti dáme placené studijní volno) a umožníme ti podívat se do světa.“ - David Zlámal, Partner, tým Korporátních financí a restrukturalizací Co je pro nás důležité Víme, že jsi teprve na začátku kariéry. Ale tady je několik věcí, které jsou pro tuhle práci podstatné: Studuješ magisterské studium ekonomického zaměření a jsi v posledním nebo předposledním ročníku. Máš čas pracovat minimálně 20 hodin týdně . Orientuješ se v korporátních financích . Finanční modelování, bankovní financování a řízení cash-flow jsou náš denní chléb. Čím víc o tom víš, tím snazší budou tvé začátky. Nemáš strach z angličtiny . Používáme ji opravdu často – při schůzkách s klienty i při práci se zahraničními kolegy. Chceš pestrou práci , protože každý den se budeš učit nové věci. Během dne tě čeká práce na více projektech současně, a tak se ti hodí i chladná hlava a dobrý time-management. Vzájemná chemie . Dobře víme, že kde to nefunguje lidsky, to drhne i po pracovní stránce. A tak je pro nás důležité, abychom si rozuměli. Náš tým tvoří parta mladých lidí, kteří začínali jako teď ty. Baví nás spolu pracovat, ale i trávit čas po práci nebo na týmových nebo firemních akcích. Jak se ti odměníme Nástupní mzda 200 Kč/hod., smlouvu na HPP (zkrácený úvazek) a k tomu benefity, které ti zaručeně udělají radost. Benefitní body v Cafeterii můžeš utratit podle sebe. Třeba si pořídit Multisport kartu, nakoupit dárky nebo si užít odpočinek na Slevomatu. Profesionální rozvoj : U nás se neustále učíš a rozvíjíš své schopnosti. Nabízíme ti jedinečný program profesního rozvoje a pestrou paletu kurzů v naší learningové mapě. Můžeš využívat přístup ke vzdělávacímu portálu Udemy.com a k jazykovým kurzům. Naši kolegové ti poskytnou podporu v podobě counselingu a interního koučinku. iPhone a laptop i k soukromému používání. Slevy pro zaměstnance : Užij si skvělé zvýhodněné nabídky na širokou škálu služeb. Využij slevy ve Fruitisimo, Sushi Time, optice, fitness centru BodyBody a na dalších místech. Zdraví a péče : Získej přístup k rychlému a pohodlnému online poradenství uLékaře.cz od kvalifikovaných lékařů. Navíc ti zaplatíme i životní pojištění. Nejen po úspěšném dokončení velkých projektů tě čekají odměny ve formě večeří, bowlingu, firemních večírků a dalších skvělých akcí, které posilují naši týmovou atmosféru. title: Threat Intelligence Analyst
description:
About the team

At PwC, our people in cybersecurity focus on protecting organisations from cyber threats through advanced technologies and strategies. They work to identify vulnerabilities, develop secure systems, and provide proactive solutions to safeguard sensitive data.

Those in information security at PwC will focus on protecting sensitive data and systems from cyber threats through risk assessments, security audits, and implementing robust security measures. Your work will help enable the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets for clients.

Job description & summary

  • Lead and manage projects and processes, ensuring timely delivery and stakeholder satisfaction

  • Drive continuous process improvements and lead cross-functional teams informally

  • Communicate effectively across teams and geographies, both verbally and in writing

  • Analyze and report on cyber threats, including attribution, incident response, and threat actor TTPs

  • Develop and deliver intelligence reports (strategic, tactical, operational)

  • Recommend preventative controls based on threat trends and incident findings

  • Apply intelligence tradecraft (e.g., kill chain, MITRE ATT&CK, diamond model) and structured analytic techniques

  • Utilize tools such as SIEM (Splunk preferred), Threat Intelligence Platforms (e.g., MISP, ThreatQ), malware sandboxes, and OSINT tools

  • Support detection development, malware analysis, and command & control framework analysis

  • Apply intelligence models to assess adversary intent, capability, and opportunity

Requirements of the role

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree preferred.

  • 4+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, incident response, security operations, and/or information security.

Preferred certifications

  • SANS certification.

  • ISC2 certification.

What you bring

  • Experience owning projects and successfully delivering results against timelines.

  • Ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate across teams.

  • Strong communication skills, including translating technical findings for non-technical audiences.

  • Structured and methodical approach to prioritization and execution.

Technical experience

  • Threat intelligence frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and Cyber Kill Chain.

  • Threat actor analysis and TTP tracking.

  • SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, or similar technologies.

  • Detection engineering and security monitoring.

  • Threat intelligence platforms and intelligence feeds.

  • Incident response and cyber investigations.

  • OSINT collection and analysis.

  • Cybercrime, ransomware, and emerging threat trends.

  • Basic scripting or programming, preferably Python.

Nice to have

  • Experience with VirusTotal or similar intelligence platforms.

  • Previous technical leadership experience.

  • Python automation or scripting experience.

  • Personal cybersecurity research activities or home lab experience.

  • Additional SANS or ISC2 certifications.


Our Benefits and Fun

  • Stable, but challenging working environment providing plenty of opportunities for your continuous professional growth.

  • Fair salary plus annual bonus corresponding with your performance.

  • Paid time off 30 days, 3 well being days and 2 extra days off from the company at the end of the year.

  • High-end Ultrabook and iPhone with unlimited data.

  • The possibility to set your work schedule flexibly. We also offer remote work from home.

  • Benefit program with 55.000 points that you can use for holidays, education, food vouchers, sports, health... Simply on what you enjoy.

  • Support for your education and development: we offer business and digital training and many other training and workshops to further develop your personal and professional skills.

title: Oracle Procure to Pay Consultant (P2P)
description:
About the role

You’ll be joining our Oracle Consulting services team. As a Certified Oracle Cloud partner, we help our clients use Oracle’s technology and applications to build their digital enterprise on the cloud; transform business functions, including finance, supply chain, HR, and tax; achieve maximum value on their investment through Managed Cloud Services; and help them manage risk and ‘go live’ on time and on budget through Oracle Cloud Embedded Assurance.

You’ll be joining a team that’s rated by Gartner and IDC Marketspace as a Leader in several categories, including being positioned as a Leader in Gartner’s Magic Quadrant for Oracle Cloud Application Services, worldwide.

You’ll work with the latest technologies and big-name companies on projects that are driving the future of those organisations. Playing key roles on client engagements, assisting in creating new opportunities and contributing to knowledge sharing and the development of our people.

What your days will look like:

  • Leading, or providing key support to the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workstream for large client programmes focused on Oracle ERP Cloud technology, helping clients transform their procurement, supplier management, sourcing, purchasing, receiving, invoice processing and payment processes.

  • Leading, coaching and developing teams of PwC consultants across onshore, offshore and client teams, fostering a collaborative, high-performing delivery environment.

  • Owning the successful delivery of the Procure-to-Pay workstream, acting as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders and providing leadership across solution design, delivery, governance and deployment.

  • Partnering with client leadership to drive delivery, remove delivery blockers and enable successful business adoption throughout the programme lifecycle.

  • Driving effective programme governance through proactive RAID management, executive reporting and informed decision-making.


The role is for you if you have:

  • Detailed knowledge of Oracle Procurement and Payables Cloud capabilities - with the ability to configure and deploy these modules within complex transformation programmes. This includes Self Service Procurement, Purchasing, Supplier Qualification, Sourcing, Procurement Contracts, Supplier Portal, Supplier Lifecycle Management, Receiving, Invoice Management, Payment Processing, Approval Management.

  • Awareness and understanding of the interactions across other Oracle applications and platform components, including Cash Management, Expenses, Tax, Projects, Sourcing, Integration Cloud (OIC), Reporting and Analytics.

  • A strong understanding of best-practice Procure-to-Pay (P2P) business processes, including requisition-to-purchase order, strategic sourcing, supplier onboarding and governance, approval workflows, receiving, invoice matching, payment processing, procurement compliance, segregation of duties and financial controls, together with the associated Oracle Cloud design, configuration and implementation options within large-scale transformation programmes.

  • Full lifecycle experience of a minimum of 3 Oracle Procurement and Payables (P2P) Cloud implementations, including design, configuration, testing, deployment and post-go-live support.

  • Understanding of end-to-end process and data interactions across Procurement, Inventory, Payables, General Ledger, Cost Management, Order Management and Warehouse Management.

  • Experience working with Finance, Shared Services and Procurement stakeholders to design and implement integrated Procure-to-Pay operating models.

  • Must be able to be SC cleared.

Demonstrable experience in several of the following activities:

  • Building trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, influencing decisions and communicating complex business and technical concepts with confidence.

  • Ability to design and document end-to-end Procure-to-Pay solutions, including sourcing, supplier management, purchasing, approvals, receiving, invoicing and payment processes

  • Planning and leading Oracle workstreams through design, build, testing, deployment and hypercare.

  • Lead

Transaktionsberatung - Als Teil des Deals Strategy & Operations Technology Teams bietest du umfassende Technologie- und Betriebsexpertise bei Carve-Outs, Integrationen, Desinvestitionen und weiteren strategischen Transaktionen. Dabei unterstützt du unsere Kunden darin, den Deal-Prozess zu beschleunigen und den Unternehmenswert zu steigern.

description:
About the role

We are seeking a Finance Transformation and ERP Managing Director to lead growth and delivery for large-scale finance transformation programmes across Health and Local Public Services sectors. This senior leadership role focuses on driving outcome-driven, technology-enabled finance transformations utilising modern cloud ERP platforms and data insights.

You will work closely with senior client leaders such as CFOs and COOs, shaping multi-year transformation strategies that improve finance operating models, controls, and enterprise platform adoption. By building repeatable delivery models and sector-specific assets, you will help scale successful implementation while ensuring strong governance and risk management.

This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of public sector finance transformation, embedding innovations like AI-enabled planning and digital operating models, all while leading a talented team of directors, managers, and specialists.

• Experience working with or within Health and Local Public Services organisations, with insight into their governance, procurement, and resilience challenges.
• Established ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders including C-suite executives.
• Strong leadership skills with experience managing and developing senior teams to deliver scalable results.
• Commercial acumen in managing complex portfolios, including financial performance and risk governance.
• Practical knowledge of cloud ERP platforms and enabling technology adoption in finance functions.

title: Director - AI-enabled Transformation in the Insurance Sector
description:
About the role:

You’ll be joining PwC’s Risk Line of Service, within our AI & Modelling team, where we help clients harness advanced analytics, Generative AI and agentic technologies to transform how they manage risk, make decisions and create value.

This role sits at the intersection of AI transformation, insurance expertise and risk management. You will play a leading role in shaping and delivering PwC’s AI agenda for the insurance sector, with a particular focus on finance, actuarial, pricing, capital and risk functions across life and non-life insurers.

You will be responsible for building, leading and scaling a multidisciplinary team developing cutting-edge Generative AI and agentic solutions, working closely with actuaries, technologists, data scientists, insurance specialists and PwC’s onshore and offshore Technology Centres of Excellence.

What your days will look like:

  • Leading AI-driven transformation programmes for insurance clients, focused on insurance pricing, reserving, capital modelling, finance transformation and risk analytics.
  • Building and leading a high-performing team responsible for designing and delivering Generative AI and agentic solutions, combining actuarial, engineering, data science and insurance expertise.
  • Acting as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders (CROs, CFOs, Chief Actuaries, Heads of Pricing and Risk), helping them navigate the implications of AI for governance, controls, performance and value creation.
  • Developing people, coaching future leaders and creating an inclusive, collaborative culture across multidisciplinary teams.

This role is for you if:

  • You have deep experience leading transformation programmes, ideally within insurance, but strong candidates from adjacent sectors (financial services, risk, capital-intensive industries) will be considered.
  • You bring strong technical credibility across areas such as: Generative AI and agentic architectures, Advanced analytics and modelling, Data-driven decision-making, Broader AI and cloud technology landscapes
  • You understand insurance finance, pricing and risk, and how these functions are evolving in response to AI, regulation and market pressure.
  • You have a proven track record of building and leading teams, including multidisciplinary groups of actuaries, engineers, data scientists and domain specialists.
  • You are comfortable working with senior client stakeholders, able to build trust, challenge constructively and influence strategic decisions.
  • You bring a strong commercial mindset, with experience identifying market opportunities, shaping propositions and contributing to revenue growth.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions. ​

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: AI Solution Engineer - Manager
description:
About the role

We are looking for an experienced AI Solution Engineer to act as the link between PwC’s industry architects, who identify AI business cases, and the firm’s development capabilities. This role shapes AI solutions, meets client needs, and delivers measurable business value and technically feasible solutions. The AI Solution Engineer is a key technical resource responsible for selecting, designing, demonstrating, and delivering prototype solutions that align with customer needs and business goals during early engagement. As a trusted advisor, the Solution Engineer has a strong mix of technical expertise, problem-solving skills, and business acumen to effectively create cloud prototypes to demonstrate and communicate the value of solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. They provide experience in identifying viable and feasible AI solutions to address specific client issues and demonstrate PwC’s technical capability as part of proposals. They demonstrate extensive knowledge of hyperscaler AI offerings, understanding all of the technical requirements and dependencies of a product/solution and explaining them to potential clients

What your days will look like;

Primarily sales-oriented, this role is focused on supporting the sales process by bridging the gap between technical teams and non-technical salespeople. The role helps sales teams select and prospects understand the AI/ML solution, demonstrates how it solves their business problems, and assists in demonstrating AI technical excellence to the client in the early sales process

  • Extensive experience working with sales teams and shaping viable and feasible software solutions as part of process change for enterprise customers

  • AI Model Architecture – Evidenced expertise in LLMs, SLMs, (Large Language Models/Small Language Models) performance, suitability, training requirements, and deployment

  • An understanding of underlying statistics, machine learning and data science, data engineering and big data concepts is required

  • An understanding of the process and data complexities and prerequisites, and success criteria needed to deliver a solution that meets user and business needs

  • Cloud Security & FinOps – Knowledge of landing zones, security, and AI cost optimisation ​

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Data engineer - Technology consulting
description:
Jaký bude tvůj tým

V oblasti technologického poradenství u PwC nejde jen o to být součástí velké firmy; jde o to vidět, jak věci fungují v různých společnostech.
