Neustále rozvíjíme své dovednosti, nejen prostřednictvím projektů pro klienty, ale také díky jiným zajímavým aktivitám. Máme šest úžasných komunit, kde se věnujeme tématům jako jsou Business Intelligence, New Technologies, Digital Strategies, , Self Mastery, SAP, ESG.

Jsi nadšenec do dat, kterého baví moderní technologie, datové modelování, automatizace procesů a transformace dat? Máš chuť prohloubit své znalosti, naučit se nové věci a získat certifikáty, které tě posunou v kariéře na další úroveň? Pokud ano, pak neváhej a přidej se k nám!

Na koho se můžeš spolehnout?

Tomáš Karas je senior manažer, který vede náš tým datových expertů a Business Intelligence projektů. Na projektech pracuje jako datový architekt a projektový manažer v jednom, a spolu se svými týmy pomáhá budovat velké datové sklady, případně využívá data ke zjednodušení a automatizaci procesů a ušetří tak našim klientům 1000 dní nudné operativní práce. Když nepracuje, můžete ho buď vidět s týmem někde po práci na skleničce, nebo se stará o malou domácí zoo, včetně tří dětí a asi 80 morčat z jejich rodinné farmy.

O čem bude tvoje role

Zajímají tě data a moderní technologie? Budeme společně navrhovat a implementovat klíčové procesy na zpracování dat v rozsáhlých organizacích v Česku i zahraničí. Naučíš se pracovat s moderními technologiemi, efektivně zpracovávat velké objemy dat a integrovat data mezi jednotlivými platformy. Díky tomu pomáháme našim klientům transformovat procesy a šetříme tisíce hodin manuální práce měsíčně.

  • Komunikace s obchodními analytiky, technickými experty a testovacími týmy

  • Vývoj a návrh procesů transformace dat z různých zdrojů

  • Vytváření nebo modifikace datových modelů

  • Implementace datových integrací

  • Optimalizace a automatizace procesů v datových platformách

  • Psaní a aktualizace technické dokumentace týkající se datových řešení a procesů

Co by ti nemělo chybět

  • Ukončené vysokoškolské vzdělání

  • 1-3 roky zkušeností se zpracováním dat a automatizací procesů

  • Znalost databázových nástrojů, SQL, Python, GIT, a nástrojů na transformaci dat

You’ll be joining PwC’s Risk Line of Service, within our AI & Modelling team, working at the forefront of AI-enabled transformation in the insurance sector.

As a Manager / Senior Manager, you will sit close to the technology: shaping solution architecture, guiding engineering and modelling teams, and ensuring that AI solutions are robust, scalable, explainable and fit for purpose in a regulated insurance environment.

You will work alongside actuaries, data scientists, engineers and insurance specialists, and will be supported by PwC’s onshore and offshore Technology and AI Centres of Excellence.

  • Leading the design and delivery of AI-enabled solutions, from problem definition through to deployment, across insurance pricing, reserving, capital modelling, finance transformation and risk analytics.

  • Shaping solution architectures for Generative AI and agentic systems, including decisions around data, models, orchestration, controls and integration into existing platforms.

  • Working hands-on with technical teams (engineers, data scientists, actuaries) to translate vision into buildable, testable and scalable solutions.

  • Embedding AI responsibly, ensuring solutions meet expectations around model risk management, explainability, auditability, security and governance.

This role is for you if:

description:
About the team

Join our expanding Audit team! We're investing in our people and tech to innovate our services and client approach. We prioritize quality, merging top-notch talent with advanced technology to foster trust. Our team-oriented culture encourages mutual growth through challenging tasks and open-mindedness. As part of our team, you'll lead small audit groups and handle complex tasks, auditing both Czech and international clients.

Job description & summary

As a Senior Associate, you’ll gain in-depth knowledge into how businesses run, gain direct access to internal stakeholders and clients and work with an unrivalled range of organisations we audit. A rewarding career path awaits, join our team to develop yourself as a professional and benefit from the wide range of development opportunities available at PwC. The responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Leverage your team and relationship management skills to ensure audit documentation, from start to finish, meets PwC and regulatory standards.

  • Perform diverse audit tasks, including issue identification, data analysis, and drawing informed conclusions.

  • Foster meaningful relationships and engage in insightful, challenging conversations during audits.

  • Delegate tasks for learning and coaching, optimizing audit efficiency.

  • Connect across PwC's teams and areas, managing differing views and consulting as needed.

  • Develop innovative solutions to enhance audit quality.

  • Prioritize team coaching, clear communication, and being fully present.

  • Manage engagements with high-level leadership, guiding junior members towards quality deliverables.

  • Participate in multi-disciplinary teams, enhancing skills and perspectives to serve varied clients.

  • Ensure high-quality development of engagement deliverables.

Requirements of the role

  • A university degree.

description:
Financial Services Customer-led Transformation Consultant - Manager

About the role

PwC’s Customer Financial Services Consulting Practice is passionate about our purpose which is to help our Financial Services clients to design and deliver impactful experiences for their customers and to create value for society.

Our team helps Financial services organisations build powerful, next-generation businesses using state-of-the-art digital technology to deliver compelling and innovative experiences to their customers. Our Financial Services Design practice is at the heart of our Customer Led Transformation offering, sitting at the intersection of business strategy, experience design, and digital technology.

We help our clients achieve sustainable growth by transforming and aligning their strategy, purpose and insight, their customer and employee experience, their operations, incentives and behaviours - all accelerated by the right technologies. We focus on transformation across all areas of our client’s businesses that interact with the customer/client including marketing, sales & distribution, service, client / broker relationship management, underwriting and pricing.

We are on the lookout for individuals who can help us design and deliver the future of digital banking and wealth for our clients.

You will work alongside a range of our strategic alliance partners (Engine by Starling, Salesforce, Guidewire, Microsoft and others), gaining exposure to the latest in financial services technology and will have the opportunity to contribute to market-transforming programmes around the world.

What your day will look like:

  • Build a detailed understanding of digital solutions and work closely with Partners and Directors to identify and convert sales opportunities

  • Develop sales materials with a deep understanding of digital banking, wealth platforms, insurance and client needs

  • Competitor analysis and market analysis to form a view of the appropriate digital solutions for target markets and clients

  • Design new go-to-market propositions, based on your knowledge of the capabilities of the latest financial services platforms (incl. banking, wealth and insurance)

  • Design target-state customer journeys / service blueprints and work with designers to bring-to-life the future experience

  • Take ownership of a key domain as a product owner (e.g. onboarding, payments, customer service, AML & Fraud, quote and buy, claims, renewals ) and work with clients to understand how they can adopt out-of-the-box capabilities from leading platforms (e.g. Engine by Starling)

This role is for you if:

  • You have worked in client-facing roles, in a consulting role, or at a technology company (ideally in Financial Services) Product owner during implementation, leading teams of business analysts, UX / UI designers and engineers to design and deliver new digital customer and colleague experiences

  • You have experience of rapidly identifying client problems and presenting solutions in a structured and informative manner and you are inquisitive and like the detail of understanding how something does and should work

  • You have a technical aptitude and curiosity and the ability to be self-motivated in a highly autonomous environment, in a collaborative team

  • You have strong presentation and facilitation skills and you have attention to detail

  • You can adapt your communication style to different stakeholders (senior clients, technology vendors, engineering functions) and you are comfortable dealing with ambiguity

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: M&A Operations - Software - Technology - Senior Manager
description:
About the role

S& MA& Operations focuses on providing support for potential / actual M&A transactions and assists clients in all operational aspects of the transaction, pre and post deal, including:
  • Pre-deal value creation advisory (i.e. helping clients to prepare their business, or parts of their business for sale)
  • Buy and sell side operational due diligence (i.e. reviewing and reporting on the technology risks and value opportunities for the business)
  • Synergy development and review (i.e. helping to develop or providing an external independent review on the level of synergies available from putting two or more businesses together)
  • Carve out and divestment support (i.e. helping to develop the standalone operating model, one-off costs and standalone operating costs of a divestment)
  • Taking control and 100 day planning (i.e. helping our clients to safely take control of the business, manage risks and deliver ‘quick wins’ during the first 100 days of ownership)
  • Mergers & Acquisitions Integration (i.e. helping our clients protect and grow the value of an acquisition, develop a robust and realistic integration plan and then executing on it)
  • Post-acquisition performance improvement (i.e. reviewing where the value might lie in the business and how realistic and sustainable cost savings can be achieved)
​
What your days will look like:
We are looking for individuals who have industry experience with developing and implementing software platforms and who can help answer the following questions that are typically asked by clients when considering an investment in a technology business or one that is tech-enabled:
  • Is the platform well invested or will I need to spend cash in the short term to address ‘tech debt’?
  • Is the platform well designed and can it support the planned business growth (either through increased scale, acquisition or addressing adjacent markets / territories)?
  • Is the platform (and associated underlying infrastructure) robust and what are the implications in terms of uptime, availability and cost to serve?
  • Do the roadmap initiatives align with and support the business plan?
  • What is the competitive ‘moat’ when it comes to both features and functionality vs peers and the potential that others (such as AI) can address the same market at lower cost?
N.B. Whilst we expect candidates to be able to answer the questions above, we acknowledge and appreciate that candidates may not have experience in all areas (e.g. we expect some will have more experience with software vs infrastructure or product management vs software development).
This role is for you if:
You are a technology expert who currently operates in a technical role (i.e. product owner / manager, business analyst, scrum master (or equivalent) or development / UX) within a software / tech-enabled business.
Specific requirements
  • Have a broad technical understanding of product management and / or software development processes, concepts (especially in an agile environment) roadmaps and timelines;
  • Developed and executed a technology product strategy and vision;
  • Managed one or more development budgets and developed / evaluated R&D return on investments;
  • Planned new features and changes to a product (including research on use cases, market positioning and competitor analysis) and experience in business case creation, detailed functional specifications and wire-frames;
  • Prototyped and demonstrated new product ideas / features to stakeholders and built consensus for approval; and
  • A track record of developing and launching products, including customer implementation and / or supporting technical sales and support functions.

About the role:

You’ll be joining PwC’s Risk Line of Service, within our AI & Modelling team, working at the forefront of AI-enabled transformation in the insurance sector.

This role is for people who understand technology deeply enough to shape and execute a vision, not just talk about it. You will help insurance clients design, build and embed Generative AI, agentic and advanced analytics solutions across finance, actuarial, pricing, capital and risk functions, operating in an environment where technologies, architectures and regulatory expectations are evolving rapidly

As a Manager / Senior Manager, you will sit close to the technology: shaping solution architecture, guiding engineering and modelling teams, and ensuring that AI solutions are robust, scalable, explainable and fit for purpose in a regulated insurance environment. Leading the design and delivery of AI-enabled solutions, from problem definition through to deployment, across insurance pricing, reserving, capital modelling, finance transformation and risk analytics.

Shaping solution architectures for Generative AI and agentic systems, including decisions around data, models, orchestration, controls and integration into existing platforms.

Working hands-on with technical teams (engineers, data scientists, actuaries) to translate vision into buildable, testable and scalable solutions.

Navigating fast-moving technology landscapes, assessing emerging tools and approaches, and making informed trade-offs between innovation, risk, cost and time-to-value.

title: M&A Operations - Industrials & Services (I&S)- Senior Manager
description:
About the role

M&A Operations is a market-leading team within the Strategy& business unit in PwC Deals, supporting corporate and private equity clients through high-impact M&A and transformation engagements. Our work spans the full deal lifecycle, from pre-deal operational due diligence and value creation, through carve-out and divestment support, to post-deal integration, synergy development and performance improvement.

Within M&A Operations, the Industrial & Services (I&S) sector team works with clients across manufacturing, industrial products and services, business services, packaging, engineering and construction. We work closely alongside our Energy, Utilities & Resources (EU&R) team and advise on transactions ranging from mid-market deals to multi-billion-pound acquisitions, frequently working alongside top-tier private equity houses and global corporates.

What your days will look like:

  • Pre and post deal performance improvement using our proprietary Value Creation methodology; including identifying operational improvement levers e.g. site footprint consolidation, procurement efficiencies, back office rationalisation, supply chain optimisation, etc.
  • Supporting carve-outs and divestments to achieve viable standalone businesses; including advising on separation planning, execution, transition and optimisation e.g. Day 1 readiness, migration planning, TSA / LTA requirements, separation cost analysis, etc.
  • Providing buy and sell side Operational Due Diligence; including analysing the operations of a business along the value chain e.g. production, supply chain, support functions, Capex investment, etc.
  • Mergers and acquisitions integration support; including defining and executing the integration programme, and developing and reviewing operational synergies in combining the two businesses.
  • Assisting with other non-transactional products to support clients in maximising profitability e.g. zero based budgeting.

Across the engagements above, as a Senior Manager you will take overall responsibility for leading large complex projects, including scoping and shaping the approach to address our clients’ most critical operational challenges. You will be accountable for driving conclusions, reviewing and challenging team outputs, managing engagement risks and ensuring delivery meets both client expectations and PwC quality standards.

You will proactively manage client relationships as the main point of contact, working closely with Directors and Partners, and will play a key role in the financial management of engagements. You will lead, coach and develop junior team members, building high-performing teams and providing day-to-day leadership across projects.

In addition, you will be expected to take a proactive and leading role in business development, identifying opportunities with new and existing clients, owning proposals, and continuing to build your network.

This role is for you if:

  • Able to demonstrate a strong understanding of a function such as; engineering, operations, maintenance, procurement, supply-chain or manufacturing
  • Can quickly assess the performance of a business (or elements of it) and outline improvement opportunities based upon limited information and/ or interactions with Management
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage and communicate with senior business leaders

description:
About the team

Join our expanding Audit team! We're investing in our people and tech to innovate our services and client approach. We prioritize quality, merging top-notch talent with advanced technology to foster trust. Our team-oriented culture encourages mutual growth through challenging tasks and open-mindedness. As part of our team, you'll lead small audit groups and handle complex tasks, auditing both Czech and international clients.

About your manager

Zuzana Lisá is our Senior Manager in Assurance services with specialisation in audit of banks and other financial institutions. It is a great pleasure to work with Zuzka! She is an extra experienced person passionate about the development of her colleagues and recruitment of talented people.

Job description & summary

As a Senior Associate, you’ll gain in-depth knowledge into how businesses run, gain direct access to internal stakeholders and clients and work with an unrivalled range of organisations we audit. A rewarding career path awaits, join our team to develop yourself as a professional and benefit from the wide range of development opportunities available at PwC. The responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Leverage your team and relationship management skills to ensure audit documentation, from start to finish, meets PwC and regulatory standards.

  • Perform diverse audit tasks, including issue identification, data analysis, and drawing informed conclusions.

  • Foster meaningful relationships and engage in insightful, challenging conversations during audits.

  • Delegate tasks for learning and coaching, optimizing audit efficiency.

  • Connect across PwC's teams and areas, managing differing views and consulting as needed.

  • Develop innovative solutions to enhance audit quality.

  • Prioritize team coaching, clear communication, and being fully present.

  • Manage engagements with high-level leadership, guiding junior members towards quality deliverables.

  • Participate in multi-disciplinary teams, enhancing skills and perspectives to serve varied clients.

  • Ensure high-quality development of engagement deliverables.

Requirements of the role

  • A university degree.

  • At least 3 years’ auditing or accounting experience.

  • ACCA - either in progress, or an interest in starting.

  • English and Czech/Slovak language skills are essential.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to both facilitate team discussions and clearly present technical concepts and findings to external stakeholders.

  • Willingness and ability to work in a team.

Our Benefits and Fun

  • Opportunity to work full time or minimum 60% part time.

  • Concentrated experience and rapid career growth. It may sound like a platitude, but it really is.

  • Fair wages plus paid overtime.

  • Paid time off 20 + 5 days, 3 wellbeing days and 2 extra days off from the company at the end of the year.

  • High-end notebook and iPhone with unlimited data.

  • Benefit program with 45.000 points that you can use for holidays, education, food vouchers, sports (Multisport), health... Simply on what you enjoy.

  • Support for your education and development: paid ACCA certification and then the opportunity to become a member of the ACCA, but also training on project management, other business and digital skills (Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau) and many other training and workshops to further develop your personal and professional skills. We pay for technical certifications and the time you spend studying them.

  • Opportunity to work in the future at a foreign PwC office.

  • Extra-work activities

About the role:

We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Manager to join the Transfer Pricing team in any one of the following locations; London, Birmingham, East Midlands, Bristol, Cardiff, Manchester, Leeds, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Belfast or Aberdeen.


We can offer you a role at the heart of a thriving business where you can learn by participating in complex and challenging projects, develop your own portfolio of clients and share in the resulting success of the business.


Work within the Transfer Pricing Team is mainly project based and will involve working with multinational companies.The nature of the work is very varied and includes involvement with all types of intercompany transactions including products, services, IP and debt.

What your days will look like:

  • Managing transfer pricing risk, planning, and implementation for clients.

  • Coordinating European and global transfer pricing engagements with specialists.

  • Supporting business changes and value chain transformations, including APAs and tax audits.

  • Managing client portfolios, relationships, and financial/risk aspects of projects.

The role is for you if have:

  • Advised multinational clients on transfer pricing.

  • Devised innovative and practical solutions, sharing knowledge with team members.

  • Developed business through networking, referrals, and cross-selling other services.

  • Managed multiple projects and developed team members.

What you'll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.


We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: M&A Operations - Technology ( ERP ) Advisory Consultant - Manager
description:
About the role

PwC’s S& M&A Operations team assists both Corporate and Private Equity (PE) clients in a wide range of business critical operational and transformational challenges, driven by Merger and Acquisition (M&A) activity. We advise our clients on deals with values ranging from £50 million to over £100 billion and our clients include some of the most well-known brands and businesses in the world.

We have around 200 dynamic and friendly people from a wide range of backgrounds and disciplines. We recruit proactively from industry, consulting, private equity and audit to create a blend of relevant experience to support each transaction. We have a team of technology specialists with deep experience and are looking to enhance this team with individuals who can contribute to achieving our ambitious growth goals.


S& MA& Operations focuses on providing support for potential / actual M&A transactions and assists clients in all operational aspects of the transaction, pre and post deal, including:

  • Pre-deal value creation advisory (i.e. helping clients to prepare their business, or parts of their business for sale)

  • Buy and sell side operational due diligence (i.e. reviewing and reporting on the technology risks and value opportunities for the business)

  • Synergy development and review (i.e. helping to develop or providing an external independent review on the level of synergies available from putting two or more businesses together)

  • Carve out and divestment support (i.e. helping to develop the standalone operating model, one-off costs and standalone operating costs of a divestment)

  • Taking control and 100 day planning (i.e. helping our clients to safely take control of the business, manage risks and deliver ‘quick wins’ during the first 100 days of ownership)

  • Mergers & Acquisitions Integration (i.e. helping our clients protect and grow the value of an acquisition, develop a robust and realistic integration plan and then executing on it)

  • Post-acquisition performance improvement (i.e. reviewing where the value might lie in the business and how realistic and sustainable cost savings can be achieved)

​

This role is for you if have:

  • Broad operational experience in terms of how ERP and ERP connected applications work together with business functions.

  • Real-world experience of ERP scoping, selection, design and implementation, ideally within the context of a transaction or a transaction-related event.

  • Comfort around IT and operational analysis to quickly understand the core IT, operational and back-office processes and their associated costs to the business.

  • Proficiency in creating detailed IT cost models and budgets, interpreting data, and performing scenario analysis.

Business strategy and planning

Owning and leading a defined part of the business structure including being the first point of contact for the leadership team for the component parts of that business.

title: Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Manager
description:
About the role:

We are seeking a Manager to join our Risk and Resilience team to focus on Enterprise Risk Management. If you would like to work with the senior management teams of some of the UK’s leading non-financial services companies, have strong problem solving skills, intellectual agility and can build deep and productive relationships, our practice could be the right opportunity for you.

You’ll work across a diverse range of well-known clients and have the opportunity to build experience designing and implementing risk management frameworks to help Boards identify, assess and manage the most significant risks in their organisation.

What your days will look like:

  • Developing bespoke Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and resilience frameworks and processes
  • Conducting risk identification interviews and facilitating risk assessment workshops, including at executive management levels
  • Developing key risk indicator suites
  • Practical articulation of risk appetite
  • Design of risk reporting templates and dashboards
  • Conducting risk analytics, such as horizon scanning, scenario and strategic risk analysis etc.
  • Delivering impactful risk management training
  • Providing on-going risk monitoring support
  • Managing and delivering assignments
  • Working as part of a team or independently depending on the size of the assignment
  • Developing and managing client relationships
  • Identifying and developing client opportunities
  • Partial and full-time client secondments
  • Providing input into the development of PwC’s Risk and Resilience propositions

The role is for you if:

We're looking for motivated, passionate and enthusiastic individuals who will relish the opportunity to work in a growing team, with a portfolio of varied assignments and with significant possibilities to progress within the firm. The successful applicant will have practical experience, ideally gained within a large consultancy or client organisation.

  • Highly confident and resilient, comfortable asserting yourself with senior clients (Executive and Board level)
  • Strong technical enterprise risk management knowledge (i.e. 4 years + experience) and proven ability developing and implementing practical ERM processes and frameworks in non-FS businesses
  • Knowledge of prevailing corporate governance requirements
  • Solid financial and commercial acumen and understanding
  • Excellent presentation skills and experience planning and facilitating workshops / risk exercises with senior level audiences
  • Robust diligence and ability to pay close attention to detail, including impeccable report-writing skills
  • Familiarity with common risk analysis techniques, understanding of scenario modelling etc.
  • Working knowledge of ERM data and reporting (e.g. maintaining KRI packs, building/refreshing simple dashboards, and producing trend/outlier commentary to support risk reviews)
  • Awareness of GenAI/LLM applications in risk management
  • Ability to innovate and think laterally
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills with ability to build trust and rapport with diverse internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects
  • Proven team management skills, including coaching and development of junior resources
  • Ability to work as part of a team and independently with little management oversight
  • Commercially focused and strong business development skills

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

These include flexible working, a hybrid office/client/home model, private medical cover, access to a virtual GP, volunteering days and a strong focus on wellbeing, inclusion and development.

description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Architect at Senior Manager level to join PwC’s M&A Technology team within Strategy& Operations. This role focuses on advising clients across the deal lifecycle — from pre-deal Technology Due Diligence (Tech DD) through to post-deal separation and integration planning including IT blueprint design.

You will lead architecture thinking, shape client recommendations, and oversee delivery of technology strategies, target architectures, and cost models across all IT domains (applications, data, infrastructure, and security).

​

What your days will look like:

Pre-deal (Technology Due Diligence)

  • Lead assessments of target company technology landscapes, including applications, infrastructure, data, and IT operating models
  • Identify key risks, technical debt, and value creation opportunities to inform deal decisions
  • Provide clear, commercially grounded insights for investment committees and senior stakeholders

Post-deal (Separation & Integration)

  • Define target-state Enterprise Architecture for integrations or standalone entities
  • Lead development of technology blueprints and transition architectures across all IT domains
  • Oversee data separation, migration, and application disentanglement strategies
  • Shape TSA (Transitional Service Agreement) design, including scope, duration, and exit planning

Cost & Value Analysis

  • Lead development of standalone cost models, including run-rate IT costs and operating models
  • Oversee estimation of one-off separation or integration costs
  • Identify and quantify synergies, stranded costs, and optimisation opportunities
  • Translate architecture decisions into clear commercial implications

​This role is for you if:

  • Act as a trusted advisor to CIOs, CTOs, and senior business stakeholders
  • Lead multi-disciplinary teams across deals and transformation engagements
  • Drive high-quality client deliverables, proposals, and thought leadership
  • Strong experience in Enterprise Architecture across multiple domains
  • Proven track record in M&A, carve-outs, separations, or integrations
  • Experience in Technology Due Diligence and/or IT strategy
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience building and interpreting cost models
  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms, enterprise systems, and data architectures
  • Experience within a consulting or deals environment
  • Familiarity with Private Equity clients and transaction lifecycles
  • Knowledge of architecture frameworks such as TOGAF

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

Du bliver en del af et stærkt team med mere end 65 dygtige kolleger og af PwC’s Deals-forretning, hvor vi hjælper kunder med at gennemføre opkøb, frasalg og strategiske beslutninger. Analysere finansielle data, identificere centrale value drivers, risici og red flags samt omsætte analyser til klare anbefalinger. Som PwC’er får du en Career Coach, som følger din udvikling tæt og hjælper dig med at skabe et balanceret karriereforløb, der tager højde for dine ambitioner, kompetencer og personlige behov. title: (Senior) Consultant Accounting & Reporting Advisory (w/m/d)
description: Du willst mit Deiner Expertise unseren Bereich Accounting Advisory Services weiterentwickeln? B. von HGB auf IFRS. Zudem unterstützt Du bei der Einführung neuer Rechnungslegungsstandards, der Erstellung von Jahres- und Konzernabschlüssen sowie bei Audit-Readiness-Projekten. Kapitalmarkt- & Transaktionsprojekte : Du wirkst aktiv bei IPOs, Kapitalerhöhungen und Anleiheemissionen mit und übernimmst die Erstellung und Prüfung prospektspezifischer Finanzinformationen (z. B. Pro-Forma-Finanzinformationen, Carve-out- und Combined Financial Statements). Darüber hinaus begleitest Du die Einführung kapitalmarktfähiger Reportings sowie Post-Merger-Integrationen und berätst im Rahmen von Enforcementverfahren. Projektleitung & Teamführung : Du übernimmst Verantwortung durch die Leitung kleinerer Projektteams und die aktive Mitarbeit an komplexen Themen der nationalen und internationalen Rechnungslegung. Mandantenberatung & Branchenvielfalt : Du betreust Mandant:innen aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen – u. a. Diversified Industries, Automotive, Consumer & Industrial Markets, Communication & Entertainment, Private Equity sowie Start-ups – und bist zentrale Ansprechperson für bilanzielle Fragestellungen im Rahmen von Unternehmenstransaktionen.
description_en: Would you like to further develop our Accounting Advisory Services area with your expertise? Then you can get involved here: Accounting, Conversion & Reporting: You will advise our interdisciplinary teams and clients on the introduction and application of international accounting principles (IFRS, US GAAP) as well as on conversion projects, e.g. B. from HGB to IFRS. You will also support the introduction of new accounting standards, the preparation of annual and consolidated financial statements, and audit readiness projects. Capital market & transaction projects: You will be actively involved in IPOs, capital increases and bond issues and will be responsible for the preparation and review of prospectus-specific financial information (e.g. pro forma financial information, carve-out and combined financial statements). In addition, you will support the introduction of capital market-ready reporting and post-merger integrations and advise on enforcement proceedings. title: Experienced Quant Developer
description:
About the Role:

As a quant developer within the team, you will direct the architecture, extension and maintenance of our Python codebase that performs valuation of financial instruments. This is an individual contributor role that requires expertise in both the mathematical modelling of financial instruments, across asset classes, and python software engineering.

What your days will look like:

  • Maintenance and extension of an existing codebase, written primarily in Python with .Net components which maps/transforms trade static data between various formats: XML, JSON, CSV, Excel, etc.
  • Extend code base through addition of :
    • new derivative valuation and risk models
    • updates and improvements to user interfaces
    • other add hoc incremental features
  • Maintain and extend a RESTful API server application
  • Maintenance and extending a internal model base and help the team on-board third party provided models and artificial intelligence.
  • Lead in discussions to help drive software architecture/design.
  • Provide support in estimating clients financial instrument valuations (private credit, debt and derivative), across a wide range of instrument types.

  • Advanced experience and knowledge of Python software development in industry or academia
  • Degree in computer science, engineering, physics, or mathematics or equivalent work experience . This includes international candidates who qualify through experience in their home country.
  • Experience working on large codebases
  • A deep understanding of derivative pricing including the related XVAs
  • Theoretical understanding of and hands-on experience in developing mathematical models
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail but tempered with an ability to think laterally.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to present complex issues in a clear and articulate way to a non-technical audience.
  • Familiarity with software engineering best practices.
  • Familiarity with source control (ideally Git).

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions. Our team of forensic professionals helps clients in difficult situations related to all kinds of fraud and employee misconduct. By combining data analytics, computer forensics, financial and investigative expertise with cutting-edge technology, we advise multinational corporates across sectors and countries that are involved in corporate investigations into fraud, corruption or other wrongdoing.

Joining our team as a Manager (or experienced Senior Consultant), you will be part of the CEE (Central and Eastern Europe) Forensic Technology team, working across a diverse portfolio of forensic data analytics, eDiscovery, complex investigations, compliance reviews and crisis response throughout the EMEA region, in collaboration with global colleagues and leading law firms.

About your Team Leader

Jakub Javorský is the head of PwC’s CEE Forensic Technology team, with 16 years of experience in fraud investigations and fraud risk prevention. He values a strong, close-knit team, positive motivation, continuous upskilling, and multidisciplinary collaboration.

Job description & summary

  • • Lead end-to-end forensic data analytics projects, extracting and analyzing transactional data from ERP systems, payment platforms, and other enterprise sources.

  • Design and automate forensic workflows and data processing scripts using Python, SQL, Alteryx, and Databricks to streamline client deliverables and accelerate insights.

  • Manage digital forensics (DFIR) engagements, including forensic data collections from laptops, mobile devices, servers, and databases. Oversee eDiscovery projects using RelativityOne and other leading platforms.

  • Advise clients on complex matters such as employee fraud, intellectual property theft, and third-party risk management.

  • Manage economics of individual projects, manage internal risk management and independence checks.

  • Mentor and supervise team members, manage stakeholder expectations, and translate complex technical findings into clear, outcome-focused reports for diverse audiences.

  • Communicate directly with clients and other stakeholders, ensuring secure and defensible outcomes.

  • Uphold the highest standards of integrity, professionalism, and personal accountability.

Requirements of the role

  • 5+ years of experience in forensic data analytics or risk analytics, ideally within a Big Four firm, consultancy, or large corporate forensic environment.

  • Strong proficiency in SQL (T-SQL, PL/SQL) and advanced Python programming for data extraction, analysis, and automation.

  • Expertise with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Qlik, or Power BI, and experience with Databricks.

  • Working knowledge of Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Natural Language Processing.

  • Ability to work under tight deadlines and adapt with flexibility.

  • Fluency in English required; Czech or Slovak language skills are a plus.

  • Ability to travel for work freely and on short notice within EU.

  • Applicants must be authorized to work and travel in the EU without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Nice to have, but not required skills

  • Experience conducting financial crime, employee fraud, IP theft, or data breach investigations, including sanctions screening and regulatory compliance.

  • Experience conducting forensic data analytics investigations, sanction screenings, automated 3rd party due diligence or similar.

title: Transport Consulting - Senior Manager
description:
About the Role:

The UK transport sector is undergoing once-in-a-generation reform — from rail transformation and devolution to major capital investment, digitalisation, data-led decision making and workforce change. We help our clients navigate this complexity, design better operating models, and deliver transformation that improves outcomes for passengers, freight, places and the economy.

We are a highly motivated, capable, collaborative, diverse and caring team. We have grown significantly in recent years and have welcomed a wealth of talented individuals to the organisation. However, we have bold ambitions and see an even greater opportunity in the market. We are looking for more brilliant people to join our brilliant team. As a Senior Manager you’ll work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive consulting and industry experience, leading projects to help our clients solve complex business issues and deliver enterprise wide transformation

What your days will look like:

  • Managing the design and delivery of iconic, technology-enabled transformation programmes for some of the largest public sector clients in the UK.

  • Contributing to the development of the market for large scale transformation delivery – identifying and researching opportunities to work with new / existing clients and helping to bring new offers to the market.

  • Helping to grow our multi-specialism Enterprise Transformation team, developing the tools and techniques that will help our clients transform their ways of working and secure better outcomes for the people and places they serve.

  • Leading on the management of engagement economics, risk and issue management, performance, project and programme management.

  • Owning senior stakeholder relationships to support the delivery of engagements and build your own networks in the market.

This role is for you if:

  • You have experience of scoping and leading transformation programmes in the Transport Sector.

  • You have experience of operating model design and implementation / transformation programme management / transformation communications and engagement / change and adoption management.

  • You have experience of interpreting clients’ strategic, operational and external drivers for change, gaining respect, building trust and inspiring stakeholders and ability to forecast costs and manage to programme timelines and budget.

  • You understand of transformation opportunities in the Transport sector and what are the general factors to be considered while designing and implementing complex transformation programmes.

  • You have experience in developing requirements across process, people, organisation, technology and information

  • You have the ability to articulate the business benefits of adopting digital and cloud technologies as part of wider transformations

  • Successful track record of delivery leadership in Government and Transport sectors as a consultant or working directly in the sector.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions. We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

Einblicke - Zu unseren Mandant:innen zählen vermögende Privatpersonen und Unternehmerfamilien weltweit, unabhängig von Branche, Größe oder Rechtsform. Deine Tätigkeit fokussiert sich auf Beratung im Steuer- und Zivilrecht.

Verantwortung - Du bist verantwortlich für den reibungslosen Ablauf der Mandate, insbesondere bei der Steueroptimierung. Dazu gehört die Begleitung von Verhandlungen sowie die Ausarbeitung von Verträgen, Einsprüchen, Klagen, Gutachten und wissenschaftlichen Arbeiten.

Vielfältigkeit - Dein Aufgabenbereich umfasst die Erbschaftsteuerplanung, ertragsteuerliche Optimierung und steuerliche Planung bei Zu- und Wegzügen. Du entwirfst Gesellschafts-, Ehe- und Erbverträge sowie Testamente.   • Dein Studium der Wirtschafts- oder Rechtswissenschaften, den Abschluss zur/zum Finanzwirt:in oder einen vergleichbaren Abschluss hast du mit (sehr) guten Ergebnissen erzielt.

  • Du verfügst im Idealfall bereits über Kenntnisse im Steuer-, im Gemeinnützigkeits- sowie insbesondere im Erbschaftsteuer- und Bewertungsrecht.

  • Im Kontakt mit unseren Mandanten kannst du auf sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse zurückgreifen.

Flexibilität – In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. title: Business Change Lead - SAP Enterprise Resource Planning(ERP) - Manager
description:
About the role:

Shape the future of business transformation with PwC

At PwC, we're growing one of the leading SAP consulting practices in our global network. Our multidisciplinary teams bring together deep SAP expertise across Finance, Supply Chain, Human Capital and Business Change, complemented by Data, AI and Cloud capabilities, working alongside specialists from across PwC to help clients deliver complex business transformation programmes.

Our team partners with some of the world's leading organisations to deliver complex, multinational SAP transformation programmes spanning Finance, Supply Chain, Human Capital and business adoption. We work across the full transformation lifecycle, from strategy and business case through solution design, implementation and business adoption, helping clients realise long-term value from their SAP investments.

As our practice continues to grow, we're looking for people who are excited by the opportunity to develop their consulting careers whilst taking on increasing responsibility. We're looking for individuals who enjoy solving complex business challenges, building trusted client relationships, leading workstreams and developing the leadership skills that will shape the next stage of their career.

Our people have the opportunity to work on some of the world's largest SAP transformation programmes, learn from experienced leaders and build long-term relationships with global organisations. We're looking for people who want to grow with our practice, develop into future leaders and help shape the next phase of our success.

Whether you're leading a workstream, supporting a major client transformation or helping bring innovative AI-enabled solutions to market, you'll be encouraged to challenge conventional thinking, embrace new technologies and make a meaningful contribution from day one.

If you're looking for a career where you can combine deep SAP expertise with continuous learning, leadership development and business transformation, we'd love to hear from you.

What your days will look like:

title: GHS Service Manager
description:
About the team

PwC IT Services Limited provides shared technology services to the PwC network of member firms in a secure, legally compliant, efficient, and transparent manner.

The Service Manager will be a member of the Global Hosting Services (GHS) Service Management & Compliance team and comes to the organization having experience in IT Service Management with a background in IT infrastructure and cloud services.

The Global Hosting Service provides and operates highly available 24/7 IaaS and PaaS across multiple Public Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) and global on-premises hosting centers.

Job description & summary

The GHS Service Manager plays a critical role within the Global Hosting Services (GHS) Service Management team, ensuring that new cloud services and major enhancements are thoroughly prepared for operational readiness. This role bridges Product, Engineering, Operations, and global stakeholders to translate business requirements into operational models, validate technical and process readiness, and facilitate seamless service adoption into the GHS support framework.

The role combines service delivery, operational readiness, data‑driven decision support, and customer consultation to ensure that new services are delivered efficiently, securely, and in alignment with PwC standards.

To excel in this role, a Service Manager needs to demonstrate excellent communication abilities, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. They must also be capable of demonstrating influence outside the reach of their direct team, ensuring cohesive and efficient operations across various departments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive end‑to‑end operationalization of new cloud products and major enhancements, ensuring they meet GHS Product Acceptance Checklist (PAC) requirements (documentation, KT, access, monitoring, support models, SLAs/SLOs)

  • Translate stakeholder, product, and engineering requirements into actionable operational specifications, ensuring clarity across all teams

  • Maintain Service Level Objective (SLO) documents to clearly define customer responsibilities while ensuring the support scope remains consistent within GHS

  • Conduct risk, impact, and supportability assessments for new services

  • Document requirements and route requests to relevant GHS teams; track progress through operational readiness milestones

  • Participate in daily/weekly project Scrums and regularly report the progress

  • GHS adherence to PwC Technology ITSM processes

Requirements of the role

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Systems, Management Information Systems or equivalent experience

  • 7 years in IT and 3 years in IT Service Management

  • Knowledge of cloud fundamentals, architectural principles, and concepts.

  • General knowledge and experience in Information Technology, experience in IT infrastructure and cloud fundamentals

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills

  • SAFe or Agile framework

  • Cloud infrastructure fundamentals (Azure, AWS, GCP)

  • Experience in multiple ITIL processes

  • Establishing KPIs and driving continual service improvements

  • Analytical ability, exercising professional skepticism, strong judgment and leadership skills, and the ability to work effectively with Leadership and team members.

  • Ability to identify and communicate complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Ability to take abstract ideas from inception to completion

  • Agile, open-minded, ready to bring and implement innovative ideas

  • Ability to work in a remote, geographically dispersed environment

  • Efficient in self-management and independent task management

  • Having experience with ServiceNow is highly beneficial

Our Benefits and Fun

  • Stable, but challenging working environment providing plenty of opportunities for your continuous professional growth.

  • Fair salary plus annual bonus corresponding with your performance.

  • Paid time off 30 days, 3 well being days and 2 extra

description: Deloitte is looking for talented and experienced professionals to join our SAP-team in Sweden. title: Guidewire Technical Lead – Senior Manager
description:
About the role

The Guidewire Technical Lead plays a pivotal role in driving the successful implementation, configuration, and optimisation of Guidewire solutions within an organisation. The Technical Lead brings deep expertise in Guidewire modules (such as PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, or BillingCenter), facilitates requirements gathering, and leads Technical design and delivery.

As a Technical Lead, the role is there to ensure the solution capabilities in our Guidewire programmes are the right capabilities to meet customer outcomes, articulated in the right way to align to Guidewire solution standards and best practise.

This role needs to look forward, working with customer on coming Guidewire ski releases and ensuring our projects are aware and informed of what to plan in and working with customers to ensure they are aware of the value in each release as it maps to this business needs.

This role involves Technical and technical leadership, mentoring of others, and collaborating with stakeholders/customers to deliver scalable, high-quality insurance applications.

What will your day look like:

  • Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with business users, project managers, and technical teams to understand requirements, translate business needs into Technical specifications, and ensure alignment throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Solution Design: Lead the Technical design of Guidewire solutions, ensuring that configurations and customisations meet business objectives and comply with industry best practices. This will be across several workstreams ensuring end to end designs are robust and well rounded.

  • Supporting the Business Analysis teams on requirements Gathering, especially where the capabilities needed need customisation as opposed to configuration. Facilitate workshops and interviews to gather, analyse, and document business and Technical requirements related to Guidewire implementations.

  • Configuration Oversight: Oversee the configuration of Guidewire modules, working closely with technical teams to ensure Technical requirements are accurately implemented.

  • Issue Resolution: Act as the primary point of escalation for Technical issues, troubleshooting problems, and working with cross-Technical teams to resolve them efficiently.

  • Documentation: Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation, including Technical specifications, process flows, and user guides.

This job is for you if:

  • Extensive experience in Guidewire implementations (PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, and/or BillingCenter).

  • Strong understanding of insurance industry processes and terminology and proven ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills and experience with Agile and Waterfall project methodologies.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail and ability to lead and motivate a team of Technical analysts.

  • Background in business process reengineering or change management and demonstrated adaptability in fast-paced project environments and proactive approach to identifying and resolving potential challenges.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

description:

Our Insurance & Asset & Wealth Management Finance Transformation Advisory team works with insurers and retirement providers to modernise finance functions, strengthen financial reporting and respond to significant accounting change. The team is collaborative and multidisciplinary, bringing together finance, actuarial, data and technology specialists to deliver integrated solutions.

title: Internship - Finanční Due Diligence (M&A)
description: To nejdůležitější v pár větách V případě velkých transakcí můžeme stát jak na straně kupujícího, tak i na straně prodávajícího. Pokud se tedy některý z našich klientů chystá na velkou transakci, stojíme po jeho boku a zjišťujeme, zda například ve společnosti, kterou se chystá koupit, nejsou skryté problémy či rizika do budoucnosti. Při takových obchodech musí klient znát sebemenší detail a pochopit příběh firmy. Klientovi připravíme předinvestiční prověrku, zanalyzujeme finanční a obchodní informace a upozorníme ho na případná rizika spojená s transakcí. Finanční analýzy a výkazy, předinvestiční prověrky a práce v Excelu je gró naší práce. Tvoje role v týmu „V našem týmu budeš od začátku pracovat na reálných zakázkách, při kterých se dostaneš k opravdu zajímavým transakcím, za kterými stojí velcí investoři. Projektů máme za sebou spoustu a díky tomu ti můžeme předat naše zkušenosti a know-how. Přidej se k nám a staň se jedním z odborníků, kteří stojí za transakcemi a investicemi, které hýbou nejen českou ekonomikou. Získáš u nás rozhled. Budeš se učit od zkušenějších kolegů, dostaneš k ruce counselora a porosteš i osobnostně. Internship je jen začátek. Máme propracovaný systém, postupně budeš přebírat čím dál víc zodpovědnosti a po ukončení studia ti dáme rádi příležitost stát se Junior konzultantem. Začátky můžou být náročné, ale bude to stát za to!“ - Josef Dobřichovský, Partner, tým Due Diligence Co je pro nás důležité Víme, že jsi teprve na začátku kariéry. Ale tady je několik věcí, které jsou pro tuhle práci podstatné. Studuješ navazující magisterské studium (ideálně se zaměřením na finance) Pokud kromě angličtiny a češtiny/slovenštiny ovládáš i němčinu velmi to uvítáme. Orientuješ se v oblasti financí a účetnictví. Máš zápal pro věc. Budeš se neustále učit nové věci. A hlavně to musí být dobrý match. Budeš s kolegy trávit hodně času, tak si musíte sednout lidsky. Jak se ti odměníme Nástupní mzda 230Kč/hodinu od 1.10. (do 30.9. nabízíme 200Kč/hodinu s navýšením od října) , smlouvu na HPP (zkrácený úvazek) a k tomu benefity, které ti zaručeně udělají radost. Tady je pár z nich: Volno : Placená dovolená dle odpracovaných hodin. Odměna za doporučení kandidáta : Získej od 10 do 70 tisíc Kč za doporučení nového kolegy. Benefitní body v Cafeterii můžeš utratit podle sebe. Třeba si pořídit Multisport kartu, nakoupit dárky nebo si užít odpočinek na Slevomatu. Profesionální rozvoj : U nás se neustále učíš a rozvíjíš své schopnosti. Nabízíme ti jedinečný program profesního rozvoje a pestrou paletu kurzů v naší learningové mapě. Můžeš využívat přístup ke vzdělávacímu portálu Udemy.com a k jazykovým kurzům. Naši kolegové ti poskytnou podporu v podobě counselingu a interního koučinku. iPhone 13 i k soukromému používání. Slevy pro zaměstnance : Užij si skvělé zvýhodněné nabídky na širokou škálu služeb. Využij slevy ve Fruitisimo, Sushi Time, optice, fitness centru BodyBody a na dalších místech. Zdraví a péče : Získej přístup k rychlému a pohodlnému online poradenství uLékaře.cz od kvalifikovaných lékařů. Navíc ti zaplatíme i životní pojištění. Týmová spolupráce a zábava : U nás nejde jen o práci, ale také o zábavu a týmovou spolupráci. Nejen po úspěšném dokončení velkých projektů tě čekají odměny ve formě večeří, bowlingu, firemních večírků a dalších skvělých akcí, které posilují naši týmovou atmosféru. Můžeš se také zapojit do CSR aktivit. Co tě čeká po odeslání přihlášky Prvním krokem jsou vstupní testy , které vyplníš doma. Budou celkem tři: z angličtiny, z numeriky a logického myšlení a z češtiny. Na tyto testy budeš mít týden a budeme rádi, když je stihneš vyplnit včas. Pokud projdeš vstupními testy, budou tě čekat testy Due Diligence . Ty se píší osobně u nás v kancelářích ve Florentinu. Čeká tě test z financí a účetnictví, test z excelu a test z angličtiny. Následovat bude osobní pohovor s naší recruiterkou Karolínou a s kolegy z týmu. Tam se dozvíme detaily o tobě a ty o EY a o týmu. Kolegové se tě zeptají na cvičný příklad z praxe a trochu naťukneme i teorii. Poslední kolo je s Josefem Dobřichovským , který se s tebou bude chtít taky vidět osobně. Pro tebe jen plus, protože potkáš šéfa týmu Due Diligence. Výběrové řízení sice už začalo, ale k nám se můžeš připojit kdykoliv. Na termínu nástupu se domluvíme podle tvých potřeb. Těšíme se na tebe!

title: ER Service Delivery Advisor, Senior Associate
description:
Job Requirements

About the role:

This role sits within the ERPA team with responsibility for managing formal employee relations and case management activities. The ERPA Advisor provides expert advice to the business on employee relations matters, handling non-complex cases across misconduct, performance and health and wellbeing. Working firmwide across allocated business areas, the role requires building strong stakeholder relationships with People Consultants and wider People Lifecycle teams.


The advisor applies sound knowledge of employee relations policies to deliver pragmatic, commercially focused guidance that enables effective issue resolution. Experience of case management systems is beneficial, alongside a willingness to develop technical skills to support accurate recording and tracking of cases.


What your days will look like:

  • Leading end-to-end disciplinary and investigation processes, including interviews, evidence review and report writing across conduct, performance and risk matters
  • Providing expert employee relations advice across conduct, performance, health and wellbeing, including handling informal queries and policy guidance
  • Managing health and wellbeing cases, including occupational health referrals, income protection and performance support (e.g. PIPs and appeals)
  • Producing high-quality documentation and maintaining accurate case records in Navex and ServiceNow, while ensuring GDPR compliance and supporting projects and process improvements

This role is for you if you:

  • Bring a customer-focused mindset with strong analytical skills, able to quickly interpret multiple data sources and provide clear, accurate insights
  • Thrive both independently and as part of a team, using initiative and attention to detail to deliver high-quality outcomes
  • Are curious and proactive, challenging existing approaches and embracing change, innovation and continuous improvement
  • Are confident using digital tools and systems, with awareness of GDPR/compliance and a willingness to develop expertise in platforms such as Navex, ServiceNow, Tableau or Alteryx

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Digital & Cyber Resilience – Senior Manager
description:
About the role:

As part of PwC’s Risk business, the Digital & Cyber Resilience team supports organisations in building resilience across increasingly complex technology environments. With hybrid cloud, on‑prem infrastructure, evolving cyber threats and expanding regulatory requirements, resilience is now a strategic business imperative.

In this Senior Manager role, you’ll work at the intersection of technology, cyber security and operational resilience, helping clients design and embed “resilience by design” approaches. You’ll support organisations to prepare for, respond to and recover from cyber incidents, major technology failures and large‑scale disruption scenarios, ensuring their critical services remain secure, available and recoverable.

What your days will look like:

  • Leading and shaping complex digital and cyber resilience engagements across multiple client sectors
  • Solutioning and structuring work across cyber security, IT architecture, operational resilience and business continuity
  • Advising senior stakeholders on recovery strategy, resilience maturity and regulatory expectations
  • Supporting and overseeing disaster recovery testing, scenario exercises and resilience assessments
  • Translating technical risks into clear, business‑focused insights for boards and executive leaders
  • Mobilising, leading and developing teams, while driving high‑quality delivery and thought leadership

The role is for you if:

  • You bring deep experience across cyber security, IT operations and digital resilience
  • You have a strong technology and architecture background, spanning cloud, hybrid and on‑prem environments
  • You understand recovery planning, including DR testing, RTO/RPO design and crisis preparedness
  • You’re comfortable operating in a client‑facing, advisory role, influencing at senior and C‑suite level
  • You’re motivated by leadership, continuous learning and delivering impactful outcomes in a fast‑paced professional services environment

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

description:
Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Business Services suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Praktikant Government & Public Services (w/m/d).

Das erwartet dich

Industrie – Du unterstützt uns im Bereich Strategie- & Geschäftsentwicklung in der Industrie G&PS (Government & Public Services) für PwC Deutschland.

Geschäftsentwicklung – Im Rahmen des Business Developments wirst du Strategiepräsentationen vorbereiten, das Vertriebsreporting unterstützen und in das Monitoring der wichtigsten Erfolgskennzahlen eingebunden sein.

Content – Darüber hinaus wirkst du bei der Erstellung von Fachpublikationen für die B2B-Kommunikation tatkräftig mit.

Kommunikation – Die interne Kommunikation, u. a. Newsletter und interne Informationsportale, rundet deinen Tätigkeitsbereich ab.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du bist mindestens im 3. Semester deines Studiums der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, eins MINT-Studiengangs oder der Geistes- oder Politikwissenschaften mit wirtschaftlichem Nebenfach.

Kultur – Wir möchten, dass du dich bei uns wohl fühlst. Deshalb pflegen wir eine offene und moderne Unternehmens- sowie Führungskultur, in der wir geleistete Arbeit gemeinsam anerkennen und feiern.

Dabei gibt es keine Kernarbeitszeiten – im Rahmen der betrieblichen Anforderungen und arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, temporär in über 40 Ländern zu arbeiten.

Masterförderung – Durch unsere interne Academy, internationale Erfahrungen durch Secondments und kontinuierliches Mentoring entwickelst du dich stetig weiter. Darüber hinaus bieten wir die Möglichkeit einer Masterförderung für Examensmaster und Spezialisierungsmaster an.

title: Datový internship v Technology Consultingu
description:
Jaký bude tvůj tým

V oblasti technologického poradenství u PwC nejde jen o to být součástí velké firmy; jde o to vidět, jak věci fungují v různých společnostech. Obvykle jsme přímo v centru dění, pracujeme v projektových týmech, které zajišťují vše od návrhu po dodání skvělých, špičkových řešení v oblasti byznysu a technologií nejen v České republice. Neustále rozvíjíme své dovednosti, nejen prostřednictvím projektů pro klienty, ale také díky jiným zajímavým aktivitám. Máme šest úžasných komunit, kde se věnujeme tématům jako jsou Business Intelligence, New Technologies, Digital Strategies, , Self Mastery, SAP, Agile, ESG.

Na koho se můžeš spolehnout?

Tomáš Karas je senior manažer, který vede náš tým datových expertů a Business Intelligence projektů. Na projektech pracuje jako datový architekt a projektový manažer v jednom, a spolu se svými týmy pomáhá budovat velké datové sklady, případně využívá data ke zjednodušení a automatizaci procesů a ušetří tak našim klientům 1000 dní nudné operativní práce. Když nepracuje, můžete ho buď vidět s týmem někde po práci na skleničce, nebo se stará o malou domácí zoo, včetně tří dětí a asi 80 morčat z jejich rodinné farmy.

O čem bude tvoje role

Jsi studentem technické školy a zajímají tě data? Připoj se k nám a staň se datovým expertem. Budeme společně hledat klíčová data v rozsáhlých databázích. Naučíš se je efektivně čistit, vypočítat další odvozené informace a využívat je pro automatizaci firemních procesů. Díky tomu pomáháme našim klientům transformovat procesy a šetříme tisíce hodin manuální práce měsíčně.

  • Používáme nástroje jako Databricks, Snowflake, MS Fabric

  • Naučíš se reálné věci od zkušených analytiků a inženýrů

  • Možnost růstu na pozici architekta nebo seniorního inženýra

Co by ti nemělo chybět

  • Znalost SQL a ochota dále se v SQL vzdělávat

  • Silné analytické myšlení, komunikativnost a prezentační dovednosti

  • Zaměření na detail, přesnost a dochvilnost

  • Výhodou bude znalost v některých z těchto oblastí: Banking industry, Insurance industry, Data Warehousing, Data Lakehouse, Data modeling, Data mastering, Data quality, Batch integration, Real-time data integration, Cloud, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code

  • Znalost některých těchto technologií: Oracle, MSSQL, PostgeSQL, Teradata, Hadoop, Spark, Snowflake, Databricks, MS Fabric, BigQuery, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Airflow, Informatica, SSIS, SSRS, R, Scala, PySpark, Kafka, Pulsar, RabbitMQ

Čím Tě potěšíme my?

  • Na práci, která dává smysl a velké možnosti osobního rozvoje.

  • Férovou mzdu a benefit program s 15.000 body, který můžeš využít na dovolenou, vzdělávání, stravenky, sport, zdraví... Prostě na to, co tě baví.

  • Ultrabook a iPhone s neomezenými daty.

  • Podpora rozvoje a vzdělávání: školení obchodních a digitálních dovedností (např. Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau), průběžná školení a certifikace, např. Microsoft (Azure, PowerApps), projektové řízení (Prince2, PMI), řízení služeb (ITIL), agilní vývoj (Scrum, SAFe), DAMA, Salesforce, koučování a prezentační dovednosti a další.

  • Na Away Days jezdíme 2x ročně.

  • Každý měsíc máme TC statusy, na kterých si povíme, jak to vypadá na našich projektech a poté vyrazíme na společnou aktivitu (např. karaoke, indoor mini golf apod.)

Developing the careers of the teams working with and reporting to you and raising the profile of the team externally by expanding the network, including with external bodies.

Extensive experience of Microsoft D365 experience as a Solution Architect and senior/lead consultant

● Experience of Microsoft architecture design for custom Microsoft solutions

● Strong exposure to finance, supply chain and manufacturing and warehouse management processes implementation.

● Experience in architecting Microsoft integrations with third-party systems.

● Develop innovative solutions for our rapidly expanding client base across a range of industries.

title: Junior specialista finančního auditu
description:
Nastartuj kariéru u jednoho z největších globálních lídrů v auditu a poradenství a poznej, jak zevnitř fungují významné mezinárodní firmy. V PwC získáš zkušenosti, které tě posunou dál – ať už v auditu, financích nebo později v jiné oblasti byznysu. U nás začne tvůj profesní růst, který tě dovede až na vrchol.

Tvůj profesní růst začne od prvního dne

Staneš se členem jednoho z týmů v Kompetenčním centru, to znamená, že od prvního dne budeš pracovat po boku lidí, kteří tě budou podporovat a pomůžou ti ve tvém růstu. Fungujeme jako tým, takže se na každé zakázce můžeš spolehnout na zkušenější kolegy, kteří ti rádi poradí. Zakládáme si na otevřenosti – chyby bereme jako příležitost zlepšit se, ne něco, čeho se bát.

Co tě u nás čeká?

  • Intenzivní úvodní školení a mentoring – během několika týdnů tě naučíme, jak audit funguje od A do Z a seznámíme tě s moderními nástroji, které používáme v praxi.

  • Práce na skutečných zakázkách – budeš spolupracovat se zkušenými kolegy a podílet se na ověřování finančních výkazů a interních kontrol u významných klientů.

  • Různorodost oborů – od automotive přes bankovnictví až po další sektory, získáš komplexní přehled o firemních procesech.

  • Rozvoj komunikačních dovedností – naučíš se efektivně komunikovat s klienty i týmem a pracovat v dynamickém prostředí.

Koho hledáme?

Hledáme nového člena týmu, který se chce učit a rozvíjet. Nehledáme hotového auditora – to z tebe uděláme my. Potřebujeme člověka, který se nebojí zodpovědnosti, spolupracuje s ostatními a umí věci dotáhnout do konce.

Co je pro nás důležité:

  • Ukončená SŠ/VŠ ideálně ekonomického směru

  • Povědomí o účetnictví nebo auditu je výhodou, ne podmínkou.

  • Analytické myšlení: umíš rozložit problém na kroky, pracovat s daty a dojít k jasnému závěru.

  • Jazyky: mluvíš plynně česky/slovensky a angličtina je pro tebe běžnou součástí práce (mail, call, meeting). Němčina je velké plus, pokud tě lákají projekty s německy mluvícími klienty.

  • Týmovost i samostatnost: víš, kdy si věci nastudovat sám/sama a kdy říct o radu. Umíš přijmout i dát zpětnou vazbu s respektem a na rovinu.

  • Nevadí ti cestování, občas se podíváš mimo Ostravu – ber to jako šanci vidět, jak fungují různé firmy zblízka.

  • Můžeš nastoupit 7.9.2026.

title: Data Mesh Architect - Technology Consulting
description:
Join us at PwC Technology Consulting, where we blend business and technology! Be part of a team that crafts innovative solutions across Europe, diving into diverse company cultures and technologies. Our journey doesn't stop at client projects. Dive into our six knowledge-rich communities, from New Technologies to Digital Strategies and beyond. At PwC, it's not just about growing; it's about thriving and leading the tech revolution.

Ready for this adventure? Let's make tech history together!

About the team manager

Tomáš Karas is a senior manager who leads our team of data experts and business intelligence projects. On projects, he works as a data architect and project manager in one and, together with his teams, helps build large data warehouses, or uses data to simplify and automate processes, thus saving our clients 1000 days of boring operational work. When he is not working, you can either see him with the team somewhere after work for a drink, or he takes care of a small home zoo, including two children and about 80 guinea pigs from their family farm.

Job description & summary

As a Data Mesh Architect, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our clients data architecture frameworks with a strong emphasis on Data Mesh principles. Based in a collaborative team environment, your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Developing and maintaining data architecture frameworks that promote decentralized data ownership.
  • Implementing Data Mesh concepts to enhance scalability and data accessibility.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to align data strategies with business objectives.
  • Ensuring adherence to modern data governance practices and standards.
  • Analyzing data architecture needs and providing strategic recommendations.
  • Engaging with stakeholders to gather requirements and communicate architectural decisions.

Requirement of the role

  • University degree
  • At least 5 years of experience in data architecture and modeling
  • In-depth knowledge of Data Mesh concepts and implementation strategies.
  • Proficiency in modern data platforms and governance practices.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to manage stakeholder relationships effectively.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Our Benefits and Fun

  • Stable, but challenging working environment providing plenty of opportunities for your continuous professional growth.
  • Fair salary plus annual bonus
  • Paid time off 30 days, 3 wellbeing and 1 extra day off from the company at the end of the year.
  • High-end Ultrabook and iPhone with unlimited data.
  • Benefit program with 55.000 points that you can use for holidays, education, food vouchers, sports (Multisport), health... Simply on what you enjoy.
  • Support for your education and development: we offer business and digital training and many other training and workshops to further develop your personal and professional skills. We pay for technical certifications and the time you spend studying them.
  • Opportunity to work with foreign PwC offices, for example in the UK, DE, NL, USA, Canada and other countries
  • Extra-work activities and Away Days (team building, ski weekend, etc.).
  • You will develop your skills while having the support from the top-notch professionals in the team (also career coaching etc).

PwC is the largest audit team in the Czech Republic, but also law, tax, consulting and technology, data or forensic teams. Find out how easy it is to combine this knowledge when you're in the right place. With us, you will get the opportunity to see how business is done in large companies. We are part of an international network of companies with more than 364,000 colleagues in 151 countries.

At PwC, we create an inclusive work environment where everyone can be themselves and find their place and opportunity to develop. This year, we have successfully maintained the prestigious Equal Pay Certification, making us one of only four companies in the Czech Republic (and the only one from the Big 4) that demonstrably implements fair compensation practices regard
