description:
About the role

As a Technology Strategy and Innovation Leader you will be responsible for driving technology strategy and innovation within the Life, Retirement, and Pensions sector. You will lead the establishment of compelling go-to-market propositions by leveraging emerging technologies such as cloud computing, AI, and data analytics to differentiate offerings and meet evolving client demands. Working closely with senior technology leaders across the sector, including CTOs, you will foster collaborative partnerships and shape forward-thinking solutions that anticipate market trends. The role requires a strategic mindset combined with hands-on experience in large-scale technology transformations and operational excellence. You will be instrumental in building alliances with technology partners to broaden solution capabilities and delivering client engagements that set industry standards. The position offers a unique opportunity to influence a dynamic, evolving sector where technology meets business transformation.

What your days will look like:

  • Define and lead the execution of technology strategies aligned with market needs in the Life, Retirement, and Pensions sector.

  • Drive business development initiatives by identifying new opportunities and presenting compelling business cases.

  • Manage cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact technology solutions and thought leadership.

  • Strong relationship management skills with the ability to engage and influence senior technology leaders in this sector.

  • Demonstrated success in driving business growth through innovative go-to-market propositions.

  • Ability to analyse market trends and translate insights into actionable technology solutions.

  • Experience in managing multi-disciplinary teams and complex client engagements.

  • Strong commercial acumen with experience in origination and presenting data-driven business cases.

Dein Manager

Liviu Chirita ist als Partner verantwortlich für PwC CEE Financial Crime Advisory. Was wird deine Rolle im Team sein?

Dein Projekt wird im Bereich der Finanzkriminalität angesiedelt sein. Als Teil der Abteilung Finanzkriminalität, die unter anderem Warnungen über verdächtige Transaktionen prüft und untersucht, wirst du dazu beitragen, den Missbrauch des Finanzsystems zur Geldwäsche zu verhindern.

Deine Aufgabe wird es sein, einschlägige Warnungen zu untersuchen, Kunden, Transaktionen und andere relevante Umstände zu überprüfen.   • Ein Vollzeitvertrag für die Dauer deines Praktikums mit allen Mitarbeitervorteilen

  • Wir stellen dir für die ersten Monate eine Wohnung zur Verfügung oder helfen bei der Wohnungssuche

  • High-End-Ultrabook und iPhone mit unbegrenztem Datenvolumen

  • Bonusprogramm mit 30.000 Punkten, die du für Urlaub, Bildung, Essensgutscheine, Sport (Multisport), Gesundheit... verwenden kannst – je nachdem was dir Spaß macht

title: SAP Technical Architect / Technology Lead - Senior Manager
description:
About the role:

Shape the future of business transformation with PwC
Business transformation is evolving faster than ever. AI, automation and intelligent technologies are reshaping how organisations operate, and clients are looking for trusted advisors who can combine deep SAP expertise with consulting, business change and innovation to deliver lasting outcomes.

At PwC, we're growing one of the leading SAP consulting practices in our global network. Our multidisciplinary teams bring together deep SAP expertise across Finance, Supply Chain, Human Capital and Business Change, complemented by Data, AI and Cloud capabilities, working alongside specialists from across PwC to help clients deliver complex business transformation programmes.

Our team partners with some of the world's leading organisations to deliver complex, multinational SAP transformation programmes spanning Finance, Supply Chain, Human Capital and business adoption. We work across the full transformation lifecycle, from strategy and business case through solution design, implementation and business adoption, helping clients realise long-term value from their SAP investments.

As our practice continues to grow, we're looking for people who want more than simply delivering projects. We're proud of the collaborative culture we're building - one where people are encouraged to share ideas, challenge thinking, develop others and succeed together. We're looking for leaders who enjoy solving clients' most complex business challenges, building trusted client relationships, developing high-performing teams and shaping the future of our practice.

Our people have the opportunity to lead major transformation programmes, influence the future of our practice and develop long-term relationships with some of the world's leading organisations. We're looking for people who want to help build one of the market's leading SAP consulting practices…not simply join one.

Whether you're leading a global transformation programme, developing the next generation of consultants, shaping a major client pursuit or bringing innovative SAP and AI-enabled solutions to clients, you'll have the opportunity to make a genuine impact from day one.

If you're looking for a career where you can combine deep SAP expertise with leadership, innovation and business transformation, we'd love to hear from you.

What your days will look like:

  • Lead the technical architecture workstream across complex SAP S/4HANA transformation programmes, defining technology strategies that align with business objectives, SAP best practice and clean-core principles.
  • Design scalable SAP technology architectures spanning SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), Integration Suite, Cloud, Identity & Security, Automation and the wider SAP technology landscape.
  • Partner with Solution Architects, Enterprise Architects and client technology leaders to define target architectures and resolve complex technical design decisions across SAP and non-SAP environments.
  • Collaborate with Business Change, functional, Data, AI and Cloud teams to deliver integrated transformation outcomes that extend beyond technology implementation.
  • Help clients unlock the value of SAP Business AI, Joule, BTP and intelligent technologies, ensuring technical platforms are designed to support innovation, automation and future business growth.
  • Support strategic pursuits through discovery workshops, technical solution shaping, proposals, client demonstrations and executive presentations.
  • Coach technical consultants whilst helping shape the continued growth of PwC's SAP Technology capability.

This role is for you if:

  • You have successfully led technical architecture across multiple end-to-end SAP ECC or SAP S/4HANA transformation programmes.
  • You have deep expertise across the SAP technology landscape, including SAP BTP, Integration Suite, Cloud platforms, Identity & Access Management, SAP Fiori, SAP Basis and technical architecture.
  • You understand SAP's latest technology innovations, including SAP Business AI, Joule, clean-cor

title: Data Architect-Senior Manager
description:
About the role:

PwC’s Data & AI Consulting team is rapidly expanding as we invest in building a new generation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) products that transform how we deliver value to our clients. We’re recognised by industry analysts, such as Gartner and IDC, as a market-leading Data & AI services consultancy and are actively working with clients to design, develop and deliver AI-powered products and data capabilities that achieve tangible outcomes and business value.

We’re looking for self-starting, progressive, and inquisitive individuals who want to shape the future of how AI is applied in real business contexts. You’ll join a collaborative and entrepreneurial team that combines deep technical expertise with sector knowledge and product thinking. We work in cross-functional squads to design, build, and launch solutions that create measurable impact for our clients and strengthen PwC’s position as a leader in trusted, responsible AI.

If you want to apply your skills to complex challenges, help define new products, and be part of an ambitious team that’s re-imagining the role of AI in professional services, this could be the role for you

What your days will look like:

  • Leading the design of enterprise data architectures that underpin modern analytics, AI, and digital transformation programmes - shaping how data is ingested, modelled, governed, and served across cloud platforms.

  • Defining end-to-end data architecture strategies, covering integration approaches, data modelling patterns, lineage, quality, metadata management, and master data management, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned to enterprise vision

  • Conducting architectural discovery, shaping data workstreams, and defining technical delivery approaches for client programmes across Azure, AWS, GCP or Snowflake environments.

  • Working as part of cross-functional product squads - including Data Engineers, Data Strategist, AI specialists, and Business SMEs- to design, build, and provide technical assurance for data-driven architectures

  • Partnering with client stakeholders to understand business challenges, define data requirements, evaluate technology options, and shape investment decisions through clear articulation of value and return on investment

  • Collaborating closely with engineering teams to translate data architecture designs into buildable solutions, overseeing modelling, pipelines, integration patterns, and platform services through to delivery

  • Contributing to data strategy, architectural roadmaps, and platform evolution, helping clients modernise their data landscape and strengthen their analytics and AI capabilities

This role is for you if:

  • Proven experience in enterprise architecture, including:

  • Full lifecycle experience designing and delivering platform agnostic data architectures, leading cross-functional teams to build data models, pipelines, and semantic layers that drive business value

  • Strong commercial awareness, with the ability to link data modelling decisions to business outcomes, sector-specific challenges, and broader market trends

  • Experience selecting data and integration technologies at project or enterprise level, and confidence in articulating pros, cons, and ROI to client stakeholders

  • Deep understanding of data governance, lineage, quality frameworks, and master data management, and their role within a modern data platform

  • A track record of delivering high-quality client engagements and building trusted relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.

  • Strong consulting foundations: impactful communication, structured problem-solving, adaptability, and the ability to navigate ambiguity and deliver under pressure.

  • Design expertise in core data architecture disciplines including data modelling (proficient in at least one data modelling tool e.g. Erwin or ER Studio), metadata management, data migration and master data management

  • Well versed in data architecture approaches to ingest, model and serve data from various sources including ERP (Oracle, SAP etc.), CRM (Salesforce, etc.) and HR systems (Workday etc) incl

title: Senior Operations Business Analyst – Technology Consulting (German Projects)
description:
About the team

In the field of technology consulting at PwC, it’s not just about being part of a large company; it’s about seeing how things work in different companies. We are usually right at the center of action, working in project teams that deliver everything from design to the delivery of great, cutting-edge solutions in business and technology for clients primarily in Germany. We continuously develop our skills, not only through client projects but also through other interesting activities. As a Senior Operations Business Analyst, you will work on transformational projects for clients in the financial sector, especially banks, insurance companies, and investment firms.

About your manager

Adam Kele leads the German Financial Services Transformation Practice within Technology Consulting and brings 15 years of experience in technology strategy, complex program delivery, and system integration and transformation projects across the Central and Eastern European region. Adam is passionate about bridging the IT and business perspectives, bringing a structured yet pragmatic approach to both business and delivery.

Job description & summary

As a Senior Operations Business Analyst, you will take a key role in the analysis, design, coordination, and delivery of digital and technology‑enabled transformation projects.

You will work closely with senior client stakeholders and IT teams, translating complex business needs into clear, structured requirements and solution designs. In addition to hands‑on analytical work, you will actively contribute to delivery planning, project governance, and stakeholder alignment in agile or hybrid environments.

You are expected to take ownership of workstreams, support decision‑making, and contribute to successful project outcomes while gradually growing into broader leadership responsibilities.


Requirements of the role

  • Completed studies in Economics, Business Administration, Business Informatics, Business Engineering, or comparable field

  • Minimum of 3 years' experience in banking, asset and wealth management or consulting sector, with deep expertise in areas like credit or securities (completion of vocational training as bank clerk or working experience as business analyst preferred). In addition, extensive expertise in core banking operations, complemented by a deep understanding of back- and middle-office functions and activities, along with project management skills.

  • A strong interest in exploring and applying new technologies to enhance efficiency and drive innovation, with knowledge in integrating tech-driven solutions to streamline business processes and improve data-driven decision-making. Additionally, has a strong affinity for tools such as business analytics, RPA, and process mining solutions.

  • Exceptional analytical skills to simplify complex challenges

  • Experience using German at B2-C1 level and English at C1 level in a professional environment

  • Creative problem-solving approach to enhance efficiency

  • Client-focused adaptability to drive satisfaction and value

  • Proficient in managing time and meeting deadlines

  • Leadership potential with initiative to guide projects

Our Benefits and Fun

  • Career experience from large transformation projects for multinational clients.

  • Working in German – most of our colleagues are native speakers.

  • 45, 000 benefit points for sports, meal vouchers, pharmacy, or cultural experiences.

  • High-end Ultrabook and iPhone with unlimited data.

  • Paid time off: 25 days, 3 wellbeing days, and up to 2 extra "Christmas" days off.

  • Flexible work schedule or occasional work from home.<

title: Transfer Pricing Manager, Financial Services Tax
description:
About the role

Our Transfer Pricing team specialises in helping organisations understand how they should price transactions between related parties. We learn how our clients operate, why they succeed, where value lies and how that aligns with international tax rules. Our team is fuelled by curious minds from diverse backgrounds.

As part of our team, you'll work with deep technical specialists in a broad spectrum of areas - together we'll present differentiated thought leadership to our clients. Our investment in technology, alternative delivery models, and knowledge tools will enable you to deliver work efficiently and allow time to focus on interesting and challenging value added advisory work.

We seek to attract the best people from a diverse talent pool and encourage a culture where people can be themselves and be valued for their strengths. This is what makes us a strong organisation, with an increasingly agile workforce empowered by flexibility in how we work.

What your days will look like:

As a Manager, you will work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive consulting and industry experience, helping our clients solve their complex business issues from strategy to execution.

  • Proactively managing a portfolio of clients, mainly within the Financial Services space
  • Managing the delivery of a variety of technical projects, from transfer pricing policy support through to documentation and enquiries
  • Applying a curious mindset and analytical approach to solve complex client problems

  • Leading business development activities to help identify and further opportunities on new/existing clients
  • Coordinating input from specialists across our global network to deliver great outcomes for our clients
  • Training, coaching and supervising more junior members of the team

This role is for you if:

  • You have previous experience of advising financial services clients on transfer pricing. Wider experience of other corporate tax or related international issues would also be an advantage
  • You have a track record of managing the delivery of quality work for clients; demonstrating a thorough understanding of the client's business and relevant professional standards
  • You are able to establish and maintain trusted client relationships
  • You have previous experience of managing a varied portfolio of clients and projects including all aspects of financial and risk management
  • You have the ability to plan and manage the delivery of work against tight deadlines

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: External Audit Manager - AWM
description:
About the role

PwC's Asset and Wealth Management (AWM) practice is the market leading AWM audit business. Our business is a national practice comprising over 600 staff with a presence in 8 offices across the UK, and comprises both financial audit and non-audit assurance businesses.

Working in AWM will provide opportunities to gain experience working across a variety of clients including FTSE listed, global private companies, private partnerships, funds and Private Equity and Venture Capitalist backed companies. You'll work across a wide variety of industry sectors including, Real Estate, Hedge Funds, Pensions, Private Equity, traditional Asset and Wealth management, as well as technology and asset servicing businesses. This breadth of client base gives our people an unmatchable opportunity to gain deep understanding and experience across the whole AWM sector.

As a Manager in our London office, you’ll lead a team of forward-thinking individuals to deliver high quality audits. You’ll gain in-depth knowledge into how businesses run, gain direct access to internal stakeholders and clients and work with an unrivalled range of organisations we audit. A rewarding career path awaits, join our team to develop yourself as a professional and benefit from the wide range of development opportunities available at PwC.

Key Responsibilities include, but not limited to;

  • Leading multi-location teams, using your team and relationship management skills to ensure the delivery of high quality audit work - from planning to completion of an Audit, including the review of financial statements, ensuring that it meets PwC and regulatory standards;
  • Building meaningful relationships and demonstrating curiosity that will allow you to have insightful conversations and provide visible challenge during the Audit;
  • Building connections across teams and specialist areas within PwC to help bring insight to the organisations we audit. This includes managing a variety of views and consulting where appropriate;
  • Leading on the completion of areas of complex or judgemental audit work which includes the identification of issues, analysis of data, articulation of findings and the ability to draw informed conclusions;
  • Managing the financial and resource aspects of Audit engagements, demonstrating a commercial approach throughout.

The skills and experience we’re looking for:

  • Must possess a Chartered Accountant / ACA / ACCA / ICAS qualified accountant (or an international equivalent) or have equivalent work experience. This includes international candidates who qualify through experience in their home country.
  • Experience of IFRS and/or UK GAAP and international standards on auditing;
  • Strong project management skills and experience managing an audit from planning to completion;
  • Confident in challenging yourself and others to complete high quality testing and documentation;
  • Ability to establish and nurture positive relationships across all levels - both internally and externally;
  • Must have asset management experience specifically in the traditional asset and wealth management, real assets or alternatives sectors.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Deals - Tax | Transfer Pricing | Manager
description:
About the role

We are seeking a Manager to join our growing Deals Transfer Pricing team, supporting the increasing demand for specialist services. This role is ideal for self-starters who thrive on responsibility, enjoy working in a dynamic environment, and can manage multiple engagements across diverse teams simultaneously.

Our transfer pricing team advises clients on all aspects of the UK and international regime throughout the deal lifecycle, including exit readiness, diligence, post-deal policy revision, financing transactions and assessing the tax impact of commercial or organisational change. Work is primarily project-based and involves collaboration with multinational companies and investors / private equity and credit funds across varied intercompany transactions, including products, services, intellectual property, and debt.

Joining this team offers exposure to a diverse client base and the opportunity to develop expertise across a broad range of markets the Deals TP team is servicing . You will play a key role in delivering high-quality solutions, building strong client relationships, and contributing to the continued success of our practice.

What your days will look like

  • Working with the wider Deals Tax practice as a subject matter specialist in the course of diligence, vendor assistance, post-deal work and value creation. Your client portfolio may include corporates / listed businesses, private equity backed businesses, credit funds, real estate investors and infrastructure companies

  • Undertaking transfer pricing planning and TP policy pricing implementation

  • Involvement and coordination of European and global transfer pricing engagements working with specialists across our global network

  • Supporting companies through all elements of business change and value chain transformation

  • Assisting clients with financing transactions pricing

  • Assisting clients with tax audits from HMRC and transfer pricing defence strategies; and preparation of transfer pricing documentation for planning or compliance purposes

The Role is for you if

  • Possess a Chartered Accountant (ACA ) or Chartered Tax Advisor (ATT, CTA) or equivalent international or legal professional qualification or have equivalent work experience. This includes international candidates who qualify through experience in their home country.

  • Proven track record of delivering high-quality client work, with strong business understanding and adherence to professional standards

  • Experience in proactively managing client portfolios and projects, including financial and risk management

  • Contribution to team development through knowledge sharing, industry trend analysis, and constructive feedback

  • Business development skills, with experience in building and maintaining internal and external networks

  • Strong ability to plan and deliver work effectively under tight deadlines

  • Excellent communication skills, with expertise in negotiation and influencing stakeholders

  • Intellectual agility and creativity, with a commitment to continuous learning and knowledge sharing

What You'll receive from us

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Regulatory Training Advisor – Senior Associate
description:
Job Requirements

About the role:

As a Regulatory Training Advisor within the XLoS Regulatory Reporting team, you will serve as a key escalation point and subject matter expert for regulatory and mandatory training matters, providing expert advice and guidance on complex training‑related queries, including exceptions and breaches. Your role will focus on thorough investigation, sound judgement, and recommending effective solutions, shifting from general execution to strategic advisory. You will proactively validate data to prevent issues, provide expert guidance on Audit Risk and Quality (ARQ) matters, and act as a trusted partner driving quality and compliance through enhanced tutor sourcing and delivery. This is a high-impact role demanding resilience, strong relationship management, and influencing skills to advise the business effectively.

What your days will look like:

· Case Management & Investigation: Act as the primary escalation handler for training breaches, exceptions, and anomalies, conducting detailed root cause analysis and recommending corrective actions. Monitor and report trends to the Training Manager to support stakeholder discussions and QMSE reporting.

· Compliance & Advisory Expertise: Maintain expert knowledge of ARQ requirements and XLoS mandatory training programmes to provide accurate, specialist guidance on compliance and regulatory reporting, ensuring consistent adherence across business units.

· Data Quality & Governance: Proactively validate training target audiences to prevent breaches, working closely with Reporting Officers to ensure governance standards, high data quality, and effective end-to-end compliance processes.

· Collaboration & Continuous Improvement: Partner with Course Managers to stay current on curricula and requirements, while driving improvements in tutor sourcing, accreditation, and engagement. Support change initiatives through automation and maintain robust documentation to ensure audit readiness and knowledge continuity.

This role is for you if you:

· Have exceptional investigative and analytical skills, using sound judgement to draw conclusions and recommend actions

· Can quickly build or apply expertise in ARQ and regulatory training compliance

· Are a subject matter expert in XLoS mandatory training or related processes

· Excel at building relationships and influencing stakeholders through excellent interpersonal skills

· Are resilient, adaptable, and comfortable managing complex workloads and changing priorities

· Communicate clearly and effectively, with excellent attention to detail and a focus on data accuracy

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions. We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Cybersecurity Consultant
description:
About the Team

Threat Management team consists of cybersecurity professionals focused on prevention of the cyberattacks via detection and responding to cyber threats. The key pillars consist of incident response, threat hunting, threat intelligence, security monitoring, vulnerability management, engineering and consulting services.

About your Manager

Lubomír has over 10 years of cyber security experience with different projects related to mainly cyber security managed services, building and operating Security Operation Centers (SOC), Threat Hunting & Intelligence and Vulnerability Management. Lubomír is also responsible for team leading, project management, designing of cyber security managed services, creation and development of training plans and is a proven coach to train other team members or client staff. Outside of work, he is involved in teaching, science, and research at the University of Hradec Králové, where he guarantees and teaches the course Surveillance Systems and Forensic Analysis.

Job Description & Summary

As a manager, you will lead the newly established TDR delivery team. Your primary responsibility is to ensure the team delivers high-quality technical services that significantly impact the client's security posture. You will be the main contact for clients, a mentor for Senior Associates, and a key player in developing service offerings and business development. However, you’re expected to still “get your hands dirty” – this isn’t a pure project manager role, but a technical delivery leader.

Delivery Leadership & Client Relationship (35% of Time)

  • Lead client engagements from scoping through delivery to closure.

  • Serve as the main point of contact for the client, communicating with security leadership and management.

  • Conduct workshops at executive and technical levels.

  • Manage scope, priorities, escalations, and client expectations.

  • Take ownership of the quality of deliverables (assessment reports, roadmaps, solution proposals).

  • Present outputs at the C-level/CISO level.

Technical Contribution (30% of Time)

  • Engage in hands-on work in at least two areas: SIEM (Splunk/Sentinel), Threat Hunting, Incident Response, Detection Engineering.

  • Conduct technical reviews of team outputs to ensure quality and consistency.

  • Provide architectural advice in detection & response areas (SIEM architecture, log management strategies, use case framework).

  • Actively monitor the threat landscape and its implications for clients.

  • Ability to jump into technical work when needed – you are not just a "people manager."

Business Development, Mentoring & Service Development (35% of Time)

  • Lead and mentor 2 Senior Associates in their technical and professional growth.

  • Actively support business development by identifying opportunities, presales presentations, and preparing proposals.

  • Define and develop service offerings - decide what we sell, how we deliver it, and how we scale it.

  • Collaborate with other practice areas (e.g., GRC, Cloud Security, Identity) on cross-sell opportunities.

  • Conduct labor estimation, pricing, and resource planning.

  • Build internal knowledge base, reusable assets, and delivery frameworks.

What This Role Is NOT:

⚠️ To avoid misunderstandings:

  • This is NOT purely a managerial role. We expect you to contribute technically 30% of the time.

  • This is NOT a pure project manager role. You need to understand content, not just the process.

  • This is NOT a strategic advisory role without delivery responsibility. You deliver, not just advise.

  • This is NOT a role with a large team of 10+ people. You lead a small, senior team – you need to be a "playing coach."

  • This is NOT a "slide factory." We do real work with real impact.

Requirements of the Role

  • 6–10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, including at least 2 years in consulting/professional services or a role with client responsibility.

title: Manager - Insurance - Risk and Regulation Advisory
description:
About the role

Our Insurance & Asset & Wealth Management Risk & Regulation Advisory team works with leading insurers and asset & wealth managers to strengthen governance, enhance control environments and respond to evolving regulatory requirements. The team brings together expertise across regulatory advisory, risk and controls, and assurance in a supportive and inclusive environment.

As a Manager, you will take responsibility for delivering high-quality client engagements, managing teams and supporting senior stakeholders. You will work across a range of regulatory and risk topics, helping clients implement practical solutions that improve controls, governance and regulatory outcomes. This role can be based in London, Bristol or Edinburgh, with flexibility and client travel as required.

title: Financial Services, Tax Disputes Manager
description:
About the role:

We are seeking a Financial Services Tax Disputes Manager. Our Tax Disputes lawyers are integrated into PwC’s tax business. This enables the team to offer clients a fully integrated tax disputes offering, covering all stages of the dispute from initial enquiry and investigation to final resolution either by agreement or through the courts. Litigation is not a separate stage in the resolution process – It is part of that process. Clients come to us as we can also offer the tax technical depth of knowledge and the ability to flex how we resolve disputes; including recourse to other settlement mechanisms such as ADR or Treaty resolution as well as our recognised expertise in tax litigation.

  • Producing written advice for the client and drafting responses to correspondence.

  • Instructing Counsel, including preparing Instructions to Counsel and Notes of Conference/Consultation

  • Drafting key documentation such as Directions, Notices of Appeal, witness statements

  • Presenting case law and technical updates to the FS tax practice and at client events

This role is for you if:

  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • You have experience in Litigation.

  • You have previous experience with management of projects and case management.

  • You already have excellent technical skills.

  • You are able to demonstrate that you are able to work independently

  • You must possess a Legal Qualification (or an international equivalent) or have equivalent work experience. This includes international candidates who qualify through experience in their home country.

title: Senior účetní
description:
Jaký bude tvůj tým

Jsme tým zkušených účetních, kteří se specializují na účetnictví dceřiných společností velkých nadnárodních firem. Pomáháme klientům plnit požadavky české účetní a daňové legislativy, vedeme jejich účetnictví a sestavujeme zákonné účetní závěrky.
Často spolupracujeme přímo na straně klienta a denně komunikujeme v angličtině, takže u nás zažiješ skutečně mezinárodní prostředí.
Zároveň jsme nadšenci do automatizace, digitalizace a AI – chceme být o krok napřed a postupně eliminovat rutinní manuální práci.
Můžeš se těšit na přátelský a podporující tým, který sdílí know-how a pomáhá si navzájem.

Jaká bude tvoje role v týmu

  • Kompletní vedení účetní agendy klientů (měsíční reporting, roční účetní závěrky, DPH).

  • Řešení komplexních účetních případů a přímá komunikace s klienty.

  • Optimalizace procesů a spolupráce se stávajícími i novými klienty.

  • Nastavování převodových můstků mezi českými a zahraničními účetními pravidly.

  • Možnost zapojení do projektů přímo u klienta, často i netradičních.


Co by ti nemělo chybět

  • Min. 4 roky praxe v účetnictví a VŠ vzdělání.

  • Znalost podvojného účetnictví a českých účetních standardů (výhodou IFRS nebo US GAAP).

  • Plynulá čeština a angličtina (němčina je bonus).

  • Pokročilá práce s Excelem, analytické a logické myšlení.

  • Zkušenost s outsourcingem účetnictví výhodou.

  • Samostatnost, pečlivost, odolnost vůči stresu a týmovost.

  • Zájem o nové trendy v účetnictví, daních a technologiích.


Čím tě potěšíme my

  • Koncentrovanou zkušenost a rychlý kariérní růst. Může ti to znít jako fráze, ale tak to skutečně je.

  • Férovou mzdu a roční bonus odpovídající tvému výkonu.

  • Flexibilní pracovní doba a možnost občasné práce z domova.

  • Placené volno 30 dní, 3 Wellbeing days a 2 dny volna navíc od firmy na konci roku.

  • Špičkový Ultrabook a iPhone s neomezenými daty.

  • Benefit program s 45.000 body, který můžeš využít na dovolenou, vzdělávání, stravenky, sport, zdraví... Prostě na to, co tě baví.

  • Podporu Vašeho osobního i profesního rozvoje, včetně možnosti získat profesní kvalifikace jako RTA (Registered Tax Advisor) nebo ACCA a širokou nabídku soft skills školení.

  • Mimopracovní aktivity a Away Days (team building, ski weekend apod.).

  • Buddy systém a pravidelná zpětná vazba na tvoji práci, také konzultace s koučem, se kterým můžeš řešit svůj další rozvoj i kariérní směr.

PwC, to je největší auditní tým v České republice, ale i poradenské týmy, které se zaměřují na strategie, fúze & akvizice, restrukturalizace, finanční poradenství, daně, právo, technologie, data nebo forenzní analýzu. description:

Are you ready to make a tangible impact in one of the most dynamic and critical industries? Join our well-established and rapidly expanding team within PwC's Supply Chain and Procurement team, where we specialise in delivering transformative solutions for our clients. Develop and execute digital strategies that enhance operational capabilities and drive competitive advantage.

Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, acting as a trusted advisor. Lead project teams, manage project timelines, and ensure deliverables meet client expectations and quality standards.

title: Corporate Finance, Retail, Consumer & Leisure – Associate Director
description:
About This Role

We are recruiting an Associate Director to join our Retail, Consumer and Leisure Corporate Finance team, a market-leading group of sector specialists advising on high-profile mid-market transactions. You will play a key role in executing transactions and supporting origination activity, working with entrepreneurs, private equity and corporates across a fast-evolving consumer landscape.

This is an opportunity to play an important role in complex deal execution, contribute to client outcomes and contribute to the continued growth of a high-performing team. We are looking for an experienced M&A professional with strong commercial judgement and a track record of delivering transactions end-to-end.

  • Acting as a key point of contact for clients and advisors throughout the deal lifecycle

  • Supporting the development of junior team members, providing guidance, oversight and on-the-job coaching

This role is for you if:

  • You have strong transaction execution experience, ideally including experience within the Retail, Consumer and Leisure sectors

  • You have experience delivering end-to-end M&A transactions, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders effectively

  • You are commercially aware, proactive and able to contribute to both execution and business development activity

  • You demonstrate leadership within deal teams, supporting and developing junior colleagues

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions. We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Transactions Services- FDD, Senior Manager
description:
About the role:

As a Senior Manager in Financial Due Diligence, you’ll play a key leadership role in delivering high-quality analysis, managing complex projects, and shaping the insights that guide client decisions.

You’ll lead teams through the review of financial and commercial performance, assess key deal drivers and value-creation levers, and communicate findings clearly and effectively to senior stakeholders. You’ll interact directly with senior management teams, business owners and private equity investors, developing trusted advisor relationships and bringing clarity to fast-moving, high-stakes situations.

You’ll also contribute to the growth of the practice: developing people, building sector knowledge, expanding internal and external networks, and helping identify opportunities to support clients across the deal lifecycle.

What your days will look like:

  • Shaping engagement scope, leading the financial due diligence workstream and driving project management

  • Leading engagements for corporate and private equity clients, including liaising with other diligence workstreams and advisors.

  • Delivering clear, commercially focused insights that support clients’ value creation hypotheses.

  • Managing the preparation of high-quality diligence reports for our clients & overseeing analysis of historical and forecast performance, cash flows, working capital, and key business drivers.

The role is for you if:

  • Must possess an ACA Qualification (or an international equivalent) or have equivalent work experience. This includes international candidates who qualify through experience in their home country.

  • Strong financial due diligence experience in a deals, advisory or related environment.

  • Excellent analytical capability with the ability to interpret financial information in a commercial, value-creation context.

  • Ability to identify key drivers, risks, deal breakers and commercial implications.

  • Sound commercial judgement with the ability to link financial insights to broader deal strategy.

  • Comfortable navigating complex issues, asking thoughtful questions and shaping the story for clients.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

Vedle řešení krizových situací se budete podílet i na nastavování preventivních opatření a posilování etické kultury organizací. Čeká vás i práce v mezinárodním prostředí s našími zahraničními forenzními týmy, vysoká míra odpovědnosti a skutečný dopad vaší práce. Vaše role v týmu Vedení a řízení forenzních projektů v oblasti vyšetřování podvodů, neetického jednání, posuzování compliance programů nebo řešení sporů a regulatorních záležitostí. Odpovědnost za plánování, koordinaci a úspěšné dodání projektů v požadované kvalitě, rozsahu a termínech. Poskytování odborného poradenství klientům, jejich právním zástupcům a interním týmům v citlivých a komplexních situacích. Řízení a realizace revize dokumentů, finančních a datových analýz v rámci forenzních projektů. Úzká spolupráce s klíčovými stakeholdery, včetně klientů, právníků, auditorů, pojišťoven, regulátorů a partnerů. Příprava, revize a prezentace zpráv, expertních stanovisek a dalších odborných výstupů pro klienty. Spolupráce s multidisciplinárními týmy v rámci organizační struktury EY (finance, risk, technologie, regulatory, legal) na komplexních řešeních pro klienty. Aktivní přispívání k rozvoji metodik, procesů a kvality poskytovaných služeb. Podpora rozvoje týmu prostřednictvím vedení, mentoringu a systematického předávání know-how. Zapojení do rozvoje obchodních příležitostí, přípravy nabídek a budování vztahů s klienty. Sledování regulatorních, technologických a tržních trendů v oblasti forenzních služeb, integrity a řízení rizik. Co je pro nás důležité Minimálně 4-5 let relevantní praxe v oblasti auditu, forenzních služeb, compliance, řízení rizik nebo příbuzných oborů. Výborné komunikační dovednosti a jistota při jednání s managementem, právníky i dalšími stakeholdery. title: Listed and Inbound - Transfer Pricing Manager
description:

Our Transfer Pricing team focuses on helping organizations determine the appropriate pricing for transactions between related parties. We delve into how our clients operate, identify their success factors, uncover where value lies, and ensure alignment with international tax regulations. As a Manager, you'll collaborate with a team of problem solvers who bring extensive consulting and industry experience to address complex business issues, from strategy to execution. Your role includes managing a portfolio of clients, leading technical projects, and contributing to business development activities.

Our team is fuelled by curious minds from diverse backgrounds. As part of our team, you'll work with deep technical specialists in a broad spectrum of areas - together we'll present differentiated thought leadership to our clients. Our investment in technology, alternative delivery models, and knowledge tools will enable you to deliver work efficiently and allow time to focus on interesting and challenging value added advisory work.

What your days will look like

  • Lead the delivery of various technical projects, from initial planning stages to documentation and handling inquiries.

  • Experience in building and maintaining strong internal and external networks.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more

title: Praktikum Tax Accounting (w/m/d)
description:
Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Tax & Legal Solutions suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Praktikant Tax Accounting (w/m/d).

Das erwartet dich

Prüfung – Du bist direkt in verantwortungsvolle Mandatsarbeit eingebunden und unterstützt bei der Prüfung der laufenden und latenten Steuern von Jahres- und Konzernabschlüssen großer und mittelständischer Unternehmen. Dabei befasst du dich nicht nur mit dem Steuer- und Handelsrecht, sondern tauchst auch in die IFRS-Welt ein.

Beratung – Zusätzlich bearbeitest du bei prüfungsnaher Beratungstätigkeit verschiedene steuerrechtliche Fragestellungen, hilfst bei der technischen Umsetzung neuer IT Tax Systeme und unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Steuererklärungen.

Einblicke – Du erhältst spannende Einblicke in die Strategie und Arbeitsweise einer der führenden Beratungs- und Prüfungsgesellschaften.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du studierst Wirtschafts- oder Rechtswissenschaften, Finanzwirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Fachrichtung und hast eine Vertiefung in dem Bereich Steuern.
  • Du studierst mindestens im dritten Semester oder befindest dich in einem Gap Year zwischen Bachelor und Master.
  • Du interessierst dich für die Themen Jahresabschlüsse und Finanzbuchhaltung bringst (idealerweise) bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen durch Praktika, Werkstudierendentätigkeiten oder Projektarbeit mit.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Du möchtest uns in deinem Praktikum über einen Zeitraum von mindestens drei Monaten unterstützen.

Deine Benefits

Kultur – Wir möchten, dass du dich bei uns wohl fühlst. Deshalb pflegen wir eine offene und moderne Unternehmens- sowie Führungskultur, in der wir geleistete Arbeit gemeinsam anerkennen und feiern.

Flexibilität – In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. description: Connect to your Industry Join our market-leading Life and Pensions Strategy consulting team, recognised for deep sector expertise and trusted insight across the industry. This is a sector-specialist strategy role for someone who combines strong consulting skills with real understanding of the UK life and pensions market. As an Associate Director, you will lead high-impact engagements with insurers, pension providers, and wealth firms; owning workstreams, shaping strategic recommendations, and building senior client relationships. You will operate at the intersection of strategy and execution, translating insight into commercially viable outcomes. You will advise on: Growth, corporate and business unit strategy New product development and market entry analysis Commercial analysis, modelling and business case construction Strategic operating model design and transformation Strategy input into and mobilisation of complex transformation programmes Senior executive and Board level problem solving and facilitation What sets us apart: End-to-end impact : we go beyond strategy design to shape and deliver transformation; working alongside clients through execution, not just recommendation. True cross-functional integration: seamless collaboration across Risk, Technology, Operations, Actuarial and M&A to deliver strategy grounded in real-world constraints and opportunities. Deep sector specialism: a focused Life & Pensions practice with credibility across insurers, platforms, and wealth propositions. AI-enabled strategy and delivery: we help clients identify where AI can create measurable value; from proposition design and customer journeys to operational efficiency, risk management and scalable transformation. Entrepreneurial platform: opportunity to shape propositions, build relationships, and contribute directly to growth. Build your brand: we invest in developing distinctive expertise, supporting you to grow a personal market profile while contributing to the continued growth of the practice. Connect to your career at Deloitte Deloitte drives progress. Using our vast range of expertise, we help our clients' become leaders wherever they choose to compete. To do this, we invest in outstanding people. We build teams of future thinkers, with diverse talents and backgrounds, and empower them all to reach for and achieve more. What brings us all together at Deloitte? It’s how we approach the thousands of decisions we make every day. How we behave, our beliefs and our attitudes. In other words: our values. Whatever we do, wherever we are in the world, we lead the way , serve with integrity , take care of each other , foster inclusion , and collaborate for measurable impact . These five shared values lead every decision we make and action we take, guiding us to deliver impact how and where it matters most . Connect to your opportunity As an Assistant Director, you will operate as a senior leader on engagements, trusted to own the problem, not just the workstream. You will be accountable for translating ambiguous, C-suite challenges into structured problems, leading teams to develop clear, commercially grounded answers. Rather than simply managing delivery, you will shape the direction of engagements in real time - balancing analytical rigour, client context, and pragmatic execution. You will act as a day-to-day strategic partner to senior clients, building credibility through insight, judgement, and pace. Our work is often at the sharp end of industry change - supporting organisations navigating major regulatory, market and business model shifts. Engagements range from focused strategic sprints to multi-year transformations, giving you exposure to both front-end strategy and real delivery impact. title: Workday Delivery Consultant - Manager
description:
Job Description

About the role:

At PwC, we help organisations transform how they attract, develop, engage and manage their people. Workday is often a key enabler of this transformation, but our work goes beyond technology implementation. We help clients simplify processes, improve employee experience, strengthen data foundations and realise measurable value from their workforce technology investments.

As a Workday Manager within our Workforce Transformation practice, you will play a delivery-focused role on Workday programmes, leading client delivery teams while also contributing hands-on to the work. You will manage complex workstreams, guide and support Workday teams, shape practical solutions and remain close enough to the detail to review design decisions, resolve delivery issues and help ensure high-quality outcomes across the programme lifecycle.

This is a role for someone who enjoys working with and leading Workday delivery teams, building trusted client relationships and developing others, while continuing to deepen their own hands-on expertise in Workday, HR technology and workforce transformation.

What your days will look like:

  • Lead Workday delivery teams and workstreams across HCM, Talent, Recruiting, Learning, Compensation, Payroll, Absence, Time, Reporting, Integrations, Security and Data Migration, while providing hands-on input to solution design, configuration, testing and issue resolution.

  • Act as a Functional, Solution or Workstream Lead, owning delivery planning, quality, stakeholder engagement, risks and issues to ensure successful programme outcomes.

  • Facilitate client workshops, challenge requirements constructively and help design future-state processes that improve ways of working rather than replicate existing practices.

  • Translate business requirements into practical Workday solutions that support strategic objectives, enhance user experience and deliver measurable business value.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and guide clients through all programme phases—from discovery and design to deployment, adoption and optimisation—bringing strong problem-solving skills and delivery discipline throughout.

This role is for you if:

  • Current Workday certification with strong delivery experience across one or more Workday product areas and a proven track record in implementation, optimisation or transformation programmes.

  • Experience leading Workday workstreams or teams, with responsibility for delivery quality, project planning, risk management and successful outcomes.

  • Strong understanding of HR processes and the ability to translate business needs into practical technology solutions that deliver business value.

  • Excellent facilitation, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge requirements constructively and influence decision-making.

  • Commercially aware team player who is passionate about developing others, building high-performing teams and contributing to practice growth and business development.

What you will get from us

You will join an established Workday and Workforce Transformation practice with access to challenging client work, experienced colleagues and the wider PwC network. You will have opportunities to develop your consulting, technology, leadership and commercial skills while contributing to work that helps clients transform the way their people experience work.

We offer a range of benefits designed to support you at work and outside work, including empowered flexibility, hybrid working across office, home and client site, private medical cover, access to wellbeing support and volunteering days.

Then you will get involved with us, for example in the area of ​​risk management, in the development and implementation of integrated risk and performance management as well as in the development of quantitative risk models. title: Cyber Security Incident Response Expert
description:
About the Team

For us, SOC is not just a ticket or detections „washing machine “. We perceive incident response as a mandatory part of our services, along with other proactive activities such as: Threat Hunting, Threat Intelligence, Vulnerability Management, as well as post-incident activities like Forensic Analysis and more.

Threat Management team consists of cybersecurity professionals focused on prevention of the cyberattacks via detection and responding to cyber threats. The key pillars consist of incident response, threat hunting, threat intelligence, security monitoring, vulnerability management, engineering and consulting services.

About your manager

Lubomír has over 10 years of cyber security experience with different projects related to mainly cyber security managed services, building and operating Security Operation Centers (SOC), Threat Hunting & Intelligence and Vulnerability Management. Lubomír is also responsible for team leading, project management, designing of cyber security managed services, creation and development of training plans and is a proven coach to train other team members or client staff. Outside of work, he is involved in teaching, science, and research at the University of Hradec Králové, where he guarantees and teaches the course Surveillance Systems and Forensic Analysis.

Job description & summary

As an Incident Response Expert, you will serve as a Level 3 analyst and Subject Matter Expert (SME) withing the client's operations, specializing in security incident detection, analysis, investigation and Response. Your expertise will be pivotal in leading incident response efforts to ensure timely containment and eradication of security threats. In this role, you can expect a balanced mix of long-term client engagements in operations, alongside ad-hoc projects – based assignments focused on pure incident response, threat hunting, and breach Discovery, all aimed at fortifying client security and resilience.

This is a senior role, and its additional responsibilities may include continuous improvement of the Threat Management team tradecraft and capabilities as well as sharing knowledge, mentoring and training junior colleagues.

Requirements of the role

  • 4+ years of relevant professional experience.

  • Consistent, reliable and professional personality, capable of working within international & diverse teams.

  • Previous CERT/CSIRT/DFIR/SOC (or equivalent) experience highly desired.

  • In depth understanding of varied attack vectors and adversaries’ Tactics, Techniques & Procedures (TTPs) up to the level of Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs).

  • Excellent understanding of one or more Operating Systems (Linux, Windows, …).

  • Ability to work under pressure during major security incident response situations as well as attention to detail during post-breach investigation.

  • As an Incident Response Expert, you will lead technical investigations and recovery efforts in response to cybersecurity incidents, conducting forensics, and identifying compromised systems. Previous experience in incident response is essential.

  • Ability to lead investigations in compromised environment without any previous knowledge of the environment for major incidents (eg. ransomware, APTs).

Nice to have

  • Hands-on skills within the information security field, with special focus towards Security.

  • Information and Event Management (SIEM) tools like Splunk, QRadar, Arcsight or ELK.

  • Working knowledge of the Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools.

  • Experience with Cyber Threat Intelligence integration into SOC environment & operation.

  • Previous consulting experience in the global enterprise environment.

  • Industry recognized certifications either in the area of general information security or focused.

  • Towards Threat Management can be plus.

  • Deeper experience in any (or more) of the following areas:

Security/Network Analysis

Incident Response

Cyber Threat Intelligence

Threat and Vulnerability Management

Digital Forensics

SIEM solutions

description:

Your expertise in accounting principles and auditing standards will ensure the accuracy of financial statements. Collaborate with diverse clients, from owner-managed businesses to multinational corporations, across many industries. What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

title: Developer – Global Threat Intelligence (Senior Associate)
description:
About the role:

PwC is seeking a developer to join our Threat Intelligence practice, building the bespoke platforms and automation that underpin our global intelligence capability.

Our Threat Intelligence team delivers research‑driven, actionable intelligence to public and private sector organisations worldwide. We track emerging intrusion techniques and hundreds of threat actors across more than 27 countries, supporting incident response, adversary emulation, managed threat hunting, and strategic security decision‑making.

In this role, you’ll design and build the tools that enable analysts to collect, analyse, and publish intelligence at pace, ensuring clients have reliable access to critical insights. This includes delivering a threat intelligence portal, integration interfaces for client platforms, bespoke research services, and intelligence support across PwC’s global cyber security practice.

What your days will look like:

  • Design and build scalable automation tools and data collection systems, integrating with third-party APIs and bespoke data sources.
  • Develop and maintain internal platforms, services, and RESTful APIs that support intelligence analysis, publication, and distribution.
  • Contribute to systems that manage and present structured technical intelligence data.
  • Collaborate with service and product owners to improve interfaces and APIs, enabling seamless integration of intelligence into client-facing services.
  • Write clean, performant, reusable frontend and backend code both manually and using AI Agents.
  • Constructively review the work of your peers, reflecting critically on fit for user need as well as adherence to engineering best practices.
  • Contribute to internal documentation for both technical (DevOps, engineering) and non-technical (analyst, client) audiences.
  • Support the ongoing evolution of our platforms as we scale globally.

The role is for you if:

  • You have strong experience with Python
  • Advanced knowledge of JavaScript and modern web technologies (HTML/CSS)
  • Experience designing, developing, and consuming RESTful APIs
  • Comfort using AI tools such as Cursor and GitHub Copilot
  • Ability to write performant, maintainable, and reusable UI components
  • Experience working collaboratively within globally distributed teams
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Desirable experience:

  • TypeScript, React, and Node.js
  • Python web and back‑end frameworks (e.g. Flask, Falcon)
  • Full‑stack experience across frontend and backend systems
  • Experience deploying and operating applications in cloud environments (GCP, AWS, or Azure)
  • Familiarity with modern development practices (CI/CD, containerisation, cloud‑native architectures)

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

description:
Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Tax & Legal Solutions suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Consultant Tax Steuerliche Grundsatzabteilung (w/m/d).

Das erwartet dich
Fachwissen - Du arbeitest in der steuerlichen Grundsatzabteilung und verfolgst kontinuierlich Entwicklungen im nationalen und internationalen Steuerrecht. Du analysierst gesetzliche Änderungen, Rechtsprechung, die Positionen der Finanzverwaltung sowie europäische und globale Vorgaben und bereitest diese für deine Kolleg:innen auf.
Beratung - Du unterstützt in der Grundsatzabteilung bei der steuerrechtlichen Beratung von in- und ausländischen Mandant:innen aller Größen und Rechtsformen. Dabei hilfst du z.B. bei der Optimierung von Konzernstrukturen und Umstrukturierungen oder prüfst grenzüberschreitende Sachverhalte.

Das bringst du mit
• Du hast dein Studium in Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder in Rechtswissenschaften mit Prädikatsexamen erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
• Als Berufseinsteiger:in hast du während des Studiums einen Schwerpunkt im Steuerrecht gewählt oder du konntest bereits praktische Erfahrungen in der steuerlichen Beratung von Unternehmen sammeln.
• Deine ausgeprägten analytischen Fähigkeiten sowie deine Technologieoffenheit ermöglichen es dir, komplexe Sachverhalte schnell und effektiv aufzubereiten.
• Du verfügst über hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowie sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Deine Benefits
Flexibilität – In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. Dabei gibt es keine Kernarbeitszeiten – im Rahmen der betrieblichen Anforderungen und arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, temporär in über 40 Ländern zu arbeiten.

Freizeit – Überstunden kannst du auf deinem Jahresarbeitszeitenkonto (JAZ) sammeln und nach arbeitsintensiven Phasen durch Freizeit ausgleichen. Restliche Überstunden werden einmal jährlich ausgezahlt. Zusätzlich stehen dir 30 Urlaubstage im Kalenderjahr zur Verfügung.
Gesundheit – Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen: Neben einer eigenen betrieblichen Krankenkasse bieten wir auch Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sowie Sportangebote an. Nimm an unserem kostenlosen Betriebssportprogramm teil oder profitiere von vergünstigten Beiträgen in diversen Fitnessstudios oder einer Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft.
Das ist noch nicht alles – Wir möchten ein positives Arbeitsumfeld schaffen: Ein Umfeld, in dem flexibles und kreatives Arbeiten möglich ist, in dem Arbeit anerkannt und Leistung honoriert wird und auf das wir stolz sind. Alle Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.

title: Data Protection & Microsoft Purview Specialist
description:
About the Team

We help integrate security elements efficiently and reliably into the technological units of the client's business. We provide assurance that any changes affecting the IT environment will be fundamentally safe and allow a quick return on the client's investment. The team, which focuses on identities, privileged access management, and cloud security, is part of our broader Cyber Security team.

About the Manager

Martin Zbořil is a leader of the Identity and Cloud Security team and his major experience lies in cloud security. Within this area, Martin also finished his PhD study. Besides cloud security, he has extensive knowledge also of many other areas of cybersecurity. Martin builds a cross-functional team that includes the IAM area and cloud security with a strong focus on protection of data in the cloud. Martin pays great attention to upskilling and personal development which might be considered also as his hobby. In his personal life, he is a sports enthusiast and among his favorite sports belong football, golf, skiing, gym, cycling, tennis and many others.

Job description & summary

As a Data Protection & Microsoft Purview Specialist, you will collaborate closely with various IT teams or clients to ensure robust protection of data across both cloud and on-premise environments, leveraging Microsoft Purview. Your responsibilities will include designing and implementing data protection strategies, ensuring compliance with data privacy regulations, and integrating Microsoft Purview with other security and data management solutions. You will be responsible for monitoring data environments, identifying and mitigating risks, and ensuring that data protection measures are in line with best practices and organizational policies. This role involves not only the technical implementation but also advising on data protection strategies and policies to ensure comprehensive data security.

Requirements of the role

You needn't be an expert in the data protection area, we can help you to become so. All you need is:

  • Understanding of cybersecurity principles and data protection best practices.

  • Experience with design, implementation and/or operation of a data protection solution, e.g. data loss prevention, data classification or information protection.

  • Consistent, reliable, and professional personality with a sense of ownership, capable of working within international & diverse teams.

  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written skills: ability to clearly and concisely articulate issues, alternatives, and recommendations.

  • Proficiency in Czech and English, as you will use both languages in communication with clients.


Your advantages could be:

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Information Protection, and other Microsoft security and compliance tools.

  • Microsoft security certifications, such as SC-100, SC-200, SC-300, SC-400 etc.

  • Experience with data governance.

  • Experience in implementing and managing data protection and compliance frameworks.

  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements related to data privacy and protection.

  • Understanding of data lifecycle management and data retention policies.

  • Hands-on experience with auditing data access and data activity monitoring.

  • Advanced knowledge of encryption technologies and secure data storage practices.

  • Experience with conducting data protection impact assessments (DPIAs) and managing data breach incidents.

  • Familiarity with industry standards and frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA, ISO 27001, and NIST.

  • Project management skills.

  • Proficiency in German language.

Benefits and Fun

  • Concentrated experience and rapid career growth. It may sound like a platitude, but it really is.

  • Paid time off 20 + 5 days, 3 wellbeing days and 2 extra days off from the company at the end of the year.

Från att utforma strategier och målbilder till att implementera våra kunders framtida IT-verksamhet och dess lösningar, kommer du att bidra till att lösa våra kunders mest komplexa utmaningar inom teknik och digitalisering. Tillsammans med kollegorna i teamet arbetar du primärt med CIO:s och andra IT-chefers agenda inom områden såsom IT-strategi, styrning och operativa modeller, IT-arkitektur, IT sourcing & upphandlingsrådgivning, IT-kostnadsbesparing och effektivisering, samt storskaliga tekniktransformationer. Rollen som Manager Vi letar efter en person med 6–8 års erfarenhet från en välrenommerad större eller mindre konsultverksamhet till teamet med basering i Stockholm. Vi hjälper våra kunder med deras mest komplexa IT-utmaningar gällande exempelvis strategiska omställningar med påverkan på deras operativa modell och sourcing upplägg, eller stöd med analys av IT-kostnader och besparingsmöjligheter för att uppnå effektivisering och större affärsnyttor. Förutom klientarbete, arbetar teamet kontinuerligt med att vidareutveckla vår framgångsrika konsultverksamhet inom strategisk IT-rådgivning. Då arbetet bedrivs i team och i nära samverkan med våra kunder, är det viktigt att du känner dig trygg med att leda och coacha yngre kollegor och personer inom våra kunders verksamhet. Våra kunder utgör några av Sveriges mest framgångsrika bolag inom en rad olika branscher, vilket ger en stor möjlighet att växa som konsult och dra lärdomar från olika typer av miljöer. Ditt bidrag Leda IT-rådgivnings- eller transformationsprojekt från planering till genomförande hos våra kunder. Leda och coacha yngre kollegor i deras individuella utvecklingsresor och i samband med kundleverans. Arbeta med affärsutveckling genom identifiering och bearbetning av nya möjligheter till kundsamarbeten, samt som del av detta samarbeta med kollegor för att dra nytta av vår samlade kompetens och kunskapsbas. Genom nyfikenhet och intresse för teknologisk utveckling inom samhälle och näringsliv, engagerar du dig i olika sammanhang där tillämpning av nya tekniker diskuteras. Utveckla och upprätthålla förtroendefulla relationer både internt och externt. Aktivt bidra till utveckling av vår affär och praktik. Kvalifikationer Du är en affärsdriven person med tidigare erfarenhet av arbete som managementkonsult och som besitter en bred förståelse för IT/teknik och dess affärstillämpningar och nyttor. Du har erfarenhet av att interagera med personer av olika senioritet inom IT-organisationer, och har förmågan att föra samtal om de mest angelägna frågorna på ”CIO-agendan”. Du sporras av arbete med marknadsföring och försäljning och har förmåga att självständigt och i samarbete med andra driva affärsresultat med hjälp av sitt professionella nätverk bestående av interna och externa kontakter. Du är en lagspelare med erfarenhet av att leda diversifierade och högpresterande team, samt erfarenhet av att leverera resultat av hög kvalitet i projekt som utnyttjar teknologi för att skapa affärsvärde. Du har 5–7 års samlad relevant arbetslivserfarenhet som managementkonsult inom strategisk IT-rådgivning och transformation. Du har avlagt examen inom ett relevant område, exempelvis data- och systemvetenskap eller industriell ekonomi med IT-inriktning. Du behärskar svenska och engelska flytande i tal och skrift, ytterligare språkkunskaper är ett plus. Vi ser gärna att du har konsulterfarenhet från kunder inom finansiell sektor, konsumentprodukter och detaljhandel, eller teknologi, media och telekommunikation (TMT).

title: AI and Agentic Solutions Architect (Alliances)
description:
About the role:

PwC’s Strategic AI Alliances are central to growth, enabling differentiated solutions through partnerships with organisations such as Palantir, OpenAI and Anthropic. Focused on areas including Generative AI, Agentic AI and next-generation platforms, these alliances drive innovation, address evolving client needs and support growth across sectors and territories.
As a Senior Manager – AI and Agentic Solutions Architect (Alliances), the role focuses on leading the design, implementation and adoption of enterprise-grade AI and agentic solutions across PwC’s client portfolio. The role ensures solutions are scalable, technically robust and aligned with current and future client requirements.
This position requires strong technical expertise in AI technologies and close collaboration across Lines of Service, industry teams, alliance partners and client stakeholders. The role plays a key part in pre-sales transformation programmes, driving architectural excellence and positioning PwC as a trusted advisor in AI-led engagements across EMEA.

What your days will look like:

  • Recommend and shape AI and Agentic solutions, defining scalable architectures aligned to client needs and PwC standards.

  • Act as a technical advisor on complex, multi-region engagements, supporting pre-sales activity and large-scale transformation programmes.

  • Collaborate with alliance partners, product and engineering teams, and internal stakeholders to co-create and position solutions.

  • Build and maintain strong technical relationships across clients, alliances and PwC teams, supporting joint go-to-market initiatives.

  • Drive delivery assurance, technical governance and knowledge sharing, contributing to innovation, best practice and team objectives.

This role is for you if:

  • You hold relevant certifications in Cloud, Data and AI (e.g. Solutions Architect, Machine Learning, Generative or Agentic AI) from leading providers such as AWS, Microsoft, Google Cloud, Palantir, OpenAI or Anthropic.

  • You bring strong experience in enterprise architecture, technical pre-sales or technology consulting, with a proven track record of delivering large-scale AI and cloud solutions.

  • You demonstrate deep expertise across the AI ecosystem, including LLMs, agentic frameworks, orchestration platforms, RAG and AI governance.

  • You have a solid understanding of modern architectures, including cloud-native platforms, data ecosystems and enterprise integration patterns.

  • You can translate complex business challenges into scalable technical solutions and clearly articulate value to both technical and executive stakeholders.

  • You build trusted relationships and influence senior stakeholders while supporting business development, solution shaping and technical sales cycles.

  • You are adaptable across industries and regions, contributing to technical strategy, innovation and thought leadership in a rapidly evolving AI landscape.
