title: Consulting - Managing Director – Customer Led Transformation
description:
About the Role:

The Customer-led Transformation (CLT) Software Managing Director (MD) is a critical leadership role driving PwC’s growth in the $1 trillion global software market—the fastest growing segment of the economy. This role focuses on strengthening the firm’s presence and influence within the software and technology sectors by leveraging deep expertise in how emerging market trends impact customer engagement and software delivery.

The MD will lead the design and execution of innovative go-to-market strategies, pipeline development, and commercial initiatives that bridge consulting, managed services, and digital transformation. Leading initial engagement with software clients, the MD drives downstream implementation opportunities and accelerates revenue growth.

Success in this role requires strong industry knowledge, proven experience handling complex commercial strategies, and established relationships across key software ecosystems and investor networks. The MD will collaborate closely with PwC’s internal solution teams and strategic alliances—including Salesforce, Microsoft, and Adobe—to unlock new growth avenues and create measurable business value.

This is a high-impact role, central to advancing PwC’s leadership in software consulting by addressing evolving client needs and market opportunities through tailored solutions and strategic partnerships.

What your days will look like:

  • Lead and execute the strategic growth of PwC’s software consulting business within CLT TMT, focusing on sales transformation and pipeline development.

  • Drive collaboration with alliance partners to develop innovative, AI-infused offerings and integrated go-to-market strategies.

  • Manage and grow a specialised team to support pursuit and delivery efforts in software-focused sectors.

  • Develop and implement commercial models optimising subscription monetisation, partner reseller networks, and customer personalisation.

  • Champion adoption of advanced technologies such as GenAI to enhance client service and internal delivery efficiencies.

  • Provide leadership across key accounts, expanding engagement with strategic clients and identifying new market opportunities.

  • Collaborate in cross-functional initiatives including Deals, Risk, Tax, and Digital to maximize impact and client value.

  • Act as a credible market player advocating PwC’s position in software consulting through thought leadership and industry engagement.

This role is for you if:

  • Extensive industry knowledge in software and technology sectors with a focus on hyperscalers and software-centric business models.

  • Proven commercial leadership with expertise in driving software GTM motions, business model innovation, and evolving partner/channel models.

  • Experience leading complex sales strategies that integrate business leadership with technical delivery.

  • Strong network across major and emerging software players, investors, and technology ecosystems.

  • Creative deal making capabilities including risk-reward models and integrated managed services.

  • Demonstrated ability to build and lead high-performing teams, managing multiple layers of direct reports and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Deep understanding of software subscription pricing, digital customer engagement, and AI-enabled market transformation.

  • Credibility as a strategic advisor and market influencer within the software consulting industry.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

The role sits within the Private Equity Portfolio (PE Portfolio) Tax team,one of the most successful teams within PwC’s Deals Tax network.

Our PE Portfolio team advises Private Equity backed businesses, working collaboratively across specialisms to drive value and help our clients succeed at all stages of the deal lifecycle. The team operates on a national basis so that no matter where individuals are located, we bring the best experts to our clients and the broadest range of opportunities to our people. Our client base is truly international and we pride ourselves on the strength of our network.

Our team is fueled by open and curious minds who are passionate about their work. As part of the team you’ll experience unparalleled opportunities to develop your career. You'll work on complex and challenging projects and gain experience working with prestigious and diverse clients - from high profile multinational organisations and private equity firms to start-ups and owner-managed businesses.

The role would suit a candidate with a strong UK corporate tax background, a good awareness of other taxes, as well as experience of managing client accounts. Experience of transaction work and/or the Private Equity market is desirable, but not essential, as full training and support would be provided.

What your days will look like:

  • You will work in a team providing tax advisory services to a range of PE portfolio company clients delivering bespoke tax advice in relation to the PE portfolio company and the transactions it is involved with. The work is wide-ranging including international tax and supporting our clients throughout the deal cycle. ​

  • Play a key role in building and maintaining relationships with clients. In particular, working closely with clients to provide them with proactive innovative and commercial tax services.

  • Seek specialist input from other parts of tax and wider network - in particular Transaction Service and non-UK teams

  • Be actively involved in business development activities, helping to identify and research opportunities with new and existing clients

  • Use technical knowledge and commercial awareness to help solve important problems for our clients

This role is for you if:

  • Chartered Accountant (ACCA, ICAEW, ICAS, CAI) or Chartered Tax Advisor (ATT, CTA) or equivalent international qualification

  • UK corporate tax skills and experience as well as good awareness of other taxes (VAT, employment taxes, management taxes etc)

  • Some transaction or PE Portfolio experience is desirable, but not essential

  • A flexible approach to allow you to work as part of a number of client/transaction teams simultaneously

  • Ability to build internal and external relationships and networks, both within the UK and overseas

  • Strong analytical, project management and report writing skills.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Lead AI and Data Architect, Senior Manager – Strategy, Governance and Architecture, AI & Data
description: Connect to your Industry Do you want to be at the heart of some of the biggest and most ambitious AI and data projects? How do you make intelligent, future-proof decisions in a world where change is the one constant? That is exactly what you will help our clients do. Take your career to the next level by joining one of the world’s best and most recognised professional services firms. You will build trusted relationships with business stakeholders and use the most exciting new technologies available to create data-driven programmes that transform their organisations. Your advice will help clients position their organisations to succeed in an ever-evolving marketplace. At Deloitte, you will have the opportunity to work with a wide variety of interesting, international and world-leading clients who are navigating an evolving marketplace where AI is fundamentally reshaping their businesses. With a focus on next-generation technology-enabled projects, you will be at the forefront of innovation and have the chance to make a real impact. Join us and be part of a dynamic, collaborative and supportive team dedicated to delivering exceptional results. You will have access to unparalleled training and development opportunities, as well as the chance to work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry. Connect to your career at Deloitte Deloitte drives progress. Using our vast range of expertise, we help our clients' become leaders wherever they choose to compete. To do this, we invest in outstanding people. We build teams of future thinkers, with diverse talents and backgrounds, and empower them all to reach for and achieve more. What brings us all together at Deloitte? It’s how we approach the thousands of decisions we make every day. How we behave, our beliefs and our attitudes. In other words: our values. Whatever we do, wherever we are in the world, we lead the way , serve with integrity , take care of each other , foster inclusion , and collaborate for measurable impact . These five shared values lead every decision we make and action we take, guiding us to deliver impact how and where it matters most . Our team specialises in “designing for data”: how to source it, store it, structure it, transform it and consume it for a wide range of data-centric use cases, including data APIs, data monetisation, GenAI, machine learning, management information and reporting. As a Senior Manager, you will lead the architecture of complex AI and data transformation programmes, working with senior client stakeholders to translate business objectives into scalable, secure and deliverable solutions. You will guide multidisciplinary teams from strategy and design through to implementation, while contributing to proposals, market-facing perspectives and internal practice development. In this role, you will be expected to: Help market-leading clients understand how to use data and cutting-edge technologies to address their challenges, ambitions and objectives. Lead the definition and design of end-to-end functional and solution architectures that articulate the capabilities required to support data and analytics activities. Work closely with executive-level client stakeholders and cross-functional project teams, including business analysts, data engineers, architects and testers, to understand business vision and requirements, translate them into actionable project plans, roadmaps and technical specifications, and ensure successful project delivery. Provide thought leadership and contribute to the development of innovative technology solutions, sharing your expertise and best practices with clients and colleagues. Mentor junior team members, foster their professional development, and lead effective, enthused and diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contributions. Contribute to proposals for new business opportunities, showcasing your expertise and understanding of client needs. Stay abreast of industry trends and the vendor landscape through continuous learning, adapting to the ever-evolving data and AI technology landscape while building relationships and solution understanding with leading solution and platform vendors. title: Corporate Finance, Retail, Consumer & Leisure – Director
description:
About The Role:

We are recruiting a Director to join our Retail, Consumer and Leisure Corporate Finance team, a market-leading group of sector specialists advising on high-profile mid-market transactions. You will play a central role in originating and executing deals, working with entrepreneurs, private equity and corporates across a fast-evolving, dynamic consumer landscape.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of complex transactions, shape client outcomes and contribute to the continued growth of a high-performing team. We are looking for an experienced dealmaker with strong commercial judgement, an established network and a track record of delivering successful transactions end-to-end.

What your days will look like:

As a Director, you will combine transaction expertise and origination leadership to drive client outcomes and the growth of the team. Your day-to-day will include:

  • Building and maintaining a strong origination pipeline, identifying opportunities and leveraging your network to generate new business

  • Leading end-to-end transaction execution, managing timelines, stakeholders and delivery risk

  • Applying deep sector insights to shape client strategy and positioning across transactions

  • Providing leadership across the team, coaching and developing junior talent, and fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture

This role is for you if:

  • You have a proven track record of originating M&A transactions, ideally within the Retail, Consumer and Leisure sectors

  • You have extensive end-to-end transaction experience, with an ability to execute complex deals with multiple stakeholders

  • You have built and maintained senior client relationships across entrepreneurs, private equity and corporates, acting as a trusted adviser

  • You lead, develop and inspire high-performing teams, providing clear direction, coaching and structured development to junior colleagues.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions. We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: SOC Analyst
description:
About the Team

For us, a SOC is not just a ticket or detection "washing machine." Our understanding of a SOC includes monitoring and event detection and analysis, investigation of incidents and their remediation, and post-incident activities. We deliver services to our clients that consist of an analytic approach utilizing Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems, together with Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR/XDR) tools, as well as other technologies and tools that allow us to provide comprehensive services.

About your Manager

Ivana has over 7 years of experience across different IT fields and a focus on Cybersecurity for the last 5 years. Ivana is known for being a supportive team player. She is committed to nurturing the growth and development of each team member, ensuring they reach their full potential. Their collaborative approach and dedication to professional development inspire a thriving and innovative work environment. In her free time, Ivana is a sporty person, she likes running, swimming, triathlons and all kinds of endurance sport races.

Job Description & Summary

SOC Analyst is primarily responsible to identify and analyze threats in the clients environment, leveraging Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) & Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) tools, performing log analysis and investigation to reach conclusions based on evidence with high degree of confidence. Further responsibilities cover the continuous improvement through service development, guidelines and procedures update as well as the contribution to larger cross-disciplinary projects for major clients.

We provide an opportunity to grow in the Cyber Security field - whether your desire is to be the go-to SOC Architect, Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR) expert, Threat Hunter, Cyber Threat Intelligence professional, this is the team to be. With clients coming from Czech Republic as well as from the wider EMEA region, you will have the opportunity to grow your technical expertise or consulting skills (or both) of a lifetime.

Requirements of the Role

  • Minimum 1 year of relevant professional experience

  • Consistent, reliable and professional personality, capable of working within international & diverse teams

  • Previous SOC/CERT/CSIRT (or equivalent) experience highly desired

  • Hands-on skills within the information security field, with special focus towards system & log analysis or network & OS (Windows, Linux) administration

Nice to have

  • Working knowledge of the Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools like Microsoft Sentinel, Defender, Tanium, QRadar, FireEye

  • Previous experience in working in the global enterprise environment

  • Deeper experience in any (or more) of the following areas:

- Security/Network Analysis

- Incident Response

- Cyber Threat Intelligence

- Threat and Vulnerability Management

- Digital Forensics

  • Czech language is an advantage

  • Industry recognized certifications either in the area of general information security or focused towards Threat Management can be plus

Our Benefits and Fun

  • Concentrated experience and rapid career growth. It may sound like a platitude, but it really is.

  • Flexible work arrangements with the possibility of working from home.

  • Fair salary plus paid overtime.

  • Paid time off 20 + 5 days, 3 wellbeing days and 2 extra days off from the company at the end of the year.

  • High-end Ultrabook and iPhone with unlimited data.

  • Benefit program with 30.000 points that you can use for holidays, education, food vouchers, sports, health... Simply on what you enjoy.

  • Support for your education and development: business and digital skills training (e.g. Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau), ongoing training and certification, for example in Microsoft (Azure, PowerApps), project management (Prince2, PMI), service management (ITIL), agile development

We partner with leading organisations to transform their marketing functions, customer engagement models and technology ecosystems to deliver measurable commercial outcomes. We're looking for a director to lead the growth of our Experience & Marketing capability. This is a hybrid sales and delivery leadership role, combining commercial leadership, proposition development and the successful delivery of complex transformation programme.

As a Director within PwC's Sales, Service & Marketing practice in CSX, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and growing our Marketing proposition. You will be responsible for developing client relationships, expanding strategic alliances and leading the delivery of large-scale marketing transformation programmes.

As organisations increasingly adopt AI-powered and agentic operating models, this role will help clients reimagine how marketing functions are designed, operated and measured, leveraging data, automation, generative AI and autonomous agents to deliver more personalised, efficient and measurable outcomes.

Whilst primarily focused on marketing transformation, the role will also support broader customer experience and customer-led change initiatives where marketing acts as a key enabler of end-to-end customer transformation.

What your days will look like:

You will be responsible for leading the proposition development of marketing, driving commercial growth through:

  • Collaborating with our key alliances (Salesforce, Adobe, Microsoft) and emerging AI ecosystem partners.

  • Collaborating across Lines of Service to expand the value of current accounts where there is an existing or potential marketing, customer engagement or broader customer transformation opportunity.

  • Responsible for the management of the Marketing practice and building marketing capabilities within the newly defined organisational structure in CSX and our delivery centres. This includes strengthening capabilities across marketing strategy, marketing technology, AI-enabled marketing operations and adjacent customer experience disciplines.

  • Delivery of strategic Marketing transformation programmes, including those involving significant AI adoption, organisational change and complex technology ecosystems, whilst supporting wider customer experience transformation.

This role is for you if:

  • Have extensive marketing transformation experience within a large consulting firm with experience of working internationally, having gained an understanding of how marketing contributes to broader customer experience and customer-led transformation.

  • Deep focus on marketing strategy, marketing technology, systems and processes, customer data and AI-enabled marketing capabilities, alongside related areas of customer experience transformation.

  • Thought leader in marketing transformation, marketing technology strategy and delivery, and the application of Generative AI and Agentic AI to marketing and customer engagement; viewed by clients as an expert who they turn to for help and advice.

  • Help clients define and implement AI-enabled marketing operating models, embedding automation, generative AI and agentic capabilities to improve effectiveness, efficiency and customer outcomes.

  • Confidence working across sector verticals - from banking and insurance to non-profits - to promote and deliver client impact across the clusters with a focus on Private.

  • Manage and deliver large projects by developing the project team, assessing engagement risks throughout, driving conclusions, and reviewing / challenging the output produced by the team.

  • Excellent client handling skills with experience of leading external client projects and/ or large-scale strategy and operations change programmes.

  • Strong change and people leadership skills, track record of successful change execution and an exemplary track record in providing client satisfaction as well as being a strong team player.

description:
About the role

Our Insurance & Asset & Wealth Management Risk & Regulation Advisory team helps insurers and asset & wealth managers respond to regulatory change, strengthen controls and improve governance. The team offers strong technical exposure, structured development and the opportunity to work alongside experienced practitioners across risk, regulation and assurance.

We offer market-leading solutions and advisory services to finance leaders who want to manage the growing complexity of their roles. We support our clients with strategy development, operating model design, organizational design, and technical implementations – all to enable successful finance transformations. As part of Deloitte’s Business Finance offering, you will help clients across various industries solve complex challenges related to the CFO area, in collaboration with colleagues in Deloitte’s local and global network. The focus of the work lies within areas such as performance management, planning, budgeting & forecasting, consolidation, group reporting, management analytics, and business partnering - supported by leading technologies. We value an inclusive and collaborative culture where curiosity and high ambitions permeate our work. You will become part of a strong professional network with excellent opportunities for personal and professional growth. We are looking for an experienced project leader who wants to drive assignments in advisory services to CFOs with a focus on Business Finance. The role includes: Identify customer priorities and needs, and analyze challenges to translate them into concrete and value-creating solutions Design and implement new operating models that encompass technology, data, processes, organizational structure, and governance Ensure comprehensive delivery of consulting projects by leading cross-functional teams in an inclusive and engaging team culture Actively contribute to the development of our Business Finance offering and strengthen Deloitte’s position as a strategic partner to CFOs Participate in business development through customer dialogues, thought leadership, industry events, and internal competence development At Deloitte, we invest in your development – both professionally and personally. Through comprehensive training programs, mentoring, and practical learning, you will have the opportunity to develop your expertise and shape leadership grounded in your strengths, values, and drivers. We are looking for candidates with solid experience in the finance field and a strong desire to work in advisory services to CFOs. title: M&A Operations - Finance in Deals - Senior Manager
description:
About the role

M&A Operations utilises its deep experience to assist our clients across industry sectors as they navigate potential/actual M&A transactions and drive activities across all operational aspects of the transaction, pre and post completion. We are able to quickly assimilate the key operational issues, synergies, risks and upsides around a transaction, to deliver results. You are likely to work on a range of the different types of projects we support our clients with, which includes but is not limited to:

● Buy and sell side operational due diligence

● Value creation strategy and planning

● Carve out and divestiture support

● Integration support

● Taking control and 100 day planning

● Post deal performance improvement

What your days will look like:

  • You will work on a range of projects across different business sectors, whilst also focusing on the full breadth of Finance Function responsibilities including finance processes, operations, and reporting. You will draw on your previous client experience, and knowledge of deals to advise CFOs and their Finance Functions on key decision making and mitigation of risks throughout the deal.

  • The work involved can be complex and part of a fast-paced environment, therefore the role will require the ability to quickly understand, analyse and provide trusted opinions on the key issues and opportunities facing the Finance Function.

  • As a Senior Manager, you’ll lead teams and work as a trusted advisor to the most senior members of Finance, to help anticipate and solve the CFO’s complex business issues from strategy to execution.

  • Beyond project work, the role also involves driving business development and internal initiatives, to grow and develop the ways we can enhance our team, and our routes to market. You will utilise your experiences to take ownership of developing new ways to support our clients in the deal environment, as well as developing your networks both within wider PwC and with our external client base.

This role is for you if:

● Experience of finance advisory roles gained in a consulting firm, or experience in an in-house Finance role, especially those where you’ve driven change in the effectiveness of a Finance function

● M&A experience, ideally synergy, integration and/or carve-out projects, related to Finance functions

● A strong understanding of the structure/underlying processes supporting the Finance Function, including activities such as budgeting and forecasting, management reporting, and finance processes (PTP, RTR, OTC etc.)

● Experience of managing and leading Finance change / transformation projects

● Expertise in Financial analysis and understanding of the key operational / business drivers, including the ability to quickly understand large amounts of information and draw out hypotheses and/or conclusions

● Excellent communication skills, particularly the ability to produce high-quality written reports and present to senior stakeholders

  • Must possess a Professional accounting qualification, MBA or other similar qualification (or an international equivalent) or have equivalent work experience. This includes international candidates who qualify through experience in their home country

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Manager Accounting - und Kapitalmarktberatung (w/m/d)
description:
Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Assurance Solutions suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Manager Accounting – und Kapitalmarktberatung (w/m/d).

Das erwartet dich

Zukunftsausrichtung – Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die Begleitung von Börsengängen und Kapitalerhöhungen auf dem deutschen und US-Kapitalmarkt. Du leitest die Prospekterstellung und Erstellung von Finanzinformationen im Zusammenhang mit Carve Outs oder Post Merger Integrations mit.
Beratung – Du berätst bei der Einführung von kapitalmarktfähigen Reportings. Darüber hinaus leitest du unsere Kunden bei der Umstellung der Rechnungslegung von HGB auf IFRS/US GAAP/other GAAPs an und bist Ansprechpartner zu komplexen Bilanzierungsfragen.
Vielfältigkeit – Du bist Hauptansprechperson für unsere Kunden bei der digitalen Transformation von Finanz- und Accountingprozessen.
Projektleitung – Du bist in der Leitung von mehreren Projekten und hier Ansprechpartner: in für Kolleg: innen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast dein Studium in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-) Informatik, Mathematik, Naturwissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang abgeschlossen.

  • Du verfügst über mehrere Jahre (internationale) Erfahrung in der Accounting- und Kapitalmarktberatung.

  • Du bringst theoretische und praktische Kenntnisse der nationalen und internationalen Rechnungslegung mit.

  • Du hast schon eigenständig Projekte geleitet und Verantwortung für Mitarbeitende übernommen.

  • Du beherrschst die Sprachen Deutsch und Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift.

Deine Benefits

Flexibilität – In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. title: Threat Detection and Response Specialist

For us, SOC is not just a ticket or detections „washing machine “. We perceive incident response as a mandatory part of our services, along with other proactive activities such as: Threat Hunting, Threat Intelligence, Vulnerability Management, as well as post-incident activities like Forensic Analysis and more.

Threat Management team consists of cybersecurity professionals focused on prevention of the cyberattacks via detection and responding to cyber threats. The key pillars consist of incident response, threat hunting, threat intelligence, security monitoring, vulnerability management, engineering and consulting services.

About your Manager

Lubomír has over 10 years of cyber security experience with different projects related to mainly cyber security managed services, building and operating Security Operation Centers (SOC), Threat Hunting & Intelligence and Vulnerability Management. Lubomír is also responsible for team leading, project management, designing of cyber security managed services, creation and development of training plans and is a proven coach to train other team members or client staff. Outside of work, he is involved in teaching, science, and research at the University of Hradec Králové, where he guarantees and teaches the course Surveillance Systems and Forensic Analysis.

Job Description & Summary

We are building a new, compact delivery team (2-3 FTE) focused on Threat Detection & Response (TDR), which will be the backbone of our professional services offering. This team does not operate purely as a specialized "tool team" nor solely as an advisory team without technical depth.

We are looking for individuals who want to combine hands-on technical work with a consulting overlay—a skill set that includes structuring problems, designing solutions, communicating them effectively to clients, and seeing projects through to completion. If you are looking for a role where you spend 80% of your time on slides and only 20% on technology, this position is not for you. if you also prefer to work exclusively in a SOC and have no interest in client context, this role is also not suitable.

As a Senior Associate in our TDR team, you will be a key member of our delivery team, combining technical depth with a consulting approach. You will work directly on client projects, handling everything from technical analysis and implementation, to preparing deliverables and presenting findings to the client. You are not just a "tool operator" – you are a "security thinker" who understands not only technology but also its impact on our clients' business.

Technical Delivery (50% of Time)

  • Engage in hands-on work with SIEM (primarily Splunk, secondarily Microsoft Sentinel) including configuration, optimization, and troubleshooting.

  • Develop and refine detection rules/use cases based on threat landscapes and client requirements.

  • Support incident response processes, including analyzing incidents and recommending remediation actions.

  • Work with log management architectures, data sources, and log onboarding.

  • Assess the maturity of clients' detection and response capabilities.

Client Communication (30% of Time)

  • Independently lead technical workshops and working sessions with client security teams.

  • Present technical findings and recommendations with the ability to translate technical jargon into understandable conclusions.

  • Participate in status meetings, discussing scope, priorities, and next steps.

  • Build and maintain working relationships with client security teams.

Documentation and Business Development (20% of Time)

  • Prepare high-quality deliverables: assessment reports, solution proposals, recommendations, and roadmaps.

  • Compile executive summaries and outline business impacts of technical findings.

  • Assist in proposal preparation—providing technical input, labor estimation, and scope definition.

  • Contribute to the internal knowledge base and aid

title: Senior Consultant / Manager - Trade Finance Consulting - Fokus Digitalisierung (m/w/d)
description: Du willst im Bereich Consulting – Banking & Capital Markets Finanzdienstleister bei der digitalen Transformation ihrer Trade-Finance-Prozesse begleiten? Unser Team gestaltet die Zukunft des internationalen Handelsfinanzierungssektors durch innovative Technologien, Prozessautomatisierung und strategische Beratung. Wir treiben die Digitalisierung der Dokumentenprüfung, Plattformintegration und regulatorischen Compliance voran. Mach mit uns den Unterschied: als Senior Consultant / Manager – Trade Finance Consulting (m/w/d) . Standorte: Berlin , Düsseldorf , Frankfurt (Main) , Hamburg , Hannover , Köln , München und Stuttgart . Dein Impact: Als Senior Consultant Trade Finance (m/w/d) berätst du unsere Mandanten bei der digitalen Neuausrichtung ihrer Trade-Finance-Aktivitäten – mit besonderem Fokus auf die Automatisierung und Digitalisierung der Dokumentenprüfung und angrenzender Prozesse. Digitale Konzeption: Du entwickelst End-to-End-Lösungen zur Digitalisierung von Dokumentenprozessen – z. B. OCR-gestützte Prüfung von Akkreditiv-Dokumenten, KI-basierte Compliance-Checks oder Blockchain-basierte Dokumentenverifikation. Prozessanalyse: Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale in bestehenden Workflows und entwickelst digitale Zielbilder für Dokumentenprüfung, Abwicklung und Reporting. Technologieeinsatz: Du implementierst moderne Plattformen und Tools (z. B. Surecomp DOKA, Finastra Fusion Trade Innovation, Traydstream, essDOCS) und begleitest die Integration in bestehende Systemlandschaften. Innovationstreiber: Du bringst neue Technologien wie Machine Learning, Smart Contracts oder API-basierte Plattformlösungen aktiv in die Projekte ein. Strategieentwicklung: Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung digitaler Trade-Finance-Strategien, z. B. zur ESG-konformen Dokumentation oder zur Automatisierung regulatorischer Prüfprozesse. Dein Skillset: Abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar sowie fundierte Erfahrung im Bereich Trade Finance – idealerweise mit Fokus auf Digitalisierung, Dokumentengeschäft, Garantien oder Supply Chain Finance Kenntnisse digitaler Dokumentenprüfungs-Tools und Plattformen (z. B. Traydstream, Conpend, essDOCS, Bolero, Enigio) sowie sicherer Umgang mit MS Office und digitalen Kollaborationstools Verständnis regulatorischer Anforderungen (z. B. B. zur Unterstützung für pflegende Angehörige, Elternzeit-Beratung und vielem mehr Gesundheit & Fitness im Fokus durch regelmäßige Gesundheitstage, Kooperationen mit Fitness-Anbietern und die Unterstützung von Sport- und Teamevents Attraktive Arbeitgeberleistungen inklusive Bike- und Pkw-Leasing, Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung sowie flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen wie z. B. title: Business Consultant
description:
About the team

Our team of 30 colleagues has been the driving force for innovation in the area of document automation within the PwC Network. The team operates a document automation platform that is being used in almost 50 countries, will soon provide the services to the whole PwC Network globally and expand to external markets. Besides that, our team provides to our clients a broad range of document-related services, such as contract management, invoice automation, regulated documents, or records management. A career in our team will provide you with a significant variability of activities, tasks and projects and will enable you to participate on global projects.

About your manager

Štěpán is a Senior Manager at PwC with over 25 years of experience in business consulting, IT management, and document automation.
Štěpán is a coaching‑oriented leader who helps team members grow into autonomous professionals, supporting them with deep know‑how and experience. Over his career, he has contributed to some of the largest DMS deals in the Czech Republic, implemented systems automating more than one million invoices annually. His passion is helping organizations escape document chaos, strengthen compliance, and benefit from efficient, modern workflows — while exploring how AI and large language models can further transform document processing. At PwC, Štěpán’s mission is to build a strong senior team capable of delivering impactful solutions on international projects and using cutting‑edge technologies.
In his free time, he teaches diving, combining discipline, calm leadership, and a passion for helping others grow — both underwater and in professional life.

With 30 specialists supporting a platform used across nearly 50 countries — and soon across the entire PwC network — you will help deliver a broad portfolio of document‑related services, from contract management and invoice automation to regulated documents, records management, and large‑scale workflow automation.

As a Business Consultant, you will work across all project stages and help clients transform the way they manage documents and processes. You will engage directly with clients, understand their challenges, and translate them into solutions built on leading DMS, ECM, AI, workflow and process‑automation technologies. The role offers the opportunity to work on impactful local and international projects, collaborate with experienced colleagues, and further develop your consulting, technical, and project skills — including exposure to modern AI‑driven automation.

You will:

  • Participate in early‑stage client discussions to identify document‑related pains and map them to suitable document‑automation solutions.

  • Present DMS capabilities and explain how specific platforms address client needs.

  • Conduct detailed requirements analysis and prepare structured business solution designs.

  • Facilitate client workshops, internal design sessions, and presentations throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Contribute to engagements, helping clients decide what solutions to implement and how best to implement them.

  • Support the delivery of document‑automation projects to ensure solutions match client expectations and agreed scope.

  • Work on cross‑functional projects using modern, cutting‑edge document technologies.

  • Collaborate with other PwC teams — including Data and AI — to create holistic, value‑adding solutions for clients.

  • Engage in international projects and broaden your expertise in emerging automation approaches.

  • This role is ideal for a mid‑level consultant who wants to grow fast, work with world‑class technologies, and shape how organizations manage documents in an era where AI introduces new, exciting possibilities.

  • We help clients build modern, efficient and compliant document ecosystems — and you can be part of it.

This role is for you if:

  • Must possess a Chartered Accountant / ACA / ACCA / ICAS qualification (or an international equivalent) or have equivalent work experience. This includes international candidates who qualify through experience in their home country;

  • Experience of IFRS (essential) and UK GAAP (desired) and international standards on auditing (ISAs);

  • Strong project management skills and experience managing an audit from planning to completion including managing remote teams;

  • Confident in challenging yourself and others to complete high quality testing and documentation;

  • Takes pride in their work and in the Audit profession. Shows resilience and demonstrates dedication to self-development including being agile and innovative in the digital world.

What you'll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Financial Services Tax, Hedge Funds, Manager
description:
PwC's Alternative Investment Funds (AIF) team sits within our wider Financial Services Tax team. The team consists of specialists focusing on assisting alternative investment fund managers with a range of services across their business, covering the manager, the key people, the funds, investors and investments.


Whilst the team is UK based, the nature of the AIF industry means that a large amount of our work is international meaning there are many opportunities to work with the wider PwC AIF network on both outbound and inbound clients and opportunities to travel to the US are expected.


We are looking for a Manager with strong advisory and compliance focused tax experience to primarily focus on Hedge Fund and inbound clients, from start-ups all the way through to global multi-PM and multi strategy managers.

As a Manager you will have the opportunity to develop your skills, drive your ambition and work with experienced Partners and Directors across the team. The team will provide you with the opportunity to put into practice your tax technical skills in a stimulating and challenging environment.

What your days will look like:

  • The Alternative Investment Funds industry is dynamic, technically demanding and creative and offers opportunities to work on major transactions, international structuring, and a range of day-to-day UK tax matters

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Private Equity Risk and Compliance Manager
description:
As a Private Equity Independence Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in safeguarding the firm’s integrity while enabling growth. This is your chance to influence how we navigate a complex, evolving regulatory landscape—balancing commercial ambition with ethical responsibility. You’ll be at the heart of decision-making, ensuring independence and protecting our reputation, all while supporting the firm’s success in the private equity space. If you’re passionate about problem-solving, thrive under pressure, and want to contribute to something that truly matters, this i the role for you.

What your days will look like:

  • Monitor independence risks across private equity groups, including changes from investments, divestments, and restructuring.
  • Apply independence rules (FRC, SEC, Global Policy) to private equity structures across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Advise teams and partners on independence issues for complex relationships and portfolio companies.
  • Lead and document independence assessments for private equity clients, covering services, relationships, and investments.
  • Communicate confidently with senior stakeholders, providing clear guidance and delivering difficult messages when required.
  • Support training and knowledge-sharing initiatives for teams working with private equity clients.
  • Refine internal policies, procedures, and tools to strengthen independence compliance.

  • you have proven analytical, organizational, and project management skills, with the ability to make sound judgments and manage detailed information accurately.
  • you have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence to deliver clear, sometimes challenging messages and interact effectively at all levels.
  • you have strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, support, and empathize with client-facing practitioners.
  • you are a conscientious, ambitious team player, demonstrating strong self-management and the ability to take initiative in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • you have experience in coaching and supporting colleagues, with a collaborative approach to problem-solving and strong people management capabilities.

What you'll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Technology and Media Cost & Productivity - Senior Manager
description:
About the role:

The Enterprise Operations Transformation Cost and Productivity team sits within Consulting and focuses on delivering cost optimisation and productivity improvements for software and media clients in the Technology, Media and Telecommunications sector.

We are seeking a highly motivated leader to deliver hands-on engagements that combine stakeholder management, financial analysis, procurement expertise and sector knowledge. Our work spans strategic planning, rapid cost reduction, procurement and workforce optimisation, and cost transformation across COGS, SG&A and R&D.

This is an opportunity to join a growing Tech and Media team, leading high-profile assignments, shaping client recommendations, supporting business development and developing junior team members.

This post can be based in London.

What your days will look like:

You will work with high-profile software and media clients in a fast-paced, commercially focused environment, applying strong analytical and interpersonal skills to support operational change, financial turnaround and cost improvement.

As a Senior Manager, you will lead project delivery across multiple engagements, coach junior staff and act as the primary day-to-day contact for senior clients. You will work closely with Directors and Partners, manage risk, compliance, budgets and proposals, and lead business development activities. The role includes leading analysis, preparing and presenting reports, and working with client teams across functions to deliver cost optimisation projects on time and to budget.

You will work with our team to support a range of assignments including:

  • Driving project delivery, overseeing multiple cost optimisation and productivity improvement projects simultaneously.
  • Developing, planning and supporting the delivery of operational improvement projects across software, media and wider TMT businesses.
  • Developing and implementing cost control programmes across areas such as cloud, software licensing, content production, marketing spend, professional services, technology operations and corporate functions.
  • Assessing and testing financial positions, forecasts and cost baselines, including business case development and scenario testing.
  • Leading strategic planning activities, including business case and scenario testing, to support investment, prioritisation and delivery decisions.
  • Applying cost transformation and programme management methodologies to scope, plan and deliver business change programmes on time and to budget.
  • Identifying cost reduction opportunities across COGS, SG&A and R&D through financial baselining, spend analysis, performance benchmarking and value analysis.
  • Leading third party spend optimisation activity across high-value and recurring spend
  • Collaborate closely with our clients and work at client site as and when required

This role is for you if:

  • Demonstrable experience in cost optimisation, productivity improvement, financial turnaround, procurement or operational improvement, gained in consulting or within a TMT sector company.
  • Knowledge of and experience in applying cost transformation and programme management methodologies to scope, plan and deliver business change programmes on time and to budget.
  • Understanding of cost principles and levers to reduce P&L cost across COGS, SG&A and R&D, including productivity improvement and doing more with less.
  • You understand the cost pressures facing software and media organisations, such as cloud consumption, software licensing, content production costs, marketing efficiency, platform investment, customer acquisition, workforce productivity and the need to scale profitably.
  • You are confident using Microsoft Excel to build cost baselines, test scenarios and prepare and present clear, well-structured analysis, reports and presentations to senior client staff using Microsoft PowerPoint.
  • You have a track record of driving project delivery, overseeing multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously and coaching junior staff.
  • You are flexible and willing to work across diverse projects, clients and locations.
  • A relevant qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CIPFA, CIMA, MCIPS or an equivalent professional qualifi

title: Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Senior Manager
description:
About the role:

We are seeking a Senior Manager to join our Risk and Resilience team to focus on Enterprise Risk Management. If you would like to work with the senior management teams of some of the UK’s leading non-financial services companies, have strong problem solving skills, intellectual agility and can build deep and productive relationships, our practice could be the right opportunity for you.

What your days will look like:

You’ll have experience in designing and implementing enterprise risk management (ERM) frameworks and be passionate about the value that can be derived from effective risk management. The successful applicant will have practical experience, ideally gained within a large consultancy or client organisation, of conducting some or all of the following activities:

  • Developing bespoke ERM frameworks and processes
  • Leading risk identification interviews and risk assessment workshops, including at executive management levels
  • Developing key risk indicator suites
  • Practical articulation of risk appetite
  • Designing risk reporting templates and dashboards
  • Conducting risk analytics, such as horizon scanning, scenario and strategic risk analysis etc.
  • Delivering impactful risk management training
  • Providing on-going risk monitoring support
  • Developing thought leadership and new propositions to help our clients
  • Managing and leading teams to deliver client facing, and internal engagements, including monitoring engagement progress and budget
  • Working as part of a team or independently depending on the size of the assignment
  • Developing and managing relationships with key client and internal stakeholders
  • Identifying and developing new client opportunities
  • Partial and full-time client secondments
  • Leading on the development of sales and marketing materials, including proposals and thought leadership
  • Providing input into the development of PwC’s ERM proposition

The role is for you if:

  • Highly confident and resilient, comfortable asserting yourself with senior clients (Executive and Board level)
  • Strong technical enterprise risk management knowledge (i.e. 7 years + experience) and proven ability developing and implementing practical risk management processes and frameworks
  • Familiarity with common risk analysis techniques, understanding of scenario modelling etc.
  • Experience using data and analytics to strengthen ERM insights (e.g. designing data-driven KRIs, dashboarding, trend/outlier analysis, and scenario/early-warning indicators)
  • Practical understanding of GenAI/LLM use cases in risk management (e.g. risk identification, horizon scanning, control/testing support, report drafting and synthesis)
  • Practical experience in one or more of the key risk areas that are relevant to our clients organisations (e.g. resilience, cyber security, geopolitical risks)
  • Knowledge of prevailing corporate governance requirements
  • Solid financial and commercial acumen and understanding
  • Excellent presentation skills and experience planning and facilitating workshops / risk exercises with senior level audiences
  • Robust diligence and ability to pay close attention to detail, including impeccable report-writing skills
  • Ability to innovate and think laterally
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills with ability to build trust and rapport with diverse internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Proven team management skills, including coaching and development of junior team members
  • Ability to work as part of a team and independently with little management oversight
  • Commercially focused and strong business development skills

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

These include flexible working, a hybrid office/client/home model, private medical cover, access to a virtual GP, volunteering days and a strong focus on wellbeing, inclusion and development.

title: Private Equity Senior Associate
description:
About the role

This role sits within PwC UK’s Private Equity Independence team, supporting partners and engagement teams in applying audit independence requirements across complex Private Equity structures. You’ll work with large, global PE groups, helping to analyse fund, portfolio and holding‑company hierarchies to ensure the correct independence restrictions are identified and applied.

A core part of the role is maintaining high‑quality data within PwC’s Client Entity System (CES), a critical firm‑wide system underpinning independence compliance globally. By ensuring CES accurately reflects client structures, you’ll play a key role in enabling the firm to serve its clients confidently while meeting regulatory independence obligations.

What your days will look like:

  • Ensure client entities are correctly structured and classified in CES and evaluating the restriction status of entities within the hierarchy
  • Assess and monitor independence risks across private equity groups, including ongoing changes due to investments, divestments, and restructuring. Evaluate the impact of these changes on the firm’s ability to provide audit and non-audit services
  • Initiating independence assessments to maintain the firm’s independence of its clients in the context of constantly changing hierarchies
  • Maintaining organisational structures and hierarchy, designing, updating, and managing trackers for accurate monitoring of timelines, tasks, and independence issues
  • Collaborate with internal teams to resolve hierarchy-related queries and support onboarding of new entities.

This role is for you if:

  • Ability to manage and interpret detailed information, ensuring accuracy in independence assessments and documentation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to interact at all levels and deliver clear, sometimes challenging, messages.
  • Working knowledge of the PwC’s CES system in desirable. Knowledge of private equity structures and independence regulations (FRC, SEC, GIP, etc.) is also desirable, but a willingness to learn and adapt is essential.
  • A conscientious, ambitious team player with strong self-management skills and the ability to take initiative.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, changing regulatory environment and able to adapt to new challenges and priorities

What you’ll receive from us

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more

title: Junior Analyst - Financial Crime (Deutschsprachige Projekte)
description:
Für unseren Bereich Financial Crime Advisory suchen wir Kandidat:innen auf eine Junior Analysten Stelle. Diese Position ist ideal für Absolvent:innen oder Kandidat:innen mit ersten Erfahrungen, die ihre Karriere im Bankenumfeld starten und praktische Einblicke in Financial Crime Operations gewinnen möchten.

Was erwartet dich

  • Back-Office Support im Bankenumfeld - Unterstützung bei administrativen und operativen Tätigkeiten im Bereich Financial Crime mit Fokus auf strukturierte Abläufe und Prozessqualität.

  • Konten- und Datenmanagement - Pflege, Aktualisierung und Kontrolle von Kundenkonten sowie Erfassung und Validierung von Daten in internen Systemen.

  • Datenverarbeitung und -kontrolle - Prüfung, Bearbeitung und strukturierte Verarbeitung von Daten mit Fokus auf Genauigkeit und Konsistenz.

  • Bearbeitung von Bankprozessen - Zuständigkeit für standardisierte bankinterne Anfragen sowie Durchführung administrativer Tätigkeiten inklusive Dokumentation.

  • Interne Kommunikation auf Deutsch - Abstimmung mit internen Fachabteilungen der Bank zur Klärung operativer Themen und Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe.

  • Einstieg in Financial Crime Themen - Unterstützung bei Aktivitäten im Bereich Geldwäscheprävention und regulatorischer Anforderungen sowie Aufbau von Fachwissen im Bankensektor. Unser Team unterstützt Banken dabei, Finanzkriminalität wie Geldwäsche oder Betrug zu erkennen und Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten.

Was bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (z. B. Wirtschaft, Finance oder ähnliches)

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

  • Interesse am Bankenumfeld und an Financial Crime-Themen

  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und detailorientierte Arbeitsweise

  • Affinität zur Arbeit mit Daten und administrativen Prozessen

  • Teamfähigkeit sowie zuverlässige und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise

  • Erste praktische Erfahrung im administrativen oder banknahen Umfeld von Vorteil

Was bieten wir an?

  • Gebündelte Erfahrung und schnelles Karrierewachstum. Das mag wie eine Floskel klingen, ist aber tatsächlich so.

  • Faire Vergütung plus Bezahlung von Überstunden.

  • 25 Urlaubstage, 3 Wellbeing Days und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage zum Jahresende.

  • High-End-Ultrabook und iPhone mit unbegrenztem Datenvolumen.

  • Benefit-Programm mit 30.000 Punkten, die für Urlaub, Weiterbildung, Essensgutscheine, Sport (Multisport), Gesundheit und mehr genutzt werden können – ganz nach deinen persönlichen Vorlieben.

  • Unterstützung deiner Entwicklung und Weiterbildung: Trainings in Business- und Digital Skills (z. B. Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau), fortlaufende Schulungen, Zertifizierungen und vieles mehr. Zertifizierungen sowie die dafür benötigte Lernzeit werden von uns übernommen.

  • Außerberufliche Aktivitäten und Away Days (Teambuilding, Skiwochenende etc.).

  • Buddy-System und regelmäßiges Feedback zu deiner Arbeit sowie die Möglichkeit zur Abstimmung mit einem Coach über deine weitere Entwicklung und Karriereausrichtung.

description:

Our national practice works with large international listed and inbound businesses. You will work primarily on a complementary portfolio of Tax Accounting and Audit of Tax clients, with the opportunity to explore more general advisory projects.

title: Strategy& M&A Ops - Technology Director
description:
About the role

PwC’s S& M&A Operations team assists both Corporate and Private Equity (PE) clients in a wide range of business critical operational and transformational challenges, driven by Merger and Acquisition (M&A) activity. We advise our clients on deals with values ranging from £50 million to over £100 billion and our clients include some of the most well-known brands and businesses in the world.

We have around 200 dynamic and friendly people from a wide range of backgrounds and disciplines. We recruit proactively from industry, consulting, private equity and technology companies to create a blend of relevant experience to support each transaction.

Within the M&A Operations team, the Technology team is a successful, growing and ambitious team. As part of this team, you will be responsible crafting the separation/integration/value creation strategy, heavily leaning on top class IT skills and problem-solving capabilities. Buyers/sellers increasingly pursuing complex deals, such as carveouts, buy and split etc. - amid market uncertainty. Integrating/separating IT and driving value creation through IT tends to be the most complex part of these deals and requires out of the box creative thinking, collaboration across multiple business functions, and ability to get it done at deal speed.

As a Director, you set the strategic direction, lead business development efforts, and oversee multiple projects while maintaining influential executive-level client relations. You drive business growth, shape client engagements, and mentor the next generation of leaders, upholding PwC's reputation for quality, integrity, and inclusion.

What your days will look like:

  • Lead the formulation and implementation of successful deal IT separation and integration strategies
  • Leverage your technical depth on various IT domains (applications, infrastructure), architecture and separation / integration management to solve problems
  • Guide business development initiatives to drive growth
  • Oversee multiple projects to achieve quality delivery
  • Maintain and enhance executive-level client relationships
  • Mentor and develop future leaders within the team
  • Adhere to PwC's standards of quality and integrity
  • Foster an inclusive and collaborative work environment
  • Promote innovative solutions and thought leadership

The role is for you if you have:

  • Demonstrates thought leader-level abilities with, and/or a proven record of success leading efforts in top-tier management consulting firms, M&A and Divestitures situations
  • Broad knowledge of different IT domains and strong grasp of technology architecture, strategy and divestments/integrations
  • Proven record of success in directing efforts, managing and developing client relationships
  • Building reliable and collaborative relationships with team members
  • Securing new business development and project extensions
  • Communicating complex information effectively in written and oral formats
  • Leading teams to develop client proposals and solutions
  • Developing and sustaining client relationships through networking
  • Preparing and presenting thorough and clear presentations effectively
  • Demonstrated ability in evaluating and developing strategic approaches for the seamless integration/carveout/value creation anchored on technology to support business objectives

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Financial Services, Asset Wealth Management, Tax Senior Manager
description:
About the role

Our team helps our Financial Services clients navigate the frequently changing and complex national and international tax environment related to stringent capital requirements, management of operational tax risks, and tax implications of investing in different jurisdictions. You’ll help our clients with their tax structuring while helping to address the challenges of the continuously changing tax world, both locally and globally.

Our Asset & Wealth Management (AWM) team is one of the fastest growing areas of PwC's Financial Services tax advisory practice.

We are looking for a Senior Manager with strong UK Corporate Tax experience to join the team

What your days will look like:

  • You will be responsible for helping to manage an established team and providing quality advisory services to a high-profile portfolio of both UK and multinational clients

  • This role offers opportunities to work on major transactions, international structuring, and a range of day-to-day UK tax matters and audit of tax work

  • There will also be opportunities to develop deeper knowledge in particular areas of interest such as group reorganisations, BEPs planning and divestments and acquisitions

  • You will be responsible for building close relationships with a wide range of clients. You will benefit from a progressive environment where you will be encouraged to develop client relationships, technical expertise and people management skills

  • As a Senior Manager you will have the opportunity to work with experienced Partners and Directors across the FS team. The team will provide you with the opportunity to put into practice your tax technical skills in a stimulating and challenging environment

This role is for you if:

  • You have a solid background in UK corporate tax, gained within a professional services or corporate environment and knowledge of the financial services sector

  • Ideally, you will have practical experience of working within one or more of the asset management sub-sectors, but this is not essential.

  • You possess a CTA/CA/ACCA qualification (or an international equivalent) or have equivalent work experience. This includes international candidates who qualify through experience in their home country.

  • You have strong leadership, coaching and mentoring skills and can demonstrate the ability to lead and inspire a diverse team

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

Jaký bude Tvůj tým

Jsme tým zkušených mzdových účetních, kteří se zabývají dceřinými společnostmi nadnárodních firem. Jsme tu proto, abychom klientům pomohli dodržovat českou mzdovou a daňovou legislativu.

Kromě mzdové agendy často pracujeme na projektech implementace mzdového softwaru či na transformačních projektech a přispíváme svými znalosti v oblasti českého práva a mzdových procesů.

Na koho se můžes spolehnout

Martina Seidlová, partnerka v daňovém oddělení, která vede accounting a payroll services, působí ve společnosti již více než 20 let. Svou kariéru započala jako Audit assistant, postupně se posouvala dál a své zkušenosti nyní zúročuje v compliance službách.

O čem bude Tvoje role

  • Zajištění kompletní mzdové agendy pro různé typy klientů včetně znalosti exekučních srážek a odškodnění pracovních úrazů.

  • Znalost zahraničních / vyslaných zaměstnanců.

  • Aktivní komunikace s klienty a obchodními partnery, řešení jejich dotazů týkajících se mzdové agendy a budování pevných vztahů.

  • Precizní analýza vstupních dat a zajištění vysoké kvality zpracování mezd.

  • Neustálé udržování a rozšiřování odborných znalostí v oblasti pracovního práva, daní, sociálního zabezpečení a legislativy zdravotního pojištění.

  • Úzká spolupráce s účetními, daňovými a HR týmy.

title: Consultant Data Analytics Global Transformation Tax (w/m/d)
description:
Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Tax & Legal Solutions suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Consultant Data Analytics Global Transformation Tax (w/m/d).
Das erwartet dich
Team – Als Teil unseres Global Transformation Tax Teams arbeitest du gemeinsam mit Kolleg:innen aus Tax, Tech und Finance an innovativen End-to-End-Lösungen, die Unternehmen fit für externe regulatorische Anforderungen und die interne Transformation machen.
Analyse – Du entwickelst clevere, pragmatische Lösungsansätze zur Strukturierung, Verarbeitung und Validierung von Finanzdaten.

title: Financial Services, Private Client US/UK Tax - Senior Manager
description:
About the role:

Our Private Client US/UK team help our clients navigate the frequently changing and complex landscape of having exposure to both US and UK taxation, and manage the international tax environment related to stringent reporting requirements.

A career in our team will provide you with the opportunity to advise clients on their US and UK tax affairs, while acting as a trusted advisor feeding in on any tax considerations to be had when making financial decisions or acquiring assets. We are seeking a Private Client UK/US Senior Manager for our team to help individuals understand where the primary right to tax lies in different scenarios, as well as providing advice on tax implications of movement of funds.

What your days will look like:

  • Managing a diverse and broad portfolio of client engagements, while delegating responsibility to junior staff and consulting Directors & Partners where applicable.

  • Working closely with experienced Private Client Partners and Directors and having the responsibility of helping develop new client relationships, deliver complex projects, identifying and pursuing new opportunities from within our market.

  • Ability to balance leadership responsibilities with the needs of clients and the firm.

  • Maintaining an expert level of relevant US & UK tax knowledge, staying current with technical developments including changes in tax law and legislation.

This role is for you if:

  • You have relevant, detailed and up-to-date US and UK tax knowledge in the personal tax industry and experience of dealing with complex tax issues facing owners, founders and executives, as well as privately or family owned businesses.

  • You have excellent project management skills – being able to manage several demanding client projects while remaining resilient and planning workload for themselves and others.

  • You have experience in advising on international aspects such as residence, domicile and arriving/leaving the US and the UK as many of our clients have a global footprint and are internationally mobile.

  • You can demonstrate strong organisational skills with the ability to meet deadlines throughout the year and deliver high-quality work.

  • You must be an Enrolled Agent and possess one of the following qualifications; ACA,CTA or ATT (or international equivalent)

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Private Business Senior Manager
description:
About the role

Our Private Business team specialise in providing corporate tax advice to privately owned and Private Equity backed businesses together with owners and management teams on all aspects of tax in the UK and abroad including shareholder issues.

Our curious minds and collaborative spirit enables us to work together, helping clients navigate the ever changing tax landscape. As part of the team you’ll be actively encouraged to consult, to share specialist knowledge and new ideas as we continue to innovate to deliver best in class service.

A key role in a growing team, working closely with experienced Private Business Partners and Directors to develop new client relationships (including many well-known household names), identifying, and pursuing new opportunities from within our market.


What your days will look like

  • Ownership for a diverse and broad portfolio of client engagements, including privately owned and private equity portfolio companies advising on tax technical issues

  • Developing significant market relationships with clients and internal stakeholders

  • Collaborating across the firm when delivering complex projects / events

  • Maintaining an expert level of relevant tax knowledge (both UK and overseas) staying including changes in tax law and legislation.

  • Must possess a ACA and/or CTA qualification (or international equivalent)

  • Relevant and up-to-date UK (and some overseas) tax knowledge

  • Varied experience of more complex tax issues facing privately or family-owned businesses, private equity portfolio companies and business owners.

  • Project management skills - able to manage several client projects simultaneously

  • Stakeholder management and coaching ethos

  • Excellent written communication - including reports, technical memos


What you’ll receive from us

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Manager - Capital Projects Risk and Control
description:
About the role:

At PwC, Capital Projects Risk & Control team typically reports to the Head of Assurance, PMO Assurance Leads, Internal Audit or CFO, providing expert challenge and scrutiny over project delivery and third party relationships in order to deliver improved outcomes for capital projects, such as reduced cost or risk. We deliver complex programmes of work using a high-performing team diverse in its experience in performing capital project reviews, programme and baseline assurance commercial and deal shaping / re-shaping and negotiation.

We’re seeking talented, high performing professionals to join our team across all levels of experience.

If you enjoy working with high profile clients – often household names – then our growing Capital Projects Risk & Control team at PwC will provide you with that opportunity.

What your days will look like:

  • Leading and managing work-streams within a larger engagement, supporting the delivery of advisory and assurance services on major capital programmes.
  • Delivering reviews on capital projects throughout their lifecycle, providing observations, recommendations and proposals to clients to help them plan and execute their projects on time and on budget, and supporting the implement of these.
  • Assessing the compliance, effectiveness and maturity of the project management and project controls activities and supporting the implementation of agreed improvements to help the clients to monitor, control and mitigate their risks on costs, schedules, scope and quality.
  • Reviewing contracts and commercial matters on capital projects (i.e. major deals / business cases / commercial strategies) and providing observations, recommendations and proposals to clients to help them optimise their controls and supporting the implementation of these. Reviewing contracts and commercial matters on capital projects (i.e. major deals / business cases / commercial strategies) and providing observations, recommendations and proposals to clients to help them optimise their controls;
  • Leading or supporting the formation and / or review of complex third party arrangements on capital programmes.
  • Leading and performing supplier compliance and dispute resolution activities, to investigate value leakage or identify poor performance on capital programmes.

The role is primarily client facing at a senior level in often time-pressured environments; whilst there is frequent scope to innovate, recommendations must be based upon clear commercial logic and a robust understanding of the client’s unique circumstances and issues.

This role is for you if:

  • Experience in the development, delivery and / or assurance of major capital programmes, ideally within sectors such as energy, water, transport or central government.
  • Project controls, commercial management or quantity surveying backgrounds, combined with the ability to apply this experience in an advisory and assurance context.
  • Having done one or more of the following roles:
  • Supporting or leading project controls and/or project management activities on large, complex EPC or infrastructure programmes, including cost, schedule, risk and performance management
  • Advising on or delivering project controls, commercial strategy and programme assurance within professional services and/or client-side environments
  • Developing and stress-testing business cases and project execution strategies, with a clear understanding of delivery risk, affordability and value for money
  • Structuring and implementing commercial and contracting arrangements (e.g. NEC/FIDIC), including an appreciation of incentives, risk allocation and behavioural impacts
  • Leading or supporting procurement and supplier engagement, including negotiation and contracting strategies for major programmes
  • Interpreting and challenging programme data to provide clear, evidence-based insights to senior stakeholders

The role will allow the right individual to progress rapidly through the firm and develop a broad set of skills and experiences that are highly valued by senior executives at our clients.
