title: Insurance Tax Manager, Financial Services
description:
About the role

PwC’s Insurance Tax team is the UK market leader in providing tax services to the insurance sector. We work with general, life and health insurers, reinsurers, brokers, and the Lloyd’s market, serving major UK names as well as leading European, US and Bermudan groups. Alongside top-tier firms, we support medium-sized businesses and start-ups. Operating nationally, our team is centred in London with practices in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester and Bristol.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Manager to join our growing team, delivering a wide range of tax services to clients across the insurance market in a collaborative environment.

What your days will look like:

  • Support a portfolio of Financial Services Insurance clients, leading on direct tax advisory and compliance matters while supporting Senior Manager and Directors
  • Provide strategic solutions to complex insurance tax challenges, leveraging analytical skills and coordinating input from global specialists
  • Drive client growth and business development, identifying new opportunities and strengthening relationships across the insurance market
  • Lead and develop the team, through coaching, training, and supervision, while staying ahead of regulatory changes and building your PwC brand

This role is for you if:

  • You have proven experience in financial services, with strong ability to deliver high-quality work and manage complex client portfolios and projects
  • Excellent client relationship skills, confident in leading discussions with senior stakeholders and building trusted networks internally and externally
  • Strong organisational and risk management capabilities, with attention to detail and ability to meet tight deadlines while staying informed on industry trends
  • Insurance direct tax experience would be helpful but is not essential, as long as you bring a solid foundation in financial services and a willingness to learn

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

description:

Our Deals Tax team collaborates with our Deals practice to advise on tax implications of transactions, including Mergers & Acquisitions, Business Recovery Services, and Real Assets and Credit. As part of the Corporate Tax network, we work across specialisms to drive value and assist clients at all deal stages.

We seek Senior Managers for our national Deals Tax practice, ensuring top experts reach our clients and offering diverse opportunities for our team. With an international client base, we leverage our strong network.

Our team values open, curious minds and offers opportunities for career growth, working on complex projects with prestigious clients.

We connect the world of business with technologies from design to implementation. In Technology Consulting, you are not only a part of PwC, but you will also get the opportunity to get to know life in other companies. title: Accounting Services | Manager
description:
About the Role:

PwC’s Accounting Services (AS) team is a leading market focused business, providing corporate accounting services to national and multinational corporations, with a focus on helping them to remain compliant and providing insights to their operations.

The services provided by AS are high quality, process / cost efficient and relationship based. They are delivered by a technically proficient, innovative, commercially focused and agile national team.

As part of PwC, the largest global accounting firm, AS offers a challenging and exciting career path.

AS have a varied and prestigious client base and work with various specialists in their own field which, combined with the importance placed on continuous technical training and personal development, provides an excellent opportunity for career development.

What your days will look like:

The AS team is looking for a qualified ACA / ACCA Manager, with broad accounting / finance experience gained working within practice, to join the team.

AS provides outsourced accounting services. These include

  • the preparation of statutory financial statements (SFS).

  • providing skilled accountants on secondment where clients have a temporary need for additional resources.

  • bookkeeping and preparation of periodic management accounts.

In addition, AS manages and controls the preparation of local SFS for cross border clients.

AS also provides advisory services, which includes advising on:

  • statutory accounting compliance requirements.

  • improvements to the SFS cycle i.e. the production, audit and filing of SFS.

The role is for you if:

  • Must possess a ACA/ACCA Qualification (or an international equivalent).

  • Strong accounting skills and technical knowledge on financial reporting matters including the ability to work from first principles.

  • Very good working knowledge of UK GAAP / IFRS and some awareness of US GAAP.

  • IT literate, ideally with some experience of accounting packages and very good excel spreadsheet skills.

  • Highly professional attitude to providing a quality service on challenging assignments in a deadline driven environment, demonstrating flexibility in changing client environments.

  • Strong supervisory skills and ability to develop and coach staff, working in a team environment.

What you'll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Financial Services, Alternative Investment Funds, Senior Manager
description:
About the role:

PwC's Alternative Investment Funds (AIF) team sits within our wider Financial Services Tax team. The team consists of specialists focusing on assisting alternative investment fund managers with a range of services across their business, covering the manager, the key people, the funds, investors and investments.


Whilst the team is UK based, the nature of the AIF industry means that a large amount of our work is international meaning there are many opportunities to work with the wider PwC AIF network on both outbound and inbound clients and opportunities to travel to the US are expected.


We are looking for a Senior Manager with strong advisory and compliance focused tax experience to primarily focus on Hedge Fund and inbound clients, from start-ups all the way through to global multi-PM and multi strategy managers.

As a Senior Manager you will have the opportunity to develop your skills, drive your ambition and work with experienced Partners and Directors across the team. The team will provide you with the opportunity to put into practice your tax technical skills in a stimulating and challenging environment.

What your days will look like:

  • The Alternative Investment Funds industry is dynamic, technically demanding and creative and offers opportunities to work on major transactions, international structuring, and a range of day-to-day UK tax matters.

  • You will lead advisory focused projects for clients within the AIF team by taking responsibility for researching and summarising technical analysis.

  • You will be responsible for helping to manage the team to provide excellent advisory services to globally situated clients. You will need to understand the business and transactions undertaken by clients to enable you to provide opportunities to those clients at the right time.

  • You will be responsible for liaising with the compliance centre for a portfolio of clients by participating in client meetings, ensuring timetable adherence, supporting the compliance team with any tax analysis before undertaking a technical review of the work prepared.


This role is for you if:

  • You want a position where you will build relationships directly with senior client leadership and founders, become a real driver with day-to-day deliverables and manage and develop the existing junior team members.

  • You have experience of working with alternative investment fund managers specifically hedge funds

  • You are commercially, financially and operationally proactive and agile and keen to work in a fast paced ever changing environment.

  • You feel energised by meeting new people, enjoy working with clients who are developing their business and exploring new ideas.

  • You possess an accounting or tax qualification (or International equivalent) or have equivalent work experience. This includes international candidates who qualify through experience in their home country.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: SAP HCM Payroll Consultant - german payroll
description:
In SAP human capital at PwC, you will focus on providing consulting services for SAP Human Capital Management (HCM) applications. You will analyse client requirements, implement HCM software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilisation of SAP HCM applications. Working in this area, you will enable clients to optimise their human resources processes, enhance talent management, and achieve their strategic objectives.

About your manager

Martin Janečka, an experienced Project Lead who’s spent years navigating the world of management consulting—turning complexity into clarity, and (occasionally) making spreadsheets behave. My core playground is project delivery, SAP HR products (especially SuccessFactors), and everything around payroll processes—yes, I actually enjoy that part!

Outside of client workshops and project timelines, you’ll most likely find me downhill biking in the mountains rather than relaxing on a beach. I’m a big fan of rock and metal music., And I also share life with two energetic kids (9 and 3), which is probably my toughest—and most rewarding—project so far.

If you like a mix of structure, energy, and a bit of humor along the way—you’ll probably get along just fine :)

Job description & summary

Are you keen to grow your career in HR IT and further develop your competences in the field of SAP HCM payroll? Would you like to help companies modernize their payroll solution, make it part of sustainable HR IT cloud architecture and help shape HR and payroll related processes?

You will be part of our global consulting team. You will be working with experienced consultants and architects focused on payroll and master data management at local or large international clients.
You will communicate and work directly with clients, mainly HR/payroll people, in order to design processes, configure, implement and successfully launch payroll solutions which help our clients meet their business goals.
On a daily basis, you should use your analytic, presentation, communication and organisational skills and further develop your knowledge and experience within SAP HCM PA, OM and payroll.

Requirements of the role

  • At least 2 years of experience with SAP HCM Payroll, Personnel Administration (PA), and Organizational Management (OM); experience with German payroll is a strong advantage; We are also open to candidates with manager-level (5+ years) experience.

  • ABAP knowledge is an advantage

  • Interest in new technology trends and IT solutions.

  • Knowledge and / or interest in HR processes, HR systems such as SuccessFactors, Workday, Oracle HCM

  • Willingness to implement new IT solutions.

  • Analytical thinking

  • Fluent in Czech and English, German is a strong advantage

  • Willingness for ad-hoc international traveling

  • University degree

Our benefits and fun

title: Corporate and International Tax Senior Manager
description:
About the role:

Our team is a leading corporate and international tax practice advising large privately owned and private equity-backed multinational businesses across the UK. With colleagues in over 10 offices nationwide, we offer flexibility on location. We are looking for a Senior Manager with strong technical expertise, experience managing complex corporate and international tax projects, and the ability to lead client relationships and develop teams.
